en.title: Meta/Astryx: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
en.summary: ⭐ 27,696 | Astryx is an open source design system originally built inside Meta, powering over 13,000 apps. It provides 150+ accessible components that can be used seamlessly by both humans and AI assistants using the exact same tooling and references.
en.full_summary:
Overview and Background

Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years. It became the largest and most-used design system in the company, powering over 13,000 applications. Built on React 19+ and StyleX, it provides 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system.
Key Features

What makes Astryx different is its focus on open internals and AI readiness. It features no styling lock-in, allowing developers to override styles using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS. Themes are managed via CSS custom properties, enabling deep customization without forking component sources. Furthermore, its API, documentation, and CLI are designed concurrently so that people and AI assistants build interfaces in the exact same way.
Getting Started and Architecture

Astryx requires React 19 or later. Users can install the core package, themes, and CLI via npm, pnpm, or yarn. The project is organized into modular packages including @astryxdesign/core, @astryxdesign/cli, and a set of ready-made customizable themes, making it easy to integrate into existing React and Vite projects.

zh.title: Meta/Astryx：一个完全可定制且专为 AI 助手准备的开源设计系统
zh.summary: ⭐ 27,696 | Astryx 是一个最初在 Meta 内部打磨并支撑了 1.3 万个应用的开源设计系统。它提供超过 150 个无障碍组件，让人类开发者和 AI 助手能够使用完全相同的工具和参考规范无缝协作。
zh.full_summary:
项目概述与背景

Astryx 是一个在 Meta 内部经过八年打磨的开源设计系统。它目前是该公司规模最大、使用最广泛的设计系统，支撑着超过 1.3 万个应用程序。该项目基于 React 19+ 和 StyleX 构建，集成了 150 多个无障碍组件、品牌级主题、深色模式、现成模板以及配套的命令行工具。
核心特性

Astryx 的最大亮点在于其开放的内部结构和对 AI 的友好支持。它没有样式绑定，开发者可以自由使用 Tailwind、CSS 模块或原生 CSS 进行样式覆盖。主题通过 CSS 自定义属性进行管理，无需分叉组件源码即可轻松定制。此外，它的 API、文档和命令行工具经过统一设计，让人类和 AI 助手能够遵循完全相同的规范构建界面。
安装与架构

Astryx 要求 React 19 或更高版本。用户可以通过常用的包管理器（如 npm、pnpm 或 yarn）安装核心包、主题和命令行工具。整个项目采用模块化架构，包含核心组件库、CLI 工具以及多款预制主题，能够方便地集成到现有的现代前端开发工作流中。

en.title: Jensen Huang leaves Nvidia after 33 years
en.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has left the company following scandals, marking the end of an era for Big Tech. While analysts say Nvidia's product roadmap and supply chain remain solid through 2027, the company faces a major challenge in finding a successor with his visionary leadership and willingness to make massive long-term bets.
en.full_summary:
The Exit and Its Background
On January 6th, 2025, Jensen Huang made his final high-profile appearance as Nvidia's CEO. Shortly after, he left the company he cofounded 33 years ago amid reports of chip smuggling scandals and personal misconduct. As the leader of the world's most valuable chipmaker, Huang was unique in his absolute centralization of power, with around 60 employees reporting directly to him.
Business and Technology Impact
Industry analysts emphasize that Nvidia's immediate future is not in jeopardy. The company's hardware roadmap and manufacturing partnerships are locked in through 2027, and its supply chain dominance remains unmatched. However, experts note that Huang was irreplaceable as a culture setter and risk-taker who pushed through historical gambles like the CUDA platform, which ultimately powered the modern AI boom.
The Search for a Successor
Finding a new CEO will be difficult because Huang operated without deputies and built the entire organization around himself. Observers believe the company will likely need to look outside for a leader who can maintain investor confidence and protect the CUDA ecosystem during this transitional vacuum.

zh.title: 黄仁勋在执掌33年后离开英伟达
zh.summary: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在经历丑闻后离开了这家由他联合创立的公司，这也标志着科技界一个时代落幕。行业分析师认为，英伟达直到2027年的产品路线图和供应链依然稳固，但公司将面临寻找继任者的巨大挑战，新领导者很难复制他的远见卓识与魄力。
zh.full_summary:
离职背景与权力核心
2025年1月6日，黄仁勋最后一次以英伟达CEO身份公开亮相。随后，在遭遇芯片走私丑闻与个人风波后，他离开了这家自己创办了33年的公司。作为英伟达绝对的核心，公司过去一切决策都高度集中在他手中，甚至有大约60名员工直接向他汇报。
业务与技术影响评估
多位行业分析师指出，英伟达的短期业务并不会立即陷入危机。该公司的产品路线图和制造供应链已经锁定到了2027年，其供应链优势依然稳固。然而，专家认为黄仁勋身上那种敢于豪赌的远见和拍板魄力极难复制，正是他当年力排众议推动的CUDA平台，才为后来的AI浪潮奠定了基础。
寻找继任者的挑战
由于黄仁勋没有设立直接副手，整个公司围绕他一人打造，寻找合适的继任者将变得异常艰难。业内普遍认为，英伟达可能需要从外部物色新帅，以在过渡期内维持投资者信心并保护其核心软件生态。

en.title: AI Is Rocking the Literary World
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is quietly transforming the literary world, helping some authors churn out hundreds of novels while sparking massive controversies. Publishers, agents, and writers are grappling with rampant AI use, copyright hurdles, and a wave of false accusations that have derailed major book deals. While tech enthusiasts see a new creative tool, many writers fear it will undercut human creativity and flood the market with machine-made stories.
en.full_summary:
The Rise of AI Authors
Some self-published authors are leveraging generative AI to rapidly produce books, navigating platforms like Kindle Unlimited where high output is rewarded. Studies estimate that a significant portion of recent self-published books contain AI-generated text, though writers note that understanding structure and craft remains essential for success.
Scandals and Accusations
Mainstream publishing is facing a period of intense turbulence, with several high-profile book deals cancelled after authors were accused of using AI. Writers of color have disproportionately faced these investigative accusations, while innocent authors live in fear of false positives from detection tools or being penalized for trying to sound non-AI.
The Copyright and Future Dilemma
US copyright law currently requires books to be human-authored to receive full protection, leaving publishers hesitant to embrace AI fully. While traditional publishers refuse to promise a complete ban, many in the industry remain committed to protecting human artists against a backdrop of growing market anxiety.

zh.title: AI正在文学界掀起轩然大波
zh.summary: 人工智能正在悄然改变文学界，它一方面帮助部分作家高效产出数百部小说，另一方面也在行业内引发了巨大的争议。出版商、经纪人和作家们正在艰难应对泛滥的AI使用、版权难题，以及一波因虚假指控而取消多起重大图书交易的风波。尽管科技爱好者将其视为全新的创作工具，但许多作家担心这会削弱人类创造力，并让市场上充斥着机器制造的故事。
zh.full_summary:
AI作者的崛起
一些独立作家正在利用生成式人工智能快速创作图书，以适应Kindle Unlimited等鼓励高产的平台。相关研究估计，近期有相当一部分自助出版的书籍包含AI生成文本，不过作家们指出，要想成功，理解结构和写作技巧依然不可或缺。
丑闻与指控
主流出版业正经历剧烈动荡，多位作家被指控使用AI后，其备受瞩目的图书交易遭到取消。有色人种作家在这些调查性质的指控中面临不成比例的审视，而无辜的作家则生活在对检测工具误报的恐惧中，甚至因为极力避免被误认为AI而束手束脚。
版权与未来困境
美国版权法目前规定图书必须由人类创作才能获得完整保护，这让出版商对全面拥抱AI犹豫不决。尽管传统出版商拒绝彻底承诺禁用AI，但在不断加剧的市场焦虑背景下，行业内的许多人依然坚定致力于保护人类艺术家的利益。

en.title: AI makes companies flatter, but also more bureaucratic
en.summary: As AI slashes the cost of monitoring and data analysis, companies are flattening their management hierarchies while simultaneously extending rules into every daily detail. While headquarters gain real-time visibility over operations, front-line workers face a barrage of automated checks and daily tasks, which risks suppressing worker initiative and choking off business exploration.
en.full_summary:
The Hidden Cost of Cheaper Oversight
Large companies traditionally relied on a human chain of supervisors and managers to enforce rules and check compliance, a process naturally limited by time and labor costs. However, recent deployments of AI tools in chains like Xushengji, Yiguotang, and Bestore allow companies to automate daily store audits, analyze thousands of operational data points continuously, and catch deviations cheaply.
The Shift from Hierarchy to Micro-Rule
This technological leap creates a paradox of organizational flattening. While fewer managers and shorter approval chains make corporate charts look cleaner, AI bypasses traditional layers to enforce standards directly onto every minute action. What used to be periodic weekly checks turn into relentless daily tasks. Front-line workers must spend their time explaining minor anomalies, leaving less room for local adaptability and proactive problem-solving.
Balancing Control and Exploration
Organizational research shows that while algorithm-driven monitoring can improve baseline execution, heavy-handed digital control often reduces employee initiative and critical feedback. As companies become hyper-efficient at enforcing existing standards, they risk penalizing non-standard yet innovative attempts, ultimately sacrificing long-term adaptability for short-term compliance.

zh.title: AI时代，公司越来越扁平，也越来越官僚
zh.summary: 随着AI大幅降低了监督和数据分析的成本，企业在精简管理层级的同时，也将规章制度延伸到了每一个日常细节。虽然总部获得了实时可视性，但一线员工却面临着源源不断的自动化检查和每日任务，这可能会压制员工的主动性并扼杀商业探索空间。
zh.full_summary:
监督成本降低背后的代价
大企业过去通常依赖层层主管和经理来执行规则、检查合规，这种模式受限于时间和人力成本，本身存在自然的边界。然而，随着徐升记、益禾堂、百果园等连锁品牌开始引入AI工具，企业能够以极低的成本自动化巡店、持续分析海量运营数据并迅速揪出违规行为。
从层级官僚到触角延伸
这种技术跃迁带来了组织扁平化的悖论。虽然管理层级减少、审批链条缩短让公司的组织架构图看起来更清爽，但AI却绕过了传统层级，直接将标准压到每一个细碎的操作上。过去每周一次的核对变成了每日追责的任务，一线员工不得不花大量时间解释异常，从而失去了灵活应变和主动寻找问题的空间。
在控制与探索之间寻找平衡
组织研究表明，算法驱动的监控虽然能提高基础执行力，但过度严密的数字化管控往往会削弱员工的主动建言和责任感。当企业把复制过去、执行标准做到极致时，很可能会将任何创新尝试视为异常，最终为了短期的全面合规而牺牲长期的适应能力。

en.title: Vega C Rocket Launch Delayed to Christmas Due to Late Satellites
en.summary: Italian rocket maker Avio reports that the upcoming Vega C launch has been pushed back to around Christmas. CEO Giulio Ranzo stated during an earnings call that the delay is caused by late satellite deliveries from customers. The mission will carry six spacecraft for Italy's IRIDE Earth observation network.
en.full_summary: According to Avio CEO Giulio Ranzo, speaking during the company's third-quarter earnings call, the third Vega C launch of 2026 has slipped by two to three weeks from its initial early December schedule. The mission will carry six satellites for Italy's IRIDE Earth observation constellation, which were recently delivered to the Guiana Space Centre by air. Ranzo noted that payload delivery delays have repeatedly impacted Avio's launch schedule this year, preventing the company from conducting more than three launches so far. While Avio previously aimed for up to five launches in 2027, Ranzo tempered expectations during the November call, indicating a more gradual increase to four annual flights, dependent on customers meeting their spacecraft delivery timelines.

zh.title: 由于卫星交付延误，织女星C型火箭发射推迟至圣诞节前后
zh.summary: 意大利火箭制造商阿维奥公司表示，即将进行的织女星C型火箭发射已被推迟至圣诞节前后。公司首席执行官吉ulio·兰佐在财报电话会议上指出，延误原因是客户的卫星交付推迟。本次任务将为意大利的IRIDE地球观测网运送六颗航天器。
zh.full_summary: 据阿维奥公司首席执行官吉ulio·兰佐在第三季度财报电话会议上透露，2026年的第三次织女星C型火箭发射时间比原计划的12月初推迟了两到三周。该任务将为意大利的IRIDE地球观测星座运送六颗卫星，这些卫星近期已通过空运运抵法属圭亚那的圭亚那航天中心。兰佐指出，载荷交付延迟今年已经多次打乱了阿维奥的发射计划，导致该公司今年迄今为止只能完成三次发射。虽然阿维奥此前曾计划在2027年实现多达五次发射，但兰佐在11月的会议上调低了预期，暗示将更平稳地过渡到每年四次飞行，前提是客户能够按时交付航天器。

en.title: France launches a new literary prize for works created with AI
en.summary: France has announced the Prix Pascal, a new literary prize that rewards works created in collaboration with artificial intelligence. This comes at a time when the publishing industry is debating the use of AI, especially after an author was dropped from major award shortlists for allegedly using AI secretly. Applicants must openly disclose their tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, and submit a detailed technical file alongside their manuscript.
en.full_summary:
The newly announced Prix Pascal in France aims to embrace AI in literature by rewarding works created in collaboration with artificial intelligence. The initiative arrives amid intense debate sparked by the case of Canadian-Haitian author Thélyson Orélien, whose novel was dropped from multiple prestigious literary awards and his Canadian publisher after he was accused of undisclosed AI use. Chaired by essayist Jacques Attali, the inaugural Pascal Prize invites unpublished authors to submit a French-language text of up to 300,000 characters.

To qualify, participants must be transparent about their tools, explicitly acknowledging whether they used Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT. Furthermore, candidates are required to submit a technical file detailing the specific LLMs or AI agents used, accompanied by a two-page explanation describing 'the seed'—defined as a word, sentence, or number—that originally sparked the creative project.

zh.title: 法国设立全新文学奖，专门奖励借助人工智能创作的作品
zh.summary: 法国宣布设立“帕斯卡奖”，这是一个旨在奖励与人工智能合作创作作品的全新文学奖。此前，出版界正围绕AI写作展开激烈争论，起因是一位作家因被指控秘密使用AI而被各大文学奖项候选名单除名。该奖项要求参赛者必须公开承认自己使用了ChatGPT或Claude等工具，并随手稿提交一份详细的技术档案。
zh.full_summary:
法国新设立的帕斯卡奖旨在接纳AI在文学创作中的应用，专门奖励与人工智能合作完成的作品。此前，出版界刚刚经历了一场巨大风波：加拿大海地裔作家泰利森·奥雷利恩因被指控未公开使用AI写作，其小说被多家知名文学奖项除名，并遭到加拿大出版商解约。在这一背景下，由散文家雅克·阿塔利担任评委会主席的帕斯卡奖应运而生，邀请从未出版过作品的作者提交长达30万字符的法语文本。

为了符合参评资格，参赛者必须保持透明，明确承认自己使用了Claude、Gemini或ChatGPT等工具。此外，候选人还必须提交一份技术文件，详细说明所使用的大语言模型或AI智能体，并附上一份两页的说明，解释最初灵感来源的“种子”，即触发整个创作项目的某个词、某句话或某个数字。

en.title: Transient beta oscillations precede voluntary movement stopping in rats
en.summary: Researchers have discovered that a single beta wave cycle occurs in the motor cortex about 200 milliseconds before a rat voluntarily stops running. Previous studies struggled to pin down this timing because traditional tests had hidden stopping times. The team also found that while this brain signal clearly indicates a plan to stop, it is not reliable enough for real-time action decoding.
en.full_summary:
Background
Brain wave activity known as beta oscillations has long been linked to how we control and inhibit movement, but scientists have struggled to pin down their exact timing relative to when a movement actually stops. This confusion largely stems from traditional testing methods where the exact moment of stopping is hidden or covert.
Details
To clear this up, researchers recorded 32-electrode brain activity alongside the running speed of head-fixed rats as they stopped running on a treadmill. They observed that a single beta wave cycle reliably occurs in the left motor cortex about 200 milliseconds before the rat stops. Using information theory, the study shows that beta power holds clues about future speed, but only when the animal is actively planning to stop. When researchers artificially added small amounts of time jitter to mimic older testing methods, this clear brain-action link completely broke down.
Impact
Using machine learning, the team demonstrated that despite being a clear biological marker of stopping, this specific beta oscillation has limited practical use for real-time decoding of actions. This work proposes a fresh conceptual model for how the brain controls the physical stopping of actions.

zh.title: 大鼠主动停止运动前会出现短暂的脑电波beta振荡
zh.summary: 研究人员发现，在大鼠主动停下跑步前大约 200 毫秒，其运动皮层会出现一个单一的beta波周期。以往的研究很难确定这个时间点，是因为传统测试中的停止时间是隐藏的。研究团队还发现，虽然这个脑电信号能明确反映出停止计划，但它用于实时动作解码并不靠谱。
zh.full_summary:
背景
被称为beta振荡的脑电波活动长期以来一直被认为与身体如何控制和抑制运动有关，但科学家们一直难以搞清楚它们与实际停止运动的精确时间关系。这种混乱主要源于传统的测试方法，在那些测试中，具体的停止时刻是隐藏的或无法直接观测的。
细节
为了弄清这一点，研究人员记录了头部被固定的大鼠在跑步机上停止跑步时的 32 电极脑电活动，以及它们的跑步速度。他们观察到，在老鼠停下之前大约 200 毫秒，其左侧运动皮层会稳定出现一个单一的beta波周期。通过信息论分析，研究表明beta波的强度包含有关未来速度的信息，但前提是动物正在积极计划停止。当研究人员故意加入微小的时间抖动来模拟旧的测试方法时，这种清晰的脑-行动关系便彻底失效了。
影响
利用机器学习方法，研究团队证明，尽管这种特定的beta振荡是停止运动的清晰生物学标志，但它在实时动作解码方面的实际应用价值相当有限。这项工作为大脑如何控制动作的物理停止提供了一个全新的概念模型。

en.title: Coherus cuts 30% of workforce to focus on esophageal cancer drug trials
en.summary: Coherus Oncology is cutting 30% of its workforce as it narrows its clinical focus primarily onto esophageal cancer. The decision follows early-stage trial data showing strong anti-tumor activity when combining its experimental antibody tagmokitug with its approved drug Loqtorzi, prompting the company to reduce costs and extend its cash runway.
en.full_summary:
Coherus Oncology announced a 30% reduction in its workforce as the company scales back its broader cancer pipeline to focus specifically on esophageal indications for its investigational combination therapy.

Last month, Coherus reported phase 1b data for the combination of tagmokitug, a CCR8-targeting antibody, and its approved PD-1 blocker Loqtorzi. According to the company, the combination demonstrated a confirmed overall response rate of 75% in front-line esophageal squamous cell carcinoma patients, regardless of PD-L1 status. Chief Medical Officer Rosh Dias stated that the data suggest regulatory T cells are a critical driver of resistance, and that tagmokitug enhances PD-1 activity.

To align with this narrowed strategy, Chief Financial Officer Bryan McMichael reported that the workforce reduction and pipeline narrowing will lower core cash burn by $6 million to $7 million quarterly over the next two quarters. The company reported third-quarter revenue of $14 million for Loqtorzi, its FDA-approved treatment for nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and ended September with $83.6 million in cash. Coherus plans to maintain selected other trials, including a phase 1b study with Johnson & Johnson and an ongoing phase 2 trial in liver cancer, while aiming for financial self-sufficiency.

zh.title: Coherus 裁员 30% 以集中资源研发食管癌联合疗法
zh.summary: 由于将研发重点转向食管癌，生物制药公司 Coherus Oncology 宣布裁员 30%。此前公布的早期临床数据显示，其试验性抗体与已获批药物联合使用对多种实体瘤表现出积极的抗肿瘤活性，促使该公司通过精简管线来降低现金消耗。
zh.full_summary:
生物制药公司 Coherus Oncology 宣布将裁员 30%，并将其癌症治疗研发管线收窄，集中精力推进试验性联合疗法在食管癌领域的适应症。

上个月，Coherus 公布了其靶向 CCR8 的抗体 tagmokitug 与已获批的 PD-1 抑制剂 Loqtorzi 联合治疗的 1b 期数据。据该公司称，该联合疗法在一线食管鳞状细胞癌患者中显示出 75% 的确认客观缓解率，且与 PD-L1 状态无关。公司首席医疗官 Rosh Dias 表示，这些数据表明调节性 T 细胞是耐药性的关键驱动因素，而 tagmokitug 能够增强 PD-1 的活性。

为了配合这一战略调整，首席财务官 Bryan McMichael 表示，精简组织和缩小研发范围将在未来两个季度内使核心现金消耗每季度减少 600 万至 700 万美元。该公司公布其用于鼻咽癌的获批药物 Loqtorzi 第三季度收入为 1400 万美元，截至 9 月底账面现金为 8360 万美元。Coherus 计划在保持部分其他早期试验的同时，通过战略聚焦走上财务自给自足的道路。

en.title: AbCellera drops its OX40 drug program following industry-wide setbacks
en.summary: AbCellera announced it will stop developing its experimental autoimmune drug ABCL575 after completing an early-stage trial. Although the drug met its primary safety goals, the company pointed to broader industry challenges in the OX40 drug class. Several major drug developers have recently scaled back or cancelled similar programs due to safety concerns or modest clinical benefits.
en.full_summary:
Background
AbCellera was developing ABCL575, an antibody targeting the OX40 ligand intended to treat atopic dermatitis and other autoimmune conditions. While its phase 1 trial successfully met tolerability and pharmacokinetic goals, the company decided not to advance the candidate past this initial stage, citing external developments across the entire OX40 drug class.
Industry Context
The broader OX40 class has faced significant hurdles recently. Earlier in the year, Kyowa Kirin and Amgen halted clinical studies for rocatinlimab due to emerging malignancy concerns. Subsequently, Sanofi scrapped regulatory submission plans for amlitelimab, conceding it offered no meaningful therapeutic improvement despite originating from an expensive $1.1 billion acquisition. Conversely, some developers like Inhibrx Biosciences remain optimistic, reporting positive early results for cancer immunotherapy combinations.
Pipeline Shift
With the OX40 program shelved, AbCellera is shifting its internal focus toward other pipeline assets. Its lead candidate is now ABCL635, an NK3 receptor-targeting antibody for menopausal hot flashes, which recently achieved a phase 2 success and is positioned as a potential non-hormonal therapy competing with existing commercial options.

zh.title: 由于行业接连受挫，AbCellera 放弃开发 OX40 药物
zh.summary: AbCellera 宣布在完成早期临床试验后，将停止开发其自身免疫性疾病实验药物 ABCL575。尽管该药达到了预期的安全性目标，但该公司指出这是由于 OX40 药物赛道面临行业大环境的挑战。近期，多家大型药企因安全隐患或疗效提升有限，纷纷缩减或取消了同类研发项目。
zh.full_summary:
背景与决策
AbCellera 曾推进一款靶向 OX40 配体的抗体药物 ABCL575，用于治疗特应性皮炎及其他自身免疫性疾病。虽然其一期临床试验顺利达到了耐受性和药代动力学目标，但该公司评估外部同类药物的发展形势后，决定不再推进该候选药物进入后续阶段。
行业困境
近期整个 OX40 药物赛道遭遇了挫折。今年早些时候，协和麒麟与安进合作的疗法因潜在的肿瘤风险叫停了临床试验；随后，赛诺菲也放弃了将另一款同类抗体提交监管审批的计划，承认其无法带来有意义的疗效提升。不过，仍有部分企业在肿瘤免疫领域公布了积极的早期联合治疗数据。
业务调整
在搁置 OX40 项目的同时，AbCellera 将重心转向了其他管线。其核心候选药物 ABCL635 是一款靶向 NK3 受体的非激素类潮热治疗药物，此前在二期临床中取得了积极进展，正试图在现有的市场竞争中形成差异化优势。

en.title: Experts fear Treasury's proposed China biotech investment ban will backfire on U.S. leadership
en.summary: The U.S. Treasury's proposed rules to restrict outbound investments in China's biopharma sector have sparked intense concern among industry leaders and legal experts. While Washington aims to protect national and economic security, critics like RA Capital's Peter Kolchinsky warn that the vague regulations—particularly around joint ventures—will blind U.S. investors, cripple domestic innovation, and inadvertently hand a competitive advantage to European and Chinese rivals.
en.full_summary:
The Proposed Rules and Industry Anxiety
The U.S. Department of the Treasury released a 163-page draft policy detailing how it plans to implement the COINS Act, which seeks to add pharmaceutical compounds to an outbound investment blacklist. While traditional cash-based licensing deals remain untouched, the proposal places ambiguous restrictions on equity investments, co-development deals, and joint ventures involving Chinese entities, leaving biopharma executives and trade attorneys struggling to define compliant behavior.
The Threat of a 'Flying Blind' Strategy
Industry heavyweights, including a coalition of prominent healthcare investors led by RA Capital, argue that the rules will backfire. By barring U.S. investors and drugmakers from engaging in equity and co-commercialization structures in China, American firms will lose vital visibility into the global clinical pipeline. Critics warn that European investors and multinational pharmaceutical companies—unbound by these strict rules—will scoop up promising Chinese assets, leaving U.S. players at a severe disadvantage.
The 'Joint Venture' Riddle and Economic Security
A major source of confusion is the Treasury's lack of a clear legal definition for 'joint ventures,' which threatens popular models like U.S.-based 'NewCos' formed around Chinese-licensed assets. Legal experts note that the broad scope reflects a shifting political reality where economic security is treated as national security. Although the industry is pushing for narrower definitions focused strictly on bioweapons or select agents, analysts suggest that policymakers are determined to protect U.S. technological leadership across the board, regardless of the compliance burden and potential chilling effect on cross-border R&D.

zh.title: 专家警告：美国财政部限制对华生物技术投资的提案或将适得其反
zh.summary: 美国财政部关于限制对华生物医药领域对外投资的拟议规则，引发了业内领袖和法律专家的广泛担忧。尽管华盛顿的初衷是维护国家和经济安全，但以RA Capital的彼得·科尔钦斯基为首的批评者警告称，这些含糊不清的规定（尤其是关于合资企业的条款）将蒙蔽美国投资者的双眼，削弱本土创新能力，并无意中将竞争优势拱手让给欧洲和中国对手。
zh.full_summary:
拟议规则与行业焦虑
美国财政部发布了一份长达163页的政策草案，详细阐述了如何实施《全面对外投资国家安全法》（COINS法案），该法案旨在将“药物化合物”列入对外投资黑名单。虽然传统的现金许可交易暂不受影响，但该提案对涉及中国实体的股权投资、共同开发协议以及合资企业施加了含糊不清的限制，这让生物医药高管和贸易律师在界定合规行为时陷入困境。
“盲目飞行”的战略威胁
包括由RA Capital领导的一批知名医疗健康投资者在内的行业重量级人物争辩称，这些规则将适得其反。通过禁止美国投资者和药企在中国参与股权和共同商业化结构，美国公司将失去对全球临床管线的关键洞察力。批评人士警告称，不受这些严格规则约束的欧洲投资者和跨国制药公司将抢购中国优质资产，从而令美国企业处于严重劣势。
“合资企业”谜题与经济安全
引发困惑的一个主要原因是财政部对“合资企业”缺乏清晰的法律定义，这威胁到了围绕中国授权资产建立的美国本土“新公司（NewCo）”等热门模式。法律专家指出，其广泛的适用范围反映了一个正在转变的政治现实，即经济安全已被视为国家安全。尽管业界正敦促将范围缩小至生物武器或特定病原体，但分析人士认为，决策者决心全面保护美国的领先技术地位，而较少顾及合规负担以及对跨境研发可能造成的冷却效应。

en.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: GS Caltex uses Amazon SageMaker Canvas and Pipelines to connect process engineers' models to production workflows. This integration allows ML engineers to deploy models within a few hours instead of a week, significantly lowering inference costs by running batch predictions every 30 minutes.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

GS Caltex, a South Korean energy and chemical company, divides AI model development between process engineers and machine learning engineers. Process engineers build and validate models visually in Amazon SageMaker Canvas without writing code. Meanwhile, ML engineers configure Amazon SageMaker Pipelines for deployment and scheduled inference.

To bridge the gap between development and production, GS Caltex automated the handoff process. ML engineers previously spent about a week on integration tasks like setting data paths and connecting preprocessing jobs. With the new automated setup, they can deploy models within a few hours. The company now runs batch inference every 30 minutes, which eliminates the need to keep costly real-time prediction endpoints running continuously and lowers overall costs.

zh.title: 韩国GS Caltex如何用亚马逊云科技实现AI模型快速上线
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：韩国能源公司GS Caltex利用亚马逊云科技的工具，把工程师在可视化界面里做好的AI模型直接连到了生产线上。现在他们部署模型只需要几个小时，而过去得花上一周时间，通过每30分钟跑一次批量预测，还大大省下了运行成本。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

韩国能源和化工巨头GS Caltex将AI模型的开发和运维分成了两部分：懂业务的工程师负责在可视化工具里直接建模，而机器学习工程师则负责用流水线工具把模型推向生产。

过去，把开发好的模型搬到生产环境需要繁琐的手工配置，光是连数据、配环境就要花掉大约一周时间。通过自动化改造，GS Caltex让工程师们能在几个小时内搞定模型部署。他们现在每30分钟自动跑一次批量预测，不用再长期开着高成本的实时服务器，省下了不少钱。

en.title: Google Research releases Antigravity teamwork and Gemini 4 for scientific problem solving
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google Research reports recent results from Antigravity's teamwork multiagent systems combined with Gemini 4 models, which tackle complex problems across mathematics, computer science, and engineering. According to Google, these tools pair parallel generation with dedicated verifiers to bridge the gap in model predictability and partition context to maintain multi-day task accuracy. Google is making these agentic tools available externally to researchers and developers.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

Background and Design
Google Research details the design and applications of Antigravity's teamwork multiagent systems, built on top of various Gemini models including Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen. Frontier research requires navigating vast literature, building computational pipelines, and verifying every step. To address the unreliability of single model generations and the loss of context in multi-day tasks, teamwork uses parallel exploration paired with dedicated falsifiers like Lean 4 proof checkers and execution simulators, while partitioning context across specialized agents.
Scientific and Engineering Results
According to Google, teams across Google and academic institutions used these multi-agent workflows to solve long-standing open problems. In mathematics and theoretical computer science, researchers proved the 2013 Courtade–Kumar conjecture, resolved a 2014 open question in adaptive data analysis, and formalized complex proofs in Lean 4, including the Weil conjectures and parts of the Navier–Stokes equations. In systems software and hardware engineering, the tools were used to build the FarArray low-latency kernel-bypass system, rewrite large codebases like the Zircon microkernel and libgav1 into safe Rust, and optimize TPU kernels, yielding significant performance gains over manual implementations.
Availability
Google states that these features, along with the /boost command and Deep Review document evaluation tools, are currently available in Antigravity. Additionally, Google has opened applications providing 10,000 academic researchers with six months of free access to their highest usage tier.

zh.title: 谷歌研究院发布 Antigravity teamwork 与 Gemini 4 用于攻克科学难题
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：谷歌研究院公布了 Antigravity teamwork 多智能体系统结合 Gemini 4 模型 的最新成果，用于攻克数学、计算机科学和工程领域的复杂难题。据谷歌称，这些工具将并行生成与专用验证器相结合，解决了模型预测不准的问题，并通过隔离上下文来维持多天任务的准确性。谷歌正向研究人员和开发者外部开放这些智能体工具。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

背景与系统设计
谷歌研究院详细介绍了 Antigravity teamwork 多智能体系统的设计与应用，该系统基于 Gemini 4 Argon、Carbon 和 Hydrogen 等多种模型构建。前沿研究需要查阅大量文献、构建计算流水线并验证每个步骤。为了解决单次模型生成的不确定性以及长周期任务中的上下文丢失问题，teamwork 采用了并行探索与专用验证器（如 Lean 4 证明检查器和执行模拟器）相结合的方式，同时将上下文分配给不同的专业智能体进行隔离处理。
科学与工程成果
据谷歌称，谷歌及学术机构的团队利用这些多智能体工作流解决了多个长期存在的开放性难题。在数学和理论计算机科学领域，研究人员证明了 2013 年的 Courtade–Kumar 猜想，解决了自 2014 年以来在自适应数据分析中悬而未决的问题，并在 Lean 4 中形式化了复杂的数学证明，包括韦伊猜想以及纳维-斯托克斯方程的部分内容。在系统软件和硬件工程方面，这些工具被用于构建 FarArray 低延迟内核旁路系统，将 Zircon 微内核和 libgav1 等大型代码库重写为安全的 Rust 语言，并优化了 TPU 内核，相比手写实现取得了显著的性能提升。
获取方式
谷歌表示，这些功能以及 /boost 命令和 Deep Review 文档评估工具目前已在 Antigravity 中上线。此外，谷歌还开放了申请通道，向 10,000 名学术研究人员提供为其六个月的最高使用层级免费访问权限。

en.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's Dots agents buy things for you
en.summary: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT Wallet for its US Pro subscribers, allowing its Dots AI agents to make online purchases. The system uses biometric verification for every transaction and generates payment tokens so your actual credit card details are never shared. In the future, OpenAI plans to let users fully delegate purchases by setting strict limits and pre-approval rules.
en.full_summary:
Background and Rollout
OpenAI is expanding its Dots AI agents platform, introduced earlier this year, by adding a dedicated payment tool called ChatGPT Wallet. The feature is rolling out to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are 18 and older, requiring a US billing address and eligible major credit cards from American Express, Chase, Mastercard, and Visa.
Security and Privacy
OpenAI reports that users must add a card to the wallet, after which Dots agents can initiate purchases based on user prompts. However, the agent must check in with the user before finalizing any transaction. Every purchase requires a security check using biometric verification, such as Face ID or a fingerprint scan. Similar to Apple Pay or Google Wallet, the system replaces actual credit card details with a payment token, meaning card numbers are hidden from both the AI agent and the merchant.
Future Plans and Limitations
Looking ahead, OpenAI expects users to eventually fully delegate purchases to their agents by defining parameters like spending limits, approved categories, or specific timeframes. However, practical hurdles remain. Some retailers restrict or block AI agents entirely, similar to how Amazon blocked Meta's Muse agents earlier this year. OpenAI notes that online stores must update their websites, payment gateways, and risk systems to accommodate legitimate agent purchases and prevent accidental blocking.

zh.title: ChatGPT 钱包让 OpenAI 的 Dots 智能体帮你买东西
zh.summary: OpenAI 正在面向美国 Pro 订阅用户推出 ChatGPT 钱包，允许其 Dots 智能体代为进行网上购物。该系统对每笔交易都进行 生物特征验证，并通过生成支付令牌来确保不泄露真实的信用卡信息。未来，OpenAI 计划允许用户通过设定严格的额度和预批规则来 完全委托智能体 进行购买。
zh.full_summary:
背景与推出
OpenAI 正在为其今年早些时候推出的 Dots 智能体平台添加一项名为 ChatGPT 钱包 的专属支付工具。该功能开始向美国 18 岁及以上的 ChatGPT Pro 订阅用户推送，需要美国账单地址以及符合条件的美国运通、大通、万事达和维萨主流信用卡。
安全与隐私
OpenAI 表示，用户将卡片添加至钱包后，Dots 智能体便能根据用户的指令发起购买，但在结账前必须先 同用户确认。每一笔交易都需要通过面容 ID 或指纹扫描等生物特征验证进行安全检查。类似于苹果或谷歌钱包，该系统会将实际的信用卡信息替换为 支付令牌，这意味着智能体和商家都无法看到用户的真实卡号。
未来规划与限制
展望未来，OpenAI 预计用户最终能够通过设定消费额度、购买类别或时间段等参数，完全把购买任务交托 给智能体。不过，实际落地仍面临阻力。部分零售商对 AI 智能体施加了限制甚至全面封禁，正如亚马逊今年早些时候屏蔽了 Meta 的 Muse 智能体一样。OpenAI 指出，电商网站必须更新其网站、支付和风控系统，以 识别合法的智能体购买 并避免被误拦截。

en.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
en.summary: This tutorial shows how to use SimReady robot assets and AI agents to set up a pick-and-place task in Isaac Sim. It explains how to download pre-configured robot arms and objects, assemble them, and test their movements for physics and collision accuracy before running the simulation.
en.full_summary:
The walkthrough outlines a step-by-step process for building a beverage can pick-and-place simulation using the UR17G arm, Robotiq 2F-140 gripper, and a soda can within Isaac Sim 6.2. According to the text, SimReady Central provides OpenUSD assets equipped with pre-defined simulation properties such as collisions, mass, and joint settings, validated against specific profiles like Robot-Body and Robot-Gripper.

Developers can rely on AI agents combined with Isaac Sim skills to automate tasks, including loading local USD files, inspecting joint limits, assembling the arm and gripper into a single articulation, and generating Python-based movement controls. The guide emphasizes pre-run behavior checks—such as verifying joint settings, testing small arm movements, and confirming that objects rest correctly on work surfaces without falling through—to ensure the virtual robot interacts accurately with its environment.

zh.title: 如何用现成资产和AI在仿真软件里搭建机器人抓取任务
zh.summary: 本教程介绍了如何利用现成的机器人资产和人工智能，在 Isaac Sim 仿真软件中快速搭建一个抓取放置任务。文章详细讲解了如何下载配置好的机械臂和物体模型、完成组装，并在运行仿真前测试它们的物理和碰撞表现，帮助开发者省去繁琐的底层调试工作。
zh.full_summary:
准备与资产下载
本文详细展示了如何在 Isaac Sim 6.2 中使用 UR17G 机械臂、Robotiq 2F-140 夹爪和饮料罐模型，搭建一个完整的抓取放置仿真任务。据介绍，Hugging Face 上的 SimReady Central 平台提供了带有物理属性（如碰撞、质量和关节设置）的 OpenUSD 资产，并通过了相应的规范验证，省去了开发者从头配置物理参数的麻烦。
组装与AI辅助控制
开发者可以借助支持 Isaac Sim 技能的 AI 代理来简化工作。通过输入特定提示词，代理能够自动加载本地的 USD 文件、检查关节极限、将机械臂与夹爪组装成一个整体，并编写控制脚本。教程强调在运行正式抓取前，必须先测试关节运动和接触反应，确保物体不会直接穿透工作台。
仿真局限性说明
文章最后指出，当前的仿真设置属于简化模型，例如未对液体晃动或罐体变形进行建模，且抓取力度是通过测试设定的固定值，并未针对真实硬件进行校准。这些测试结果仅适用于当前的脚本化虚拟环境，无法直接保证在真实物理世界或未知物体位置下的运行效果。

en.title: IEEE Spectrum Video Friday Highlights NASA's PROMISE Moon Rover and In-Space Assembly
en.summary: IEEE Spectrum shares its weekly robotics video roundup, featuring NASA's nuclear-powered Moon rover named PROMISE, Boston Dynamics testing wheeled Atlas robots, and DARPA demonstrating automated in-space assembly in orbit.
en.full_summary: This week's IEEE Spectrum robotics video compilation highlights several developments across space and terrestrial robotics. According to the report, NASA plans to send a nuclear-powered rover named PROMISE to the Moon's South Pole, utilizing spare and test-bed hardware from previous Mars missions. In space manufacturing, a Caltech payload under DARPA's NOM4D program successfully assembled a truss structure in orbit using a gantry robot and a reflective mesh. Terrestrially, Boston Dynamics tested a wheeled version of its Atlas humanoid, while Corvus Robotics showcased autonomous inventory drones operating without localized infrastructure at an ASICS distribution center.

zh.title: IEEE Spectrum 视频周报：NASA 计划向月球发射核动力巡视器 PROMISE
zh.summary: IEEE Spectrum 每周机器人视频精选展示了多项进展，其中包括 NASA 计划发射的核动力月球巡视器 PROMISE、波士顿动力测试轮式阿特拉斯机器人，以及 DARPA 在太空中成功进行 自动化太空组装 的演示。
zh.full_summary: 本周的 IEEE Spectrum 机器人视频汇编展示了多项航天与地面机器人的最新进展。报道称，NASA 计划向月球南极发射一台名为 PROMISE 的 核动力巡视器，该车将大量使用此前火星探测任务的备用硬件。在太空制造方面，加州理工学院作为 DARPA NOM4D 项目的一部分，在轨道上成功利用门式机器人 组装了桁架结构 并部署了反射网。在地面应用方面，波士顿动力测试了装有轮子的 Atlas 人形机器人，Corvus Robotics 则展示了在没有定位设施的仓库中自主运行的库存盘点无人机。

en.title: langchain-openai==1.8.0 - Dropping Python 3.10 Support and Adding OpenAIClassifier
en.summary: This update officially stops supporting Python 3.10, requiring users to upgrade to Python 3.11 or newer. It also introduces the new OpenAIClassifier feature to help developers work with the Decisions API more easily.
en.full_summary:
Version Update Details

The langchain-openai maintainers announce the release of version 1.8.0, which includes several key updates for developers building applications with language models. The most notable change is that Python 3.10 support has been dropped because it reached its end-of-life, making Python 3.11 the new minimum requirement. Users staying on older Python environments will automatically stick with the 1.7.x branch.
New Features and Improvements

Beyond environment adjustments, this release introduces the OpenAIClassifier designed for the Generally Available Decisions API. Additionally, the team refreshed internal model profile data to ensure better compatibility and performance with recent updates.

zh.title: langchain-openai==1.8.0 - 停止支持 Python 3.10 并新增分类器
zh.summary: 这次更新正式停止支持 Python 3.10，要求用户将环境升级到 3.11 或更高版本。同时，它带来了一个全新的 OpenAIClassifier 功能，方便开发者更好地使用决策相关接口。
zh.full_summary:
版本更新概览

langchain-openai 团队正式发布了 1.8.0 版本，为使用大语言模型构建应用的开发者带来了一系列更新。最引人注目的变化是，随着 Python 3.10 寿终正寝，官方决定停止支持 Python 3.10，将最低运行环境要求提升到了 Python 3.11。还在使用旧环境的用户将继续停留在 1.7.x 系列版本。
新增功能与优化

除了环境门槛的提高，本次更新还加入了全新的 OpenAIClassifier 功能，专门用于对接官方的决策 API。同时，开发团队也刷新了模型配置数据，以确保与最新模型保持良好的兼容性和表现。

en.title: LangChain Raises $300M Series C at $3B Valuation
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: LangChain announced a $300M Series C funding round led by CapitalG, valuing the company at $3B. The company aims to help enterprises own their intelligence through AI agents and its LangSmith platform, which is already used by over 7,000 organizations.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

LangChain announced that it has raised $300 million in Series C funding at a valuation of $3 billion, led by CapitalG with participation from GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP, and Sapphire Ventures. The company believes that AI agents will transform the economy, and every enterprise will need to control its own intelligence, data, and infrastructure to build competitive advantages.

To capture this market, LangChain highlights its LangSmith platform, which serves over 7,000 organizations—including Fortune 500 enterprises like NVIDIA and Toyota as well as startups like Harvey. LangSmith is structured around three core pillars: Agent Runtime (infrastructure and architecture for running agents), Agent Improvement (testing, monitoring, and automated optimization), and Agent Governance (centralized control over models, tools, and sensitive data). The company also announced an upcoming release event scheduled for Friday, November 20th, to introduce new platform capabilities.

zh.title: LangChain 获得 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值达 30 亿美元
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：AI 开发框架公司 LangChain 宣布获得由 CapitalG 领投的 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，公司估值达到 30 亿美元。他们主打的 LangSmith 平台目前已被超过 7000 家机构采用，旨在帮助企业打造和掌控自己的 AI 智能体。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

LangChain 宣布获得由 CapitalG 领投的 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，新老股东包括 GIC、DFJ Growth、IVP 以及 Sapphire Ventures 等，公司估值达到 30 亿美元。LangChain 认为 AI 智能体将重塑经济，未来每个企业都需要自主掌控其核心智能与数据，从而在竞争中建立优势。

为了支撑这一愿景，LangChain 推出了 LangSmith 平台，目前已有超过 7000 家机构采用，其中包括 NVIDIA、丰田等财富 500 强企业以及 Harvey 等初创公司。LangSmith 的核心功能主要围绕三个支柱：智能体运行环境（提供可靠的底层架构）、智能体优化（支持测试、监控与自动化调优）以及智能体治理（集中管控模型、工具与敏感数据）。此外，该公司预告将于 11 月 20 日（周五）举办发布会，推出更多全新平台功能。

en.title: HHS pumps up to $25M into ibogaine, other psychotropic drugs on Veteran’s Day
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced up to $25 million in funding for ibogaine and other rapid-acting psychotropic drugs to treat serious mental illnesses like PTSD in veterans. Led by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the initiative includes research networks and clinical trial preparations, though ibogaine also carries documented risks of severe cardiac and neurological complications.
en.full_summary:
The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced up to $25 million in investments targeting psychotropic compounds, with a particular focus on the psychedelic substance ibogaine. ARPA-H is allocating up to $4.9 million over five years for investigational medicines addressing PTSD, with subsequent awards slated for substance use disorders. Meanwhile, the National Institute of Mental Health is launching a $20 million funding opportunity for a research network examining treatments like ketamine, psilocybin, and esketamine.

Ibogaine has been a central focus of the Trump administration, supported by an executive order in April aimed at accelerating psychedelic therapies. Researchers note that ibogaine operates through a complex matrix pharmacology rather than a single target. While proponents highlight promising anecdotal and preliminary findings, the compound is also associated with neurotoxic and cardiotoxic risks, with published literature recording 33 deaths following its use as of 2022.

zh.title: 美国卫生与公众服务部在退伍军人节宣布斥资高达 2500 万美元研究伊博格碱及其他精神药物
zh.summary: 美国卫生与公众服务部宣布提供 高达 2500 万美元的资金，用于研究伊博格碱及其他速效精神药物，以治疗退伍军人的创伤后应激障碍等严重精神疾病。在卫生部长罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的推动下，该计划涵盖了 建立研究网络和临床试验筹备工作，不过伊博格碱同时也伴随着严重心脏和神经并发症的已知风险。
zh.full_summary:
美国卫生与公众服务部宣布投入高达 2500 万美元的资金，重点推进迷幻化合物伊博格碱及其他精神药物的研究。美国高级健康研究计划局（ARPA-H）将在五年内拨款高达 490 万美元，用于推进针对创伤后应激障碍等严重精神疾病的试验性药物研究，后续还将资助针对物质使用障碍的项目。同时，国家精神卫生研究所正提供 2000 万美元的资助机会，用于启动一个研究网络，研究氯胺酮、赛洛西宾和艾司氯胺酮等快速起效的干预药物。

伊博格碱一直是美国政府关注的重点，此前曾在 4 月发布行政命令以加速迷幻疗法的开发。研究人员指出，伊博格碱通过复杂的矩阵药理学发挥作用，而非单一靶点。尽管支持者强调了有前景的初步发现，但该化合物同时也伴随着神经毒性和心脏毒性风险，相关已发表文献显示截至 2022 年已有 33 起使用后的死亡记录。

en.title: Release v5.23.0 - New Model Additions and Exporters Update
en.summary: Hugging Face Transformers version 5.23.0 introduces a variety of new multi-modal and language models, including Inkling2, Liquid AI's LFM3, and InternLM3. It also overhauls the model exporters, allowing users to seamlessly export and run models on optimized runtimes like ONNX Runtime and OpenVINO with significant speed improvements.
en.full_summary:
New Model Additions

This release adds support for several prominent model families. Inkling2 is a multi-modal model supporting text and image inputs with a large parameter scale. Liquid AI's LFM3 and LFM3-VL introduce hybrid architectures combining gated short convolutions and grouped-query attention. Other notable additions include IQuestCoder for code generation, Shanghai AI Laboratory's InternLM3 instruction-tuned model, and experimental decision heads like JEV.
Exporters and Backend Runtimes

The update brings a major overhaul to model exports. Every export now returns an ExportedModel, which shares the same API as the original model and can be pushed to the Hub and reloaded. It supports Dynamo, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, and ExecuTorch, with built-in runtime fusions that make decoding significantly faster than standard PyTorch eager execution.
Core Bugfixes and Optimizations

Beyond new models, version 5.23.0 addresses a wide range of issues across vision pipelines, distributed training, attention mechanisms, caching, and audio processing. These include fixing cache correctness in various models, optimizing expert parallelism, and improving overall stability for multi-GPU setups.

zh.title: 版本 v5.23.0 发布 - 引入全新模型支持与导出功能升级
zh.summary: Hugging Face Transformers 5.23.0 版本带来了多款全新的多模态与语言模型，包括 Inkling2、Liquid AI 的 LFM3 以及 InternLM3。同时，该版本大幅升级了模型导出器，让用户能够将模型无缝导出并在 ONNX Runtime 和 OpenVINO 等优化运行时上运行，大幅提升了运行速度。
zh.full_summary:
全新模型加入

本次更新加入了多个重要模型系列的支持。Inkling2 是一种支持文本和图像输入的大规模参数多模态模型。Liquid AI 的 LFM3 与 LFM3-VL 引入了结合门控短卷积与分组查询注意力的混合架构。此外，新增的模型还包括用于代码生成的 IQuestCoder、上海人工智能实验室的 InternLM3 指令微调模型，以及实验性质的决策头 JEV。
导出器与后端运行时

更新对模型导出功能进行了重大重构。现在的每次导出都会返回一个 ExportedModel，它与原模型拥有相同的 API，并且可以推送到 Hub 并重新加载。该功能全面支持 Dynamo、ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO 和 ExecuTorch，内置的运行时融合技术让解码速度远超标准的 PyTorch 急切执行模式。
核心Bug修复与优化

除了新模型，5.23.0 版本还修复了视觉流水线、分布式训练、注意力机制、缓存以及音频处理等多个领域的各种问题。其中包括修复多种模型中的缓存正确性、优化专家并行机制，以及提升多 GPU 设置的整体稳定性。

en.title: 5 food and beverage companies making sustainable packaging changes
en.summary: As regulators and consumers push for less packaging waste, food and beverage companies are making targeted sustainable packaging changes. From Campbell's paper-based clips to PepsiCo's lightweight bottles, these brands are adjusting their materials to improve recyclability and comply with new rules while meeting consumer demand.
en.full_summary:
Food and beverage manufacturers are facing mounting pressure from new extended producer responsibility laws and shifting consumer preferences, leading to practical updates in product packaging.

Several major brands have recently implemented specific material swaps. Campbell's replaced plastic dog bone packaging with a recyclable paper clip for Rao's sauce jars, removed mixed-material layers in its plastic bottles, and added recycled content to its pretzel canisters. PepsiCo reduced its overall plastic use by over 7 million pounds by lightweighting Gatorade and Lipton bottles. Target eliminated carbon-black colorant from its bakery and deli trays to make them more compatible with existing recycling systems. Bel Group swapped the outer cellophane wrap of Babybel cheese for paper to save an estimated 850 metric tons of packaging material annually globally. Meanwhile, Mars partnered with Berry Global to transition large M&M's, Skittles, and Starburst pantry jars to 100 percent post-consumer recycled plastic, aiming to eliminate over 1,300 metric tons of virgin plastic each year.

zh.title: 五家食品饮料巨头正在改造包装以减少浪费
zh.summary: 随着监管和消费者对减少包装垃圾的要求越来越高，食品饮料企业正在进行有针对性的绿色包装改造。从金宝汤的纸质卡扣到百事可乐的轻量化瓶子，各大品牌都在调整材料以提高回收利用率，在顺应新法规的同时迎合消费者的环保需求。
zh.full_summary:
食品和饮料制造商正面临着来自生产者责任延伸法案以及消费者偏好转变的双重压力，这促使企业对产品包装进行切实改进。

多家知名品牌近期推出了具体的材料替换方案。金宝汤用可回收的纸质卡扣替代了塑料固定带，去除了塑料瓶中的混合材料层，并在椒盐卷饼容器中加入了再生塑料成分。百事可乐通过对佳得乐和立顿瓶子进行轻量化设计，将塑料使用量减少了7百万磅以上。塔吉特百货从其烘焙和熟食托盘中去除了炭黑着色剂，使其更容易被现有的回收系统处理。贝勒集团将小贝勒奶酪的外层塑料包装换成了纸质材料，预计每年在全球范围内节省850公吨包装材料。同时，玛氏与Berry Global合作，将M&M's、彩虹糖等大号储藏罐转换为100%消费后再生塑料，旨在每年减少1300多公吨原生塑料的使用。

en.title: llama.cpp reaches v1.0.0, establishing a stable API for local AI development
en.summary: llama.cpp and ggml have released their v1.0.0 versions, marking an important milestone for running artificial intelligence locally across various hardware devices. The project team announces that future updates will strictly follow semantic versioning to protect downstream developers who rely on their libraries for private and cross-platform applications.
en.full_summary:
After three and a half years of growth, the llama.cpp project has become a foundational tool for running multi-modal large language models locally on everything from consumer computers to enterprise servers. With the release of version 1.0.0 for both llama.cpp and its tensor library ggml, the team aims to provide a more reliable foundation for the expanding ecosystem of local AI applications.

To support this growth, the project is establishing strict semantic versioning rules. Any breaking changes to the public C application programming interface will now trigger major version bumps, making interface boundaries clearer for developers who integrate the software into their products. Additionally, the project continues to expand its distribution channels and hardware support, utilizing infrastructure from Hugging Face alongside hardware partnerships with major chipmakers to ensure code quality and broad platform compatibility.

zh.title: llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0 版本，为本地人工智能开发建立稳定接口
zh.summary: 本地大模型运行工具 llama.cpp 及其底层引擎 ggml 正式发布 v1.0.0 版本，标志着在各类硬件上运行人工智能迎来了重要里程碑。开发团队宣布，未来更新将严格遵循语义化版本规范，全力保障下游开发者的接口稳定性。
zh.full_summary:
经过三年半的发展，llama.cpp 已经成为在个人电脑和企业服务器等各类硬件上运行多模态大模型的关键工具。随着 llama.cpp 及其张量库 ggml 正式迈入 1.0.0 时代，开发团队旨在为日益庞大的本地人工智能应用生态提供更加稳固的基础。

为了支撑这种增长，该项目确立了严格的语义化版本控制规则。未来对公开 C 语言接口的任何破坏性改动都将直接提升主版本号，从而向将该软件集成到产品中的开发者明确展示接口边界。此外，该项目正通过扩大分发渠道与硬件支持，借助 Hugging Face 的基础设施以及各大芯片厂商的硬件协作，持续保障代码质量和广泛的平台兼容性。

en.title: Marea Touts Phase 2 Lipid Disorder Win for MAR001
en.summary: Cardiometabolic biotech Marea Therapeutics reports that its drug candidate MAR001 significantly reduced blood fat in a phase 2b study for patients with high triglycerides. The antibody lowered triglycerides by over 70% in patients with very high levels, while showing a side effect rate slightly below the placebo group. CEO Josh Lehrer notes the results are encouraging for patients facing pancreatitis and heart attack risks, with plans to advance further studies and explore potential applications in obesity.
en.full_summary:
Clinical Results
Cardiometabolic biotech Marea Therapeutics, now a subsidiary of Lisata Therapeutics following a September acquisition, released data from the first part of a phase 2b study evaluating its drug candidate MAR001. According to the company, the angiopoietin-like protein 4 (ANGPTL4)-targeting monoclonal antibody reduced triglycerides by 72.2% in patients with levels at or above 500 mg/dL, and by 57.2% in those at or above 300 mg/dL. More than half of the 235 adult patients on MAR001 reached normal triglyceride levels, compared to 3.4% on placebo. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 69.5% of MAR001-treated patients, slightly below the 77.6% rate for the placebo cohort.
Pipeline and Future Plans
Marea CEO Josh Lehrer stated in an interview that the data is encouraging for establishing an optimal treatment for patients facing the dual threat of pancreatitis and cardiovascular risk. The company has already initiated the second part of the mid-stage study involving 100 patients, and plans to take a half-life-extended version called MAR005 into a phase 3 study for severe hypertriglyceridemia. Additionally, Marea is exploring the potential for its pipeline to address obesity and has a candidate named MAR002 in early-stage trials for acromegaly.
Background
The acquisition of Marea followed Lisata's failed deal with Kuva Labs, which resulted in significant workforce reductions. The subsequent merger with Marea involved a stock-for-stock transaction backed by a $225 million commitment from investors including Forbion, venBio, and Third Rock Ventures.

zh.title: Marea 公布脂质紊乱药物 MAR001 二期临床积极结果
zh.summary: 心血管代谢生物技术公司 Marea Therapeutics 报告称，其候选药物 MAR001 显着降低了血脂，在一项针对高甘油三酯患者的 2b 期临床研究中取得了成功。该抗体使极高水平患者的 甘油三酯降低了 70% 以上，且不良反应发生率略低于安慰剂组。公司首席执行官 Josh Lehrer 表示，这些结果令人鼓舞，有望帮助患者降低 胰腺炎和心脏病发作风险，未来计划推进后续研究并探索肥胖症领域的应用潜力。
zh.full_summary:
临床结果
心血管代谢生物技术公司 Marea Therapeutics（在 9 月被收购后成为 Lisata Therapeutics 的子公司）公布了其候选药物 MAR001 的 2b 期研究第一部分结果。据该公司称，这种靶向血管生成素样蛋白 4（ANGPTL4）的单克隆抗体使水平在 500 mg/dL 及以上的患者的 甘油三酯降低了 72.2%，而水平在 300 mg/dL 及以上的患者降低了 57.2%。在 235 名成年患者中，超过一半的人在使用 MAR001 后甘油三酯水平恢复正常，而安慰剂组这一比例仅为 3.4%。MAR001 治疗组的治疗中出现的不良事件发生率为 69.5%，略低于安慰剂组的 77.6%。
研发管线与未来计划
Marea 首席执行官 Josh Lehrer 在采访中表示，这些数据对于为面临胰腺炎和心血管风险双重威胁的患者确立最佳治疗方案令人鼓舞。公司已启动该中期研究的第二部分（涉及 100 名患者），并计划将名为 MAR005 的半衰期延长版本推进至针对严重高甘油三酯血症的 三期临床试验。此外，Marea 正在探索其管线应对肥胖症的潜力，并有一款名为 MAR002 的候选药物处于治疗肢端肥大症的早期临床阶段。
背景信息
Marea 的收购是在 Lisata 与 Kuva Labs 的交易告吹之后进行的，当时这导致了大规模裁员。随后与 Marea 的合并包括了一项换股交易，并获得了来自 Forbion、venBio 和 Third Rock Ventures 等投资者总计 2.25 亿美元的资金承诺。

en.title: Delix raises $100M for depression drug without psychedelic trips
en.summary: Delix Therapeutics has secured $100 million in Series C funding to advance zalsupindole, a non-hallucinatory psychedelic therapy designed to treat major depressive disorder. Backed by Johnson & Johnson, the company plans to start a Phase 2b clinical trial in 2027.
en.full_summary:
Background
Delix Therapeutics, a Boston-based biotech born from a University of California lab in 2019, focuses on developing neuroplastogens, a class of drugs aimed at regrowing lost brain connections without causing traditional psychedelic trips.
Details
The newly raised $100 million Series C round was led by J&J's venture arm, with participation from several other investors. The funds will primarily advance its lead oral candidate, zalsupindole, which is based on a naturally occurring compound found in plants and toad secretions. Delix reported positive Phase 1b safety data in healthy volunteers in late 2024 and aims to launch a Phase 2b trial for major depressive disorder in the first half of 2027.
Impact
Beyond depression, the capital will support the pipeline's expansion into other neurological and neurodegenerative conditions, such as schizophrenia and Alzheimer's disease. The deal arrives amid renewed industry momentum, highlighted by recent high-profile acquisitions and regulatory focus on psychedelic-based mental health treatments.

zh.title: Delix 融资 1.05 亿美元研发不产生幻觉的抑郁症药物
zh.summary: Delix Therapeutics 获得了 1 亿美元 C 轮融资，用于推进其用于治疗抑郁症的无幻觉致幻剂疗法 zalsupindole。该公司由强生等机构支持，计划在 2027 年启动 2b 期临床试验。
zh.full_summary:
背景
Delix Therapeutics 是一家总部位于波士顿的生物技术公司，于 2019 年从加州大学实验室孵化而出，专注于开发能够恢复大脑神经连接的“神经塑形剂”，目标是避开传统致幻剂的致幻副作用。
细节
该公司新完成的 1 亿美元 C 轮融资由强生旗下风险投资机构领投，多 家投资方跟进。这笔资金将主要用于推进其核心口服候选药物 zalsupindole，该药物源自植物和蟾蜍分泌物中的天然化合物。Delix 在 2024 年底公布了健康志愿者的 1b 期积极安全数据，并计划在 2027 年上半年针对重度抑郁症启动 2b 期临床试验。
影响
除了抑郁症，这笔资金还将用于支持该技术在精神分裂症和阿尔茨海默病等其他神经系统疾病上的管线拓展。此次融资正值整个行业对精神类药物研发重燃兴趣之际，近期多起巨额收购和政策倾斜正推动该领域加速发展。

en.title: Merck’s MASH drug efinopegdutide succeeds in mid-stage trial
en.summary: Merck reports that its experimental drug efinopegdutide successfully treated MASH (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis) in a mid-stage clinical trial. The drug outperformed a placebo by helping clear the liver disease in over half of the tested patients without worsening liver scarring.
en.full_summary:
Clinical Trial Results
Merck revealed data from its phase 2b trial involving 386 patients with MASH and stage F2 or F3 fibrosis. Participants received one of three doses of efinopegdutide or a placebo for 52 weeks. The trial met its primary endpoint, showing MASH resolution in 56% to 63% of patients across the different doses, compared to 13% for the placebo arm.
Drug Mechanism and Context
Efinopegdutide is a subcutaneously injected co-agonist targeting both GLP-1 and glucagon receptors. Merck included a research arm using Novo Nordisk's semaglutide, where 53% achieved MASH resolution. Merck originally licensed the drug from Hanmi Pharmaceutical in 2020 after it passed through Johnson & Johnson's pipeline.

zh.title: 默沙东脂肪肝新药中期试验取得成功
zh.summary: 默沙东公布了一项中期临床试验结果，其研发的试验性药物efinopegdutide在治疗MASH（代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎）方面取得了显著效果。试验显示，该药物帮助超过半数的患者消除了肝脏炎症，且没有导致肝纤维化恶化。
zh.full_summary:
临床试验结果
默沙东公布了一项针对 386名患者 的2b期临床试验数据。这些患者均患有MASH以及F2或F3期纤维化，他们在52周内接受了三种不同剂量的efinopegdutide或安慰剂治疗。结果显示，在不同剂量组中，有 56%至63% 的患者实现了MASH消除，而安慰剂组这一比例为13%。
药物机制与背景
该药物通过皮下注射发挥作用，能够同时激活 GLP-1和胰高血糖素受体。默沙东在试验中还设立了一个对照组，使用诺和诺德的司美格鲁肽，其MASH消除率为53%。默沙东于2020年从韩美药品公司引进了这款候选药物，该药物最初由强生公司研发。

en.title: Cohere Expands Sovereign AI Platform with AISLE and cubic
en.summary: According to Cohere Blog: Cohere announces the completion of its acquisition of AISLE and the onboarding of the team behind cubic. These additions form the core of Cohere's newly established cybersecurity business and secure coding vertical, aimed at helping enterprises and governments deploy AI while retaining full control over data and infrastructure.
en.full_summary:
According to Cohere Blog:

Background and Acquisitions
Cohere states that organizations increasingly require AI systems that are powerful, secure, and under their control, a concept the company refers to as sovereign AI. To advance this goal, Cohere has completed its acquisition of AISLE, a builder of autonomous systems for vulnerability discovery and remediation, and welcomed the team behind cubic, an AI-powered code review platform. These transactions mark Cohere's fourth and fifth strategic M&A deals this year, following Aleph Alpha and Reliant AI.
Cybersecurity and Prague Hub
Following the acquisition, AISLE co-founders are taking key leadership roles: Ondrej Vlcek becomes Senior Vice President of Cohere Cyber, Jaya Baloo becomes Chief Information Security Officer, and Stanislav Fort becomes Vice President of AI Security. Cohere plans a long-term investment in Prague, establishing the city as its global center for AI cybersecurity and autonomous security systems, leveraging AISLE's expertise to build cyber-resilient AI capabilities.
Secure Coding and Enterprise Scale
Cubic's team, led by founder and CEO Paul Sanglé-Ferrière, brings expertise in AI, security, and developer tools. Their review agents support environments such as on-premises and air-gapped deployments. According to Cohere, this team will establish the company's secure coding vertical, accelerating the integration of enterprise-grade coding and vulnerability remediation capabilities into its platform.

zh.title: Cohere 收购 AISLE 与 cubic，进一步扩展主权 AI 平台
zh.summary: 据Cohere Blog发布的信息：Cohere 宣布完成对 AISLE 的收购，并迎来了 cubic 团队的加入。这两项举措旨在建立全新的网络安全业务和安全编程垂直领域，帮助企业和政府在保持对数据和基础设施完全控制的同时部署人工智能。
zh.full_summary:
据Cohere Blog发布的信息：

背景与收购动作
Cohere 表示，企业和政府在部署人工智能时越来越需要兼顾强大性能与绝对控制权，即所谓的“主权 AI”。为此，Cohere 宣布完成对漏洞自动发现与修复系统构建商 AISLE 的收购，并吸纳了 AI 代码审查平台 cubic 的团队。这是 Cohere 今年继 Aleph Alpha 和 Reliant AI 之后的又一批战略并购。
网络安全与布拉格研发中心
收购完成后，AISLE 的联合创始人将担任核心领导职务：Ondrej Vlcek 担任 Cohere Cyber 高级副总裁，Jaya Baloo 担任首席信息安全官，Stanislav Fort 担任 AI 安全副总裁。Cohere 计划在布拉格进行长期投资，将该市打造成全球 AI 网络安全与自主安全系统中心，利用其专业知识构建具备韧性的 AI 防御能力。
企业级安全编程
由创始人兼 CEO Paul Sanglé-Ferrière 领导的 cubic 团队在 AI、安全和开发者工具领域拥有丰富经验，其代码审查代理支持本地部署和隔离环境。据 Cohere 称，该团队将负责建立公司的安全编程垂直领域，加速将企业级代码审查和漏洞修复能力整合到其平台中。

en.title: Regeneron's antibody curbs POTS heart rate spikes in mid-stage trial
en.summary: Regeneron announced that its experimental monoclonal antibody, baloncibart, met its primary goal in a Phase 2 trial for postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, a chronic condition with no FDA-approved treatments. Patients receiving a single high dose experienced a mean drop in heart rate of 11.4 beats per minute compared to placebo, paving the way for a Phase 3 study planned for early 2027.
en.full_summary:
Clinical Trial Results
Regeneron reported data from its Phase 2 Pinnacle trial evaluating baloncibart, also known as REGN7544, in 82 patients with postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS). Patients receiving a 450-mg injection experienced a mean drop in heart rate of 11.4 beats per minute compared to placebo at day eight, while a 150-mg dose reduced heart rate by 9.5 beats per minute. The high-dose group also showed sustained heart rate reductions and reported improvements in physical functioning at day 29.
Mechanism and Development
POTS is a chronic autonomic nervous system disorder associated with lightheadedness and fatigue, with no currently approved treatments. Baloncibart is an NPR1-blocking monoclonal antibody designed to increase blood volume in circulation. Regeneron plans to launch a Phase 3 study in the first half of 2027, building on this mid-stage success.

zh.title: 再生元抗体药物在临床试验中成功抑制体位性心动过速综合征的心率飙升
zh.summary: 再生元宣布其研发的单克隆抗体药物 baloncibart 在针对体位性心动过速综合征的二期临床试验中达到了主要目标，该病目前尚无 FDA 批准的治疗药物。与安慰剂相比，接受单次高剂量注射的患者心率平均下降了每分钟 11.4 次，为计划在 2027 年上半年开展的三期试验铺平了道路。
zh.full_summary:
临床试验结果
再生元公布了二期 Pinnacle 试验的数据，该试验评估了 baloncibart（又称 REGN7544）对 82 名体位性心动过速综合征（POTS）患者的疗效。在第 8 天，接受 450 毫克注射的患者与安慰剂相比，心率平均下降了每分钟 11.4 次，而 150 毫克剂量的降幅为每分钟 9.5 次。高剂量组在第 29 天时仍保持了显著的心率下降，并在身体机能方面报告了改善。
作用机制与开发计划
POTS 是一种与头晕和疲劳相关的慢性自主神经系统疾病，目前尚无获批疗法。baloncibart 是一种阻断 NPR1 的单克隆抗体，旨在增加循环中的血液容量。基于此次二期试验的成功，再生元计划在 2027 年上半年启动三期临床研究。

en.title: Robot Talk: Making robots work reliably in high-risk environments
en.summary: In this podcast episode, Claire chats with robotics engineer Daniela Shchegelskaya about getting robots to work reliably outside the lab. They discuss using Boston Dynamics' Spot robot for inspections in live power substations, focusing on tackling tough challenges like network connectivity and system safety in high-risk environments.
en.full_summary:
Real-World Challenges
Daniela Shchegelskaya, an engineer from the University of Twente, shares her work on moving autonomous robots from controlled labs into unpredictable real-world settings. She highlights that reliability, connectivity, and system-level design are the biggest hurdles when deploying machines where failure is not an option.
Substation Inspections
At Elimpus, Shchegelskaya focuses on integrating Boston Dynamics' Spot robot to inspect live power substations. This involves enabling autonomous navigation, remote diagnostics, and data collection in environments with heavy electromagnetic interference and strict safety requirements.

zh.title: 机器人播客：如何让机器人在高风险环境中稳定工作
zh.summary: 在这期播客节目中，主持人克莱尔与机器人工程师达尼埃拉探讨了如何让机器人在实验室之外稳定可靠地工作。他们讨论了如何利用波士顿动力的 Spot 机器人进行带电变电站巡检，重点关注在危险环境中解决网络连接和系统安全等棘手难题。
zh.full_summary:
现实世界的挑战
来自特文特大学的工程师达尼埃拉在节目中分享了她关于如何将自主机器人从可控实验室推向不可预测的现实环境的工作。她强调，当把机器部署到不容出错的场所时，可靠性、网络连接和系统级设计是最大的门槛。
变电站巡检应用
在 Elimpus 公司，达尼埃拉专注于集成波士顿动力的 Spot 机器人，用于带电变电站的日常巡检。这需要在电磁干扰大、安全要求极高的环境中实现自主导航、远程诊断和数据采集。

en.title: Biopharma industry looks beyond GLP-1s for next-gen weight loss treatments
en.summary: At the ObesityWeek 2026 conference, biopharma companies are shifting attention beyond standard GLP-1 drugs to explore new pathways like amylin modulation. Industry experts emphasize that the next generation of weight loss therapies will focus heavily on improving treatment persistence and the quality of weight reduction, particularly preserving muscle mass.
en.full_summary:
Amylin Pipeline Competition
As existing GLP-1 treatments like Wegovy and Zepbound face challenges regarding side effects and plateauing results, amylin analogs are emerging as a primary alternative. Companies such as Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly, and a partnership between Roche and Zealand Pharma are showcasing data for their pipeline assets, balancing higher efficacy against tolerability trade-offs.
Muscle Preservation and Quality
Beyond raw weight loss numbers, companies are prioritizing body composition. Biohaven and Wave Life Sciences are presenting data on therapies designed to target myostatin and INHBE proteins, aiming to reduce fat while preserving lean muscle, addressing a major drawback of current incretin drugs.
Persistence and Long-Term Value
Industry leaders note that roughly half of patients drop out of treatment within six months. Presentations at the conference, including Rhythm Pharmaceuticals' long-term data, highlight the growing importance of treatment durability and persistence in determining the true commercial and clinical value of obesity therapeutics.

zh.title: 减肥药迎来新变局：医药巨头齐聚年会，探索超越GLP-1的新疗法
zh.summary: 在 2026 年肥胖症学术大会上，各大生物医药公司开始将目光投向标准的 GLP-1 药物之外，重点探索胰淀素调节等全新靶点。行业专家指出，新一代减肥疗法将更加关注提高患者依从性以及减脂质量，特别是如何在线上减重的同时保住肌肉。
zh.full_summary:
胰淀素靶点的激烈角逐
随着现有的 Wegovy 和 Zepbound 等 GLP-1 药物面临副作用和减重瓶颈，胰淀素类似物正成为各大药企争夺的下一个热门靶点。诺和诺德、礼来以及罗氏与 Zealand Pharma 的合作项目都在会上展示了各自管线的最新数据，在追求更高疗效的同时，也面临着耐受性等安全权衡。
肌肉保护与减脂质量
除了单纯的体重下降数字，生物医药行业开始高度关注身体成分的改善。Biohaven 和 Wave Life Sciences 等公司正在展示针对肌肉生长抑制素等靶点的疗法，旨在在减少脂肪的同时保留肌肉，以此解决现有肠促胰岛素药物的一个主要痛点。
治疗依从性与长期价值
行业专家指出，大约有一半的患者在接受减肥治疗六个月内会选择放弃。本次会议上 Rhythm Pharmaceuticals 等公司带来的长期数据表明，治疗的持久性和患者依从性，正成为评估肥胖症疗法商业潜力和临床价值的关键指标。

en.title: How Dyania Health's AI speeds up patient chart reviews in hospitals
en.summary: According to NVIDIA Generative AI: Dyania Health built Synapsis AI, a clinical reasoning engine that processes decades of unstructured patient records inside hospital firewalls. By using NVIDIA technology, the system connects years of medical notes to automate chart reviews, helping clinicians quickly identify patients who need attention while keeping all data secure on-site.
en.full_summary:
According to NVIDIA Generative AI:

How Synapsis AI Works
Hospitals accumulate vast amounts of patient history in free-text formats like physician notes and operative reports. Dyania Health developed Synapsis AI to read across these scattered documents, connecting findings from years apart to answer complex clinical questions and surface actionable signals for care teams.
Security and Local Processing
To protect patient privacy, Synapsis AI operates entirely on NVIDIA-accelerated computing inside the health system's firewall. The platform is trained using NVIDIA NeMo libraries and optimized via TensorRT, allowing hospitals to process records onsite without sharing sensitive data externally.
Real-World Application at Cleveland Clinic
In a study involving over 7,800 aortic valve replacement patients between 2005 and 2021, Cleveland Clinic utilized Synapsis AI to review historical charts and build predictive models for valve deterioration and reintervention risks. According to the health system, this approach completes manual chart reviews that would otherwise take years, with clinicians retaining final decision-making authority.

zh.title: Dyania Health 用 AI 帮医院快速翻阅病历，缩短患者等候时间
zh.summary: 据NVIDIA Generative AI发布的信息：医疗科技公司 Dyania Health 推出了 Synapsis AI 临床推理引擎，能够直接在医院内部防火墙内处理数十年积累的病历文本。借助英伟达的技术，该系统能够自动进行病历审查，帮助医生快速找出需要关注的患者，同时确保所有敏感医疗数据都安全地留在医院本地。
zh.full_summary:
据NVIDIA Generative AI发布的信息：

Synapsis AI 如何工作
医院里积攒了大量的患者病历，大都以自由文本的形式存在于医生笔记和手术报告中。Dyania Health 开发的 Synapsis AI 能够阅读这些分散的文档，串联多年数据来解答复杂的临床问题，为医护团队提供清晰的参考信号。
数据安全与本地运行
为了保护患者隐私，Synapsis AI 完全运行在医院防火墙内的英伟达加速计算平台上。该平台借助英伟达的工具进行优化，让医院能够在本地处理海量病历，而无需将敏感数据传输到外部。
克利夫兰诊所的实际应用
在克利夫兰诊所涉及 7800 多名主动脉瓣置换患者的研究中，该院利用 Synapsis AI 审查历史病历并构建了预测模型，用来评估瓣膜退化和再次手术的风险。克利夫兰诊所表示，这种方法完成了原本需要人工花费数年才能做完的病历审查工作，同时最终决策权依然掌握在医生手中。

en.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
en.summary: Nvidia’s leadership crisis has sparked concern in Israel, where the company is a major employer and economic driver. While the tech community worries about future commitment to its local operations, venture capitalists believe Jensen Huang’s departure could create a window for competitors to challenge Nvidia’s dominance in the AI chip market.
en.full_summary:
Jensen Huang’s resignation has caused anxiety in Israel, where Nvidia employs around 6,000 people and has deep roots following its 2019 acquisition of Mellanox. Local tech figures note that Huang personally drove the company’s heavy investment in the region, raising questions about whether his successor will maintain the same level of commitment. Interim CEO Colette Kress has deep ties to the region, and Israeli executives like Apple’s Johny Srouji and Nvidia’s Michael Kagan have been floated as potential successors.

Despite the local uncertainty, venture capitalists in Israel view the transition as a potential turning point for the broader AI industry. According to Vertex Ventures Israel General Partner Yanai Oron, slower decisions at Nvidia could give rivals an opening, though a broader slowdown in AI spending remains a risk. Selah Ventures founder Adi Levanon notes that while Huang's departure does not dismantle Nvidia's ecosystem, it might prevent the company from becoming a full-on monopoly, giving alternative chip and inference software developers a chance to prove their economic value.

zh.title: 英伟达高层地震，以色列创投圈嗅到竞争对手的逆袭机会
zh.summary: 英伟达的管理层变动在被视为“第二故乡”的以色列引发担忧，当地投资者和技术人员正密切关注新掌门人是否会动摇对当地的研发投入。不过，当地风投机构认为，失去黄仁勋的英伟达可能会面临决策放缓，这反而给竞争对手和新芯片带来了抢占市场份额的好机会。
zh.full_summary:
英伟达前CEO黄仁勋的辞职在以色列引发了广泛关注。作为英伟达除美国以外最大的研发基地所在地，以色列拥有约6000名英伟达员工，其经济和科技生态与这家芯片巨头深度绑定。当地科技界担心，失去一手推动收购Mellanox并对当地持续投资的黄仁勋后，英伟达未来对以色列的承诺可能会发生变化。目前临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯与以色列联系紧密，同时苹果的约尼·斯鲁吉和英伟达的迈克尔·卡冈也被传为潜在接班人选。

尽管面临本地的不确定性，以色列的风险投资人普遍认为，这次领导层变动可能削弱英伟达在行业内的绝对统治力。Vertex Ventures合伙人雅奈·奥伦指出，英伟达决策变慢可能会给竞争对手留下切入市场的窗口。Selah Ventures创始人阿迪·莱瓦农则认为，黄仁勋的离开虽然不会摧毁英伟达的技术壁垒，但确实可能减缓其走向全面垄断的步伐，为研发AI专用芯片和推理软件的新兴企业创造了证明自身经济价值的难得机遇。

en.title: Nvidia processors power Chinese AI data centre projects worth $3 billion despite US export controls: Report
en.summary: According to a Reuters report, China has developed AI computing projects worth over $3 billion that rely on restricted Nvidia processors like the H100 and H200. These projects span across multiple provinces, showing that Chinese developers remain heavily dependent on American chip technology despite tightening US export controls, which could lead to potential supply disruptions and higher costs.
en.full_summary:
Project Details
According to a Reuters report, multiple regions in China have incorporated restricted Nvidia processors into their AI infrastructure plans. Projects using H100 and H200 chips span across Fujian, Shaanxi, Jilin, Inner Mongolia, and Gansu provinces, with investments ranging from billions of yuan. Some facilities, such as a computing cluster in Wuxi using H800 processors, are already operational, while institutions like Shenzhen University and Northwestern Polytechnical University have also made smaller chip purchases.
Potential Impact
The heavy reliance on restricted American technology exposes Chinese developers to significant supply disruptions, construction delays, and rising costs as Washington tightens export controls. Furthermore, developers might eventually be forced to redesign their facilities to accommodate domestically produced alternatives.

zh.title: 尽管受到美国出口管制，价值30亿美元的中国AI数据中心项目仍在使用英伟达芯片
zh.summary: 据路透社报道，中国已开发出价值超过30亿美元的AI计算项目，这些项目依赖于受到限制的英伟达处理器（如H100和H200）。这些项目分布在多个省份，表明尽管面临日益收紧的美国出口管制，中国开发者对美国芯片技术的依赖依然很深，这也可能带来供应链中断和成本上升的风险。
zh.full_summary:
项目详情
据路透社报道，中国多个地区已将受限的英伟达处理器纳入其AI基础设施规划中。涉及H100和H200芯片的项目分布在福建、陕西、吉林、内蒙古和甘肃等省份，投资额达数十亿元。部分设施（如无锡使用H800处理器的计算集群）已经投入运营，而深圳大学和西北工业大学等机构也进行了小规模的芯片采购。
潜在影响
随着华盛顿不断收紧出口管制，对受限美国技术的过度依赖使中国开发者面临供应链中断、建设延误和成本上升的重大风险。此外，开发者未来可能被迫重新设计设施，以改用本土生产的替代产品。

en.title: Raise3D Launches T450 and T700 FDM 3D Printers Alongside New Software and Post-Processing Hardware
en.summary: Raise3D has announced the T450 and T700 FDM 3D printing systems featuring large build volumes and heated chambers. According to the company, these machines utilize CoreXY motion and TwinFlow extrusion technology to achieve high printing speeds, alongside updates to existing SLS printers and a new automated sandblaster.
en.full_summary:
Product Launch Details
Raise3D has introduced the T450 and large-format T700 FDM 3D printers ahead of Formnext 2026. Both models share a CoreXY motion platform with four frame-mounted motors and TwinFlow high-flow extrusion technology, which feeds two filament paths into a single nozzle. The systems include Air Flow Manager 2 to adjust chamber temperatures up to 70°C, and feature fiber-ready nozzles reaching 420°C.
Applications and Pricing
According to CEO Edward Feng, the T450's build area enables applications like single-piece adolescent scoliosis braces. Raise3D also reported significant production time and weight reductions for battery cell transport trays. The T450 is priced at $4,999, with deliveries starting in December 2026, while the T700 is priced at $15,999, with deliveries expected by January 2027.
Additional Hardware and Software
Alongside the new printers, Raise3D announced a 100 mm build-height increase for its RMS220 SLS printer via a software update, and introduced the B520 automated sandblaster for polymer powder bed parts. These developments follow a recent $15 million funding round aimed at supporting product portfolio upgrades and market expansion.

zh.title: 复志科技发布 T450 与 T700 工业级 3D 打印机，并带来多项软硬件升级
zh.summary: 复志科技发布了全新大尺寸 T450 和 T700 FDM 3D 打印系统，配备主动加热舱。据该公司称，这些设备采用 CoreXY 运动系统与 TwinFlow 双料挤出技术 以提升打印速度，同时官方还升级了现有激光烧结打印机并推出了自动化喷砂机。
zh.full_summary:
产品发布详情
复志科技在 Formnext 2026 前夕发布了 T450 与大尺寸 T700 FDM 3D 打印机。两款机型均采用配备四个框架安装电机的 CoreXY 运动平台 以及 TwinFlow 高流量挤出技术，可将两条耗材路径送入单个喷头。系统搭载了空气流量管理器 2，可将舱温调节至最高 70°C，并配备了最高支持 420°C 的 纤维兼容喷头。
应用案例与售价
据首席执行官爱德华·冯（Edward Feng）称，T450 的打印尺寸非常适合制作青少年脊柱侧弯矫形器等一体式大件。该公司还表示，电池制造中的电芯搬运盘在采用该系统后，生产时间和重量均大幅下降。T450 售价为 4,999 美元，计划于 2026 年 12 月底开始交付；T700 售价为 15,999 美元，预计于 2027 年 1 月底交付。
软硬件扩展与融资背景
除新打印机外，复志科技还通过软件更新将 RMS220 SLS 打印机的打印高度提升了 100 毫米，并推出了针对聚合物粉末床部件的 B520 自动化喷砂机。此前，该公司刚完成了 1500 万美元的融资，资金将用于产品升级和市场拓展。

en.title: Nvidia scandal: Howard Lutnick under pressure over alleged lack of action
en.summary: US commerce secretary Howard Lutnick is facing intense pressure and potential dismissal following reports that he delayed blacklisting a Singapore-based firm linked to an alleged Chinese spy. The scandal erupted after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid revelations of personal conduct and national security concerns.
en.full_summary:
背景与事件起因
据美联社等多家媒体报道，英伟达联合创始人兼CEO黄仁勋于周四辞职，并由首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯担任临时CEO。此前有报道称，黄仁勋卷入多起婚外情，其中包括与涉嫌中国间谍的艾丽斯·黄（Alice Huang）的关系。随着美国情报部门的相关报告在特朗普政府高层流传，舆论风暴迅速升级。
商务部长的压力
批评矛头直指美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克。多位国会议员指出，商务部在将与艾丽斯·黄有关联、且曾购买数十亿美元英伟达芯片的新加坡公司Megaspeed列入出口管制黑名单一事上存在拖延行为。白宫官员目前正在讨论是否应将卢特尼克撤职，而他本人已同意在未来几周内出席国会听证会。
行业与政策影响
这起丑闻正值美国收紧对华人工智能芯片出口的关键时刻。多位国会领袖呼吁彻底调查并堵住出口管制漏洞，而中国AI公司正试图在海外寻找替代芯片产能，北京方面也在加速推进以华为为代表的国产芯片替代进程。同时，黄仁勋在中国的巨大影响力和个人崇拜现象也在社交媒体上引发了广泛关注和讨论。

zh.title: 英伟达风波持续：美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克因涉嫌应对不力面临去职压力
zh.summary: 美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克因被指延迟将一家涉嫌与中国间谍有关联的新加坡公司列入黑名单，目前正面临巨大的离职压力。此前，英伟达CEO黄仁勋因个人行为及国家安全担忧宣布辞职，引发了这场震动科技与政治圈的巨大风波。

en.title: Oura's acquisition of Counsel Health raises conflict-of-interest concerns for Eli Lilly
en.summary: Smart ring maker Oura is acquiring telehealth startup Counsel Health, a platform previously promoted by drugmaker Eli Lilly for GLP-1 prescriptions. Experts warn this deal introduces potential conflicts of interest because patients sharing health data through Oura rings may now be treated by clinicians within the same newly-acquired ecosystem, complicating how pharmaceutical companies direct patient care.
en.full_summary:
Smart ring maker Oura announced its acquisition of Counsel Health, a telehealth startup that connects patients with clinicians for popular GLP-1 weight-loss drug prescriptions. Previously, pharmaceutical giant Eli Lilly featured Counsel Health on its curated list of provider options for patients seeking these treatments.
Conflict Concerns

According to industry experts, the transaction raises conflict-of-interest questions for Eli Lilly and similar drugmakers. By integrating hardware tracking with direct telehealth diagnosis and prescription services under one corporate umbrella, the acquisition blurs the lines between objective health data collection and commercial treatment pathways, prompting a closer look at how pharmaceutical companies partner with digital health platforms.

zh.title: 智能戒指厂商 Oura 收购远程医疗初创公司，引发礼来公司的利益冲突质疑
zh.summary: 智能戒指制造商 Oura 宣布收购远程医疗初创公司 Counsel Health，而后者此前一直被减肥药巨头礼来公司列为推荐开具 GLP-1 药物的机构。专家警告称，这一收购引发了利益冲突质疑，因为患者通过 Oura 戒指收集的健康数据可能会直接流向其自有的临床医生，这让药企推荐远程医疗的做法变得更加复杂。
zh.full_summary:
智能戒指制造商 Oura 宣布收购远程医疗初创公司 Counsel Health。此前，制药巨头礼来公司曾将 Counsel Health 列为患者获取热门减肥药 GLP-1 处方的推荐服务商之一。
利益冲突质疑

据行业专家指出，这起收购给礼来等药企带来了利益冲突隐患。随着硬件追踪与远程医疗诊断服务被整合到同一家公司旗下，患者通过智能戒指收集的健康数据与商业治疗路径之间的界限变得模糊，这也让制药企业未来如何选择合作伙伴、引导患者就医备受审视。

en.title: Jensen Huang Steps Down as NVIDIA CEO
en.summary: NVIDIA announces that Jensen Huang has stepped down from his roles as president, CEO, and board director, with immediate effect. Colette Kress has been appointed as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.
en.full_summary:
NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang has resigned from his positions as president, CEO, and board member after leading the company for 33 years since its founding in 1993. Following the announcement, the company's stock experienced a significant drop in pre-market trading before recovering slightly.

Executive Vice President and CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO while maintaining her current financial responsibilities. Kress has been with NVIDIA for over 13 years and previously held financial leadership roles at Cisco and Microsoft. Additionally, the board appointed Harvey C. Jones as NVIDIA's first-ever board chairman. The company confirmed that its Q3 fiscal 2027 earnings will be released on November 17 as originally scheduled.

zh.title: 黄仁勋辞职，英伟达33年首换帅
zh.summary: 英伟达宣布黄仁勋已辞去公司总裁、首席执行官及董事职务，即刻生效。现任CFO柯秀英将出任临时CEO，董事会已启动正式继任者的遴选工作。
zh.full_summary:
英伟达官方宣布，自1993年联合创办公司以来掌舵33年的黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事职务。受此重大人事变动影响，英伟达股价在消息公布后出现剧烈波动，盘前一度大跌超过13%，随后跌幅有所收窄。

在寻找正式继任者期间，现任执行副总裁兼CFO柯秀英将出任临时CEO。柯秀英拥有丰富的科技行业财务管理经验，此前曾在思科和微软担任要职。与此同时，英伟达迎来了历史上首位董事会主席Harvey C. Jones。董事会表示，公司的日常运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将继续推进，并不受此次换帅影响，原定于11月17日的财报发布计划也维持不变。

en.title: ESA clarifies Prometheus engine tests are separate from Themis rocket delays
en.summary: The European Space Agency and ArianeGroup clarified that recent hot-fire tests of the Prometheus rocket engine were conducted independently from preparations for the long-delayed Themis reusable booster. While the engine tests successfully validated a new 3D-printing manufacturing method, the Themis demonstrator remains grounded on the launchpad in Sweden with its inaugural flight facing ongoing uncertainty.
en.full_summary:
Engine Testing Update
ArianeGroup announced that a series of hot-fire tests for the latest Prometheus rocket engine were completed on October 29 at DLR's P5 test bench in Lampoldshausen. According to the company, these tests were carried out independently of preparations for the Themis reusable booster demonstrator. A primary goal of this late-October campaign was to validate a new combustion chamber produced through a Cold Gas Spray additive manufacturing process, which aims to reduce production time and costs.
Themis Flight Delays
Meanwhile, the inaugural flight of the Themis reusable booster remains significantly delayed. Although officials previously targeted early 2026 for the first hop test from the Esrange Space Centre in Sweden, the vehicle remains grounded as winter approaches. During an October press conference, ESA's Director of Space Transportation stated that operators would decide by late November whether a 2026 inaugural flight is still feasible before winter weather halts testing.

zh.title: 欧洲航天局澄清：普罗米修斯发动机测试与忒弥斯火箭延误无关
zh.summary: 欧洲航天局与阿丽亚娜集团澄清，近期进行的普罗米修斯火箭发动机热试车，与命运多舛的忒弥斯可重复使用助推器首飞准备工作没有直接关联。尽管这次发动机测试成功验证了新的3D打印制造工艺，但忒弥斯验证机目前仍然滞留在瑞典发射台上，其首飞时间充满了不确定性。
zh.full_summary:
发动机测试进展
阿丽亚娜集团宣布，最新一代普罗米修斯火箭发动机的热试车已于10月29日在德国兰波尔特斯豪森的P5试车台顺利完成。官方表示，这些测试与忒弥斯可重复使用助推器验证机的首飞准备工作是各自独立进行的。本次测试的核心目标之一，是验证采用冷喷涂增材制造工艺生产的新型燃烧室，旨在降低发动机的生产成本并缩短制造周期。
忒弥斯火箭延误
与此同时，忒弥斯可重复使用助推器的首飞计划却一再推迟。尽管欧空局此前曾预计在2026年初进行首次跳跃测试，但随着冬季再次降临瑞典埃斯兰吉航天中心，火箭依然停在发射台上。欧空局运输主管在10月的记者会上表示，相关各方将在11月底前决定，是否有可能在今年底前实施首次飞行，否则测试将面临因冬季恶劣天气而暂停的风险。

en.title: US Lawmakers Summon Ex-Nvidia CEO After Spy Scandal
en.summary: US lawmakers have summoned Nvidia's former CEO to face questions in December following his resignation over extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. The scandal has wiped nearly half a trillion dollars off Nvidia's market value and triggered national security concerns.
en.full_summary:
Following the resignation of Nvidia's long-time leader after reports of extramarital affairs, US lawmakers have moved quickly to demand answers. Republican Senator Tim Scott requested that the former CEO and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify before the Senate Banking Committee in December, while three House committees also called for a closed-door interview.

Reports allege that one of the individuals involved was an asset of China's Ministry of State Security, raising serious concerns regarding the protection of sensitive US technology. The unfolding situation has wiped almost half a trillion dollars off Nvidia's market valuation, thrown the company into leadership transition with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO, and left the broader AI industry navigating uncharted political and security waters.

zh.title: 美国议员在间谍丑闻后传唤英伟达前CEO
zh.summary: 美国国会议员已传唤英伟达前CEO，要求其在12月份接受质询。此前，他因婚外情（其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的交往）而宣布辞职。这起丑闻导致英伟达市值蒸发了近半万亿美元，并引发了对国家安全的担忧。
zh.full_summary:
在英伟达长期掌舵人因婚外情报道宣布辞职后，美国国会议员迅速采取行动要求给出解释。参议员蒂姆·斯科特要求前CEO与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克在12月出席参议院银行委员会的听证会，同时众议院的三个委员会也要求进行闭门约谈。

报道称，相关涉事人员之一被指控为中国国家安全部的特工，这引发了各方对保护美国敏感技术安全的严重关切。这场持续发酵的风波已导致英伟达市值蒸发近半万亿美元，由首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯担任临时CEO，使这家芯片巨头和整个人工智能行业陷入了未知的政治与安全漩涡。

en.title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers present Zugwise, a domain-aware system that treats handwritten chess scoresheet digitization as game reconstruction rather than isolated handwriting recognition, using computer-chess machinery and human-move priors to catch silent errors.
en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has traditionally been framed as a handwriting-recognition task combined with move legality checks. However, the authors argue that this misses silent errors where a misread yields a legal but incorrect move, corrupting the remainder of the game. To address this, the authors present Zugwise, which repurposes computer-chess machinery—such as quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, and pin detection—to evaluate whether a human could have plausibly written a given sequence. It incorporates an absurdity detector, backward search for tracing error symptoms, and a Needleman-Wunsch merge combining evidence from both players' sheets. Evaluated on tournament sections in an oracle replay, the system reduced silent errors from 16 to 1 and from 50 to 13. Two learned signals (CTC re-scoring and a Maia-style human-move prior) raised the correct fix's top-rank rate from 58.8% to 78.0%. The software runs entirely in the browser and is free, private, and offline-capable, accompanied by a three-way adjudication protocol.

zh.title: Zugwise：用于数字化手写国际象棋记分表的地盘感知游戏重建技术
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员提出了 Zugwise，这是一个领域感知的系统，将手写国际象棋记分表的数字化视为游戏重建而非孤立的手写识别，并利用计算机国际象棋机制和人类走棋先验来捕捉隐蔽错误。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：传统上，手写国际象棋记分表的数字化被视为手写识别任务与走棋合法性检查的结合。然而，作者认为这种方法会漏掉“隐蔽错误”——即把字认错成一个合法但却错误的着法，从而破坏后续整局棋。为此，作者推出了 Zugwise 系统，它重新利用了计算机国际象棋的底层机制（如静止搜索、静态交换评估和牵制检测），来评估人类是否可能写下某个序列。该系统包含一个荒谬检测器、用于追溯错误症状的反向搜索，以及使用 Needleman-Wunsch 算法融合双方记分表证据的合并机制。在锦标赛切片的回放测试中，该系统将隐蔽错误从 16 个减少到 1 个，以及从 50 个减少到 13 个。两个学习信号（CTC 重新打分和 Maia 风格的人类走棋先验）将正确修正方案的排名前列率从 58.8% 提升至 78.0%。该软件完全在浏览器中运行，免费、私密且支持离线使用，并附带了一套三方裁决协议。

en.title: Abstention Is Not Threshold Compliance: Stated Scoring Rules in Open Language Models
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers investigate whether open language models can follow explicitly stated scoring rules with probability thresholds for abstention. They find that while formatting prompts to abstain can increase abstention rates, models fail to adjust their decisions correctly when the numerical threshold changes, indicating a lack of true threshold compliance.
