en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: This paper investigates the proposal by Kalai et al. to use explicit probability thresholds in prompts as scoring rules, directing language models to answer only when their confidence exceeds threshold t. The authors probe 12 checkpoints across three post-training stages from four open 3-8B model recipes, alongside exploratory models up to 32B. The empirical tests reveal that while a strict abstention format line shifts mean abstention from 20% to 91% at t = 0.75, varying t from 0.5 to 0.9 within this format changes abstention by a mere -0.8 percentage points. Without formatting prompts, higher thresholds can paradoxically lower abstention, with up to 40% of items receiving decisions incompatible with threshold-independent beliefs. Furthermore, external thresholds on recalibrated P(True) showed brittle generalization across datasets like TriviaQA and PopQA, and models trained on threshold-conditioned targets failed to track unseen thresholds consistently. The study concludes that high abstention rates do not imply true rule compliance and outlines rigorous evaluation criteria for stated scoring rules.

zh.title: 拒绝并非阈值合规：开源语言模型中声明的评分规则研究
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员探讨了开源语言模型是否能够遵循带有明确拒绝概率阈值的声明评分规则。他们发现，虽然特定提示格式可以提高拒绝率，但当数值阈值发生变化时，模型无法正确调整其决策，这表明模型缺乏真正的阈值合规性。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：本文研究了 Kalai 等人提出的在提示词中使用显式概率阈值作为评分规则的方法，即指导语言模型仅在置信度超过阈值 t 时才回答。作者对四个开源 3-8B 模型系列在三个后训练阶段的 12 个检查点以及最高 32B 的探索性模型进行了测试。实证结果表明：虽然在 t = 0.75 时，强制的拒绝格式行将平均拒绝率从 20% 提高到 91%，但在此格式下将 t 从 0.5 提高到 0.9 仅使拒绝率变化了 -0.8 个百分点。在没有该格式的情况下，更高的阈值甚至会降低拒绝率，高达 40% 的检查点条目收到了不符合阈值独立信念的决策。此外，基于重新校准的 P(True) 的外部阈值在 TriviaQA 和 PopQA 等数据集之间表现出脆弱的泛化能力，针对阈值条件目标训练的模型也无法一致地跟踪未见过的阈值。研究总结认为，高拒绝率并不意味着真正的规则合规，并为声明的评分规则提出了严格的评估标准。

en.title: Robust AI builds collaborative mobile robots for warehouses and factories
en.summary: According to MIT Robotics: Startup Robust AI is developing mobile robots like Carter to assist workers in logistics and manufacturing environments. Unlike fully automated systems that require expensive facility overhauls, these robots are designed to work alongside humans, featuring intuitive physical controls and AI vision to reduce physical strain without getting in the way of daily tasks.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Robotics:

Background and Origins
Robust AI was co-founded in 2019 by Anthony Jules and MIT Professor Emeritus Rodney Brooks, known for his work leading CSAIL and co-founding iRobot and Rethink Robotics. After navigating early pivots prompted by the Covid-19 pandemic, the founders leveraged years of customer interviews to focus on logistics and manufacturing industries that lack full automation.
Technology and Workflows
The company's flagship mobile robot, Carter, resembles a utility cart and is built for fast-changing warehouse environments. It features a force-sensitive handlebar, holonomic wheels, and an AI-powered vision system, allowing humans to easily guide, push, pull, or direct it using gestures. Carter is designed to phase into operations as needed, handling tasks like moving items across large facilities where human workers might otherwise walk up to 30,000 steps a day.
Human-Robot Interaction
Robust AI emphasizes human agency, drawing lessons from past automation failures where rigid robots blocked hospital corridors. By designing the digital system to support rather than disrupt human workflows, the company aims to let humans do what they do best while letting machines handle repetitive physical transport.

zh.title: 初创公司 Robust AI 推出协作移动机器人，旨在融入人类工作场所
zh.summary: 据MIT Robotics发布的信息：初创公司 Robust AI 正在开发名为 Carter 的移动机器人，以协助物流和制造环境中的工人。与需要昂贵厂房改造的全自动化系统不同，这些机器人旨在与人类并肩工作，配备了直观的物理控制和人工智能视觉，能够在减轻体力负担的同时不干扰人类的日常工作。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Robotics发布的信息：

背景与创立
Robust AI 由安东尼·朱尔斯和麻省理工学院名誉教授罗德尼·布鲁克斯于 2019 年共同创立。布鲁克斯曾担任麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室负责人，并曾联合创立 iRobot 和 Rethink Robotics。在经历新冠疫情带来的业务调整后，创始人团队通过多年的客户访谈，决定将目光投向那些尚未实现全面自动化的物流和制造行业。
技术与工作流程
该公司的主打移动机器人 Carter 外形类似于手推车，专为瞬息万变的仓库环境而设计。它配备了力敏感把手、全向轮和人工智能视觉系统，允许人类轻松地对其进行引导、推拉或通过手势指挥。Carter 可以根据需要分阶段融入运营，处理在大型设施中搬运物品等任务，在这些地方人类工人每天的步行步数可能高达 3 万步。
人机交互
Robust AI 强调人类的主导权，并从中汲取了过去自动化失败的教训，例如过去曾有设计呆板的机器人堵塞医院走廊。通过设计能够支持而非干扰人类工作流程的数字系统，该公司旨在让人类发挥其特长，同时让机器处理重复性的物理运输工作。

en.title: AI Recording Gadgets Are Living on Borrowed Time as Tech Giants Move In
en.summary: Apple and other major tech players are rolling out all-day conversation memory features directly on smartwatches and phones, squeezing the market for standalone AI recording gadgets. Because basic transcription is no longer a strong competitive edge, hardware makers are rushing to act as AI agent gateways before phone makers fully integrate system-level memory within the next six months.
en.full_summary:
The Shift in Recording Hardware
Standalone AI recording cards like Plaud have enjoyed massive success since 2023, but the core function of recording and transcribing is easily matched by phones and apps. To survive, newer devices are shifting focus from professional meetings to capturing a user's entire day to build personal AI contexts.
The Phone Maker Advantage
Tech giants are quickly closing this gap. Apple added live dialogue rewind and daily recaps to the Apple Watch, while domestic brands like OPPO and Alibaba are launching devices that instantly discard raw audio after cloud transcription, keeping only the text. However, third-party hardware still faces friction because major apps block direct AI control, making standalone or wearable mics a necessary workaround to capture offline conversations.
The Race for the Agent Gateway
Ultimately, these collected contexts are read by AI agents rather than humans. As phone makers race to integrate system-level memory engines by mid-2027, standalone hardware faces a tight six-month window to position itself as a practical peripheral before users rely entirely on built-in phone capabilities.

zh.title: AI 录音硬件正在倒计时，留给创业公司的时间可能只剩半年
zh.summary: 苹果等科技巨头正在手表和手机上直接推出全天候对话记忆功能，疯狂挤压独立 AI 录音硬件的生存空间。由于基础转写技术早已不再是护城河，硬件创业公司必须赶在手机厂商把系统级记忆做完之前，抓紧抢占 AI 助手入口的最后窗口期。
zh.full_summary:
录音硬件的集体转型
像 Plaud 这样的 AI 录音卡虽然在过去几年大卖，但单纯的录音和转写早已不再是护城河，手机搭配应用就能轻松搞定。为了寻找新出路，新一代 AI 硬件开始将卖点从开会记录转向全天候追踪个人生活，为日后的个人 AI 助手积累上下文。
手机厂商的绝地反击
互联网大厂正在加速补齐这一短板。苹果在手表上推出了全天对话回顾功能，国内的 OPPO 和阿里则推出了转写后直接删除原始音频的产品。由于各大主流应用纷纷拒绝 AI 代理操作，手机很难在后台抓取线下交流，这给了硬件厂商一条不得不走的绕路机会。
争夺 AI 助手的入口
这些积累下来的全天记录，最终并不是给人看的，而是交给 AI 助手来读。随着各大手机厂商加速将记忆功能融入底层系统，独立录音硬件只剩下约半年的时间窗口，它们必须赶在手机厂商全面接管之前，努力成为大厂 AI 助手的核心外挂入口。

en.title: Building strong safety evaluations
en.summary: According to Anthropic Research: Anthropic engineering team shares guidelines for building reliable AI safety evaluations, drawing on psychology reforms and internal practices. The post emphasizes that safety claims depend entirely on robust test design, accurate constructs like appropriate responses rather than mere refusals, multi-turn simulations, rigorous grader validation, and preregistration to prevent gaming and noise in AI assessments.
en.full_summary:
According to Anthropic Research:

Background and Challenges

Safety evaluations guide critical decisions regarding AI model deployment and safeguards. However, researchers have found that AI evals are easily gamed, poorly documented, and sensitive to minor formatting changes. Drawing on psychological research reforms, Anthropic outlines best practices for building trustworthy safety evaluations.
Design and Execution Best Practices

Building strong evaluations requires matching the design to the core question, whether observational or causal, and measuring the right construct, such as appropriate response rates instead of simple refusal rates in sensitive contexts like self-harm or dual-use biology. Evals should use multi-turn simulations to capture nuanced, escalating user behavior and run in secure, sandboxed environments to prevent unintended actions.
Grader Validation and Reporting

Since modern evaluations rely on AI graders, teams must calibrate them rigorously, ensure atomic and binary criteria, and validate them against human labels. Furthermore, researchers should preregister analysis plans, report full statistics with confidence intervals, and disclose model configurations transparently to ensure results are reproducible.

zh.title: 如何为人工智能模型构建可靠的安全评估体系
zh.summary: 据Anthropic Research发布的信息：Anthropic 工程团队结合心理学改革与自身经验，分享了构建可靠人工智能安全评估的方法。文章指出，安全声明取决于坚实的测试设计、多轮对话模拟、对评分器（Grader）的严格校验，以及通过预注册来避免评估结果出现漏洞与噪声。
zh.full_summary:
据Anthropic Research发布的信息：

背景与挑战

安全评估指导着人工智能模型部署的关键决策。然而，研究发现 AI 评估容易被钻空子、文档记录不足，且对格式变化高度敏感。Anthropic 借鉴心理学领域的改革经验，总结了一套旨在提高评估可信度的最佳实践。
设计与执行原则

构建可靠评估需要将设计与核心问题相匹配，并准确衡量目标概念。例如，在自残或双用途生物学等敏感场景中，应该评估模型的适当回应率，而非简单的拒绝率。同时，评估应采用多轮对话模拟来捕捉逐渐升级的用户行为，并在安全的沙盒环境中运行以防止意外风险。
评分器校验与结果报告

现代评估通常依赖大模型作为评分器，因此团队必须对其进行严格校验、设定二元原子化标准，并使用人工标签进行交叉验证。此外，研究人员应当在测试前预注册分析计划、完整报告带有置信区间的统计数据，并透明地披露模型配置，以确保结果可复现。

en.title: The patient in the conversation: why biomedical engineering needs a reality check
en.summary: Nature Biomedical Engineering editors argue that many brilliant new medical technologies fail not because the science is weak, but because they are divorced from real clinical needs and patient realities. When designing therapies, devices, or AI tools, researchers must ask whether patients can realistically benefit and whether the treatment is actually practical in everyday healthcare.
en.full_summary:
The Patient Perspective in Research
Editors at Nature Biomedical Engineering emphasize that while submitted studies often feature impressive novelty and technical rigor, a common flaw is the lack of a compelling clinical need. Through an example of engineered bacteria targeting tumors that required prior metabolic labelling of cancer cells, editors illustrate how lab success often ignores the messy realities of patient care, such as administration routes, safety, and scalability.
Practical Challenges Across Fields
This patient-centric lens applies widely. In regenerative medicine, complex manufacturing and cold-chain storage hinder adoption. In medical devices, ingestible tools that require surgical retrieval fall short compared to those that naturally dissolve or excrete. For biomedical AI, hurdles involve data privacy and systemic bottlenecks rather than just model performance. Simplified, cost-effective, and side-effect-reducing technologies are crucial for broad accessibility.
A Call for Early Realism
The goal is not to discourage basic research, but to encourage translational researchers to anticipate clinical barriers right from the design stage. By evaluating whether benefits justify complexity, researchers can ensure their innovations genuinely improve patient lives.

zh.title: 对话中的患者：为什么生物医学工程需要回归现实视角
zh.summary: 《自然-生物医学工程》杂志编辑指出，许多出色的医疗新技术之所以无法落地，往往不是因为科学技术不行，而是因为它们脱离了真实的临床需求。研究人员在设计疗法、设备或AI工具时，必须认真思考患者是否能真正从中受益，以及该技术在现实医疗环境中是否具备实用性。
zh.full_summary:
研发过程中的患者视角
《自然-生物医学工程》的编辑们指出，虽然许多投稿的研究技术精湛且极具创新性，但它们往往缺乏真正令人信服的临床需求。以一个通过工程细菌靶向肿瘤的项目为例，该技术在实验室表现惊艳，但需要先对癌细胞进行代谢标记。编辑借此说明，实验室里的成功往往忽视了真实医疗护理中的复杂现实，比如给药途径、安全性和可扩展性。
各领域的实际挑战
这种以患者为中心的视角适用于各个领域。在再生医学中，复杂的制造流程和冷链储存阻碍了技术的普及；在医疗器械方面，需要手术取出的吞服式设备，远不如那些能自然降解或排泄的设备实用；对于生物医学人工智能而言，数据隐私和系统性瓶颈往往比模型表现本身更具挑战。简化流程、降低成本并减少副作用的技术，对于扩大医疗普及至关重要。
呼吁尽早引入现实考量
编辑强调，提出这些思考并不是为了打消基础研究的积极性，而是希望转化医学研究人员在设计阶段就主动预判临床障碍。通过评估治疗带来的益处是否能抵消其复杂性，研究人员才能确保他们的创新成果真正改善患者的生活。

en.title: A unified and practical taxonomy for false discovery rate control in omics research
en.summary: Researchers in genomics and proteomics often struggle with choosing the right statistical methods to avoid false discoveries. A recent Nature Biotechnology Comment proposes a 2 × 2 matrix to help scientists navigate these options. This framework helps researchers match their data and study design with the most rigorous statistical procedures available.
en.full_summary:
Background
In fields like genomics and mass spectrometry, researchers test thousands of biological features at once, creating a massive risk of false positives. While many statistical procedures exist to control the false discovery rate, they rely on different assumptions, making it confusing for scientists to choose the right one.
Details and Impact
To solve this, the authors propose a practical taxonomy organized around a 2 × 2 matrix. According to the authors, this matrix is designed to guide researchers in sequencing-based and mass-spectrometry-based omics. It helps them select either the most appropriate family of false discovery rate procedures or alternative, more rigorous methods tailored to their specific experimental setup.

zh.title: 组学研究中错误发现率控制的统一实用分类法
zh.summary: 做基因和蛋白质研究的科学家们，常常为挑选哪种统计方法来防止统计错误而头疼。最近《自然·生物技术》发表的一篇评论文章，提出了一个 2×2 的矩阵工具。这个分类框架能帮研究人员根据自身的 数据和实验设计，挑选出最合适且严谨的统计方法。
zh.full_summary:
背景
在基因组学和质谱等组学研究中，科学家们往往会同时对成千上万个生物学特征进行检测，这就很容易出现误报（假阳性）。虽然学术界开发了各种统计方法来控制错误发现率，但由于它们依赖的假设各不相同，研究人员在实际挑选时常常无所适从。
细节与影响
为了解决这个痛点，作者在文章中提出了一套基于 2×2 矩阵 的实用分类法。据作者介绍，该框架旨在指导基于基因测序和质谱的组学研究人员，帮助他们根据具体的 实验设计，理清思路并挑选出最合适的 错误发现率控制方法，或者换用更严谨的替代方案。

en.title: Zura scraps hidradenitis suppurativa drug program after clinical trial failure
en.summary: Zura Bio has discontinued development of its experimental drug tibulizumab for hidradenitis suppurativa after a phase 2 trial missed its primary endpoint. The trial failed because the placebo group performed much better than expected, matching the drug's effectiveness. Following the news, Zura's stock plunged 72%, though the company stated it still has enough cash to fund operations through 2028.
en.full_summary:
Zura Bio reported that its drug tibulizumab failed in a phase 2 trial involving 247 patients with hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), a chronic inflammatory skin condition. The study compared two doses of the drug against a placebo, but the trial missed its primary endpoint because patients taking the placebo showed similar improvement rates in reducing abscesses and nodules compared to those taking the medication. Although the drug's actual response rates were comparable to another approved treatment on the market, the unusually high effectiveness in the placebo arm doomed the trial.

In response to the clinical setback, investors sent Zura's stock down 72% to $1.12 when markets opened. Despite dropping the HS indication, Zura CEO Sandeep Kulkarni noted that the company will continue testing the asset in other conditions like systemic sclerosis and polymyalgia rheumatica, which have completely different disease mechanisms. Furthermore, Zura reported that the drug was generally well-tolerated with manageable safety results, and the company ended September with $187.7 million in cash, providing a financial runway through at least the end of 2028.

zh.title: Zura在临床试验失败后放弃化脓性汗腺炎药物研发
zh.summary: 由于一项二期临床试验未能达到主要终点，Zura Bio宣布停止开发其用于治疗化脓性汗腺炎的试验药物tibulizumab。该试验失败的原因是安慰剂组的表现远超预期，达到了与药物相近的疗效。受此消息影响，Zura股价暴跌72%，不过该公司表示其资金仍足以支撑到2028年底。
zh.full_summary:
Zura Bio报告称，其研发的药物tibulizumab在一项涉及247名化脓性汗腺炎患者的二期临床试验中失利。该研究对比了两种剂量的药物与安慰剂的效果，但由于服用安慰剂的患者在减少脓肿和结节方面表现出与服药患者相近的改善率，导致试验未能达到主要终点。尽管该药物的实际有效率与市场上另一款已批准的疗法相当，但安慰剂组异常高的有效率最终让试验宣告失败。

面对这一临床挫折，开盘时Zura的股价暴跌72%至1.12美元。尽管放弃了化脓性汗腺炎的适应症，Zura首席执行官Sandeep Kulkarni表示，公司将继续在系统性硬化症和风湿性多肌痛等发病机制完全不同的其他疾病中测试该资产。此外，Zura报告称该药物总体耐受性良好，安全性数据在可控范围内，且截至9月底公司拥有1.877亿美元现金，财务资金足以支撑到2028年底。

en.title: Spruce spins off preclinical endocrinology program into Adrenyx with up to $50 million backing
en.summary: Spruce Biosciences is spinning out its preclinical endocrinology program, including a monoclonal antibody for congenital adrenal hyperplasia, into a new entity called Adrenyx Biosciences. Backed by up to $50 million in private equity and led by Spruce's CFO, the separation allows Spruce to focus on neurological disorders while Adrenyx prioritizes endocrinology.
en.full_summary:
According to a Nov. 9 release, Spruce Biosciences is creating a subsidiary named Adrenyx Biosciences to house its preclinical endocrinology program, specifically the monoclonal antibody CRHX-101 (formerly SPR-202) for congenital adrenal hyperplasia.

The transaction structure involves an initial $5 million promissory note from an unnamed institutional biotechnology investor, with a total commitment of up to $50 million. The companies plan to operate as separate, publicly traded entities led by Spruce CFO Samir Gharib, pending regulatory and listing approvals in the first half of next year.

Strategic focus enables Spruce to concentrate resources on its lead neurological candidate TA-ERT for Sanfilippo syndrome type B, following a period of workforce reductions and manufacturing data delays.

zh.title: Spruce剥离临床前内分泌管线成立新公司Adrenyx并获得高达5000万美元融资
zh.summary: Spruce Biosciences 计划将其临床前内分泌管线（包括一种用于治疗先天性肾上腺皮质增生症的单克隆抗体）剥离出去，成立名为 Adrenyx Biosciences 的新公司。在获得高达 5000万美元 的私募股权资金支持并由 Spruce 首席财务官领导下，此次拆分让 Spruce 得以专注于神经系统疾病，而 Adrenyx 则专注于内分泌学。
zh.full_summary:
根据11月9日发布的消息，Spruce Biosciences 正在组建名为 Adrenyx Biosciences 的子公司，以承接其临床前内分泌项目，核心资产为用于治疗先天性肾上腺皮质增生症的单克隆抗体 CRHX-101（原名 SPR-202）。

交易架构显示，该项目获得了来自未具名机构生物技术投资者的首笔500万美元本票协议，整体私募股权承诺额高达5000万美元。在获得监管和上市批准的前提下，两家公司计划在明年上半年拆分为独立的上市公司，并由 Spruce 首席财务官 Samir Gharib 领导 Adrenyx。

战略聚焦使 Spruce 能够在经历裁员和生产数据延迟后，将资源重新集中于治疗 B 型圣菲利波综合征的主打神经系统候选药物 TA-ERT 上。

en.title: Boehringer plans 2027 survodutide submission after positive heart safety trial
en.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim reports that its obesity drug survodutide has successfully met its primary endpoint in a late-stage cardiovascular safety trial, showing no increased risk of major heart-related events. The company plans to submit for regulatory approval next year, positioning the therapy for patients looking to lose metabolic fat while preserving muscle, despite higher gastrointestinal side effect discontinuation rates compared to some rivals.
en.full_summary:
Boehringer Ingelheim presented results from the Synchronize-CVOT study at the American Heart Association Scientific Sessions, showing that survodutide achieved a hazard ratio of 0.89 in comparing major adverse cardiovascular events against placebo among 5,530 adult participants. The dual glucagon and GLP-1 receptor agonist also met secondary endpoints regarding cardiometabolic health markers.

While the drug demonstrated a meaningful weight loss of up to 13.7% at Week 72, it faces intense competition from established blockbusters like Eli Lilly's Zepbound. Furthermore, the trial noted higher discontinuation rates due to gastrointestinal adverse events, ranging between 19.3% and 20.8% across treatment arms, though company representatives express confidence that flexible dosing adjustments in future practice will mitigate this issue.

Boehringer is pursuing a dual-path regulatory strategy, aiming to seek approval for both obesity and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), with the initial weight loss application targeted for submission next year.

zh.title: 勃林格殷格翰计划在减肥药通过心脏安全性试验后于2027年提交上市申请
zh.summary: 勃林格殷格翰报告称，其减重药物survodutide在后期心血管安全性试验中成功达到了主要终点，显示不会增加重大心脏不良事件的风险。该公司计划在明年提交监管审批，该疗法旨在帮助患者减去代谢脂肪并保留肌肉，不过其胃肠道副作用导致的停药率相对部分竞争对手更高。
zh.full_summary:
勃林格殷格翰在美国心脏协会科学会议上公布了Synchronize-CVOT研究的结果，显示在5,530名成年参与者中，survodutide在主要心血管不良事件的对比中达到了0.89的风险比。作为一种胰高血糖素与GLP-1受体双重激动剂，该药物同时也达到了关于心脏代谢健康指标的各项次要终点。

尽管该药在第72周时显示出了高达13.7%的显着减重效果，但它在激烈的减肥药市场中仍面临来自礼来Zepbound等重磅药物的竞争。此外，试验指出由于胃肠道不良反应导致的停药率较高，各治疗组的停药率在19.3%至20.8%之间，不过公司代表表示有信心通过未来临床实践中的灵活剂量调整来改善这一问题。

勃林格正在推进双轨监管策略，计划同时寻求该药物用于减肥及代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）的批准，并计划在明年提交最初的减重适应症上市申请。

en.title: Google Announces 'Gemini 4 Hydrogen', a Fast and Low-Cost Model Available to Free Users
en.summary: Google has announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new AI model focused on speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agent tasks. According to Google, it is 2.5 times faster than the previous generation model and is already rolling out globally, including for free users.
en.full_summary:
Background and Positioning
Google has introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen as the third model in the Gemini 4 series, following Argon and Carbon. Google positions Hydrogen as its mainstream model for daily agent tasks, emphasizing speed and efficiency.
Performance and Comparisons
According to Artificial Analysis, Hydrogen scores 51 points on standard reasoning, outperforming Argon. Google reports it is about 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash. In Google's benchmark comparisons against Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra, Hydrogen led in 7 out of 10 items, including the HLE-Diamond reasoning test at 58.8%, while trailing in terminal operations and computer use.
Pricing and Availability
Hydrogen features a 1-million-token context window. API pricing is set at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per output token. It is available immediately across multiple developer platforms, Google Workspace tools, and the free tier of the Gemini app.

zh.title: Google发布高速低价的“Gemini 4 Hydrogen”，免费用户也可使用
zh.summary: Google正式发布了主打速度与效率的AI模型Gemini 4 Hydrogen，适合日常编程和AI代理任务。据Google称，它的运行速度比上一代轻量模型快大约2.5倍，并且从发布当天起就开始面向全球用户（包括免费用户）逐步推出。
zh.full_summary:
背景与定位
Google推出了Gemini 4系列的第三个模型Gemini 4 Hydrogen，前两个为Argon和Carbon。Google将Hydrogen定位为日常代理任务的主力模型，主打速度与效率。
性能表现与对比
根据Artificial Analysis的数据，Hydrogen标准思考水平得分为51分。Google称其速度比上一代Gemini 3.8 Flash快约2.5倍。在Google与Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5及OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra的对比中，Hydrogen在10个测试项目中的7个领先，其中包括58.8%的HLE-Diamond推理能力测试，但在终端操作等3个项目上落后于对手。
价格与可用性
该模型拥有100万个token的上下文窗口。API定价为每百万输入token 1.5美元、输出token 7.5美元。目前它已通过多个开发者平台、Workspace工具以及Gemini免费版向全球用户提供。

en.title: MIT researchers tackle space nuclear power and radiation detection challenges
en.summary: According to MIT Energy: MIT professor Jake Hecla is researching technologies to enable nuclear energy in space, focusing on solving heat dissipation challenges through liquid droplet radiators. His team is also developing methods for radiation detection and monitoring aerospace nuclear systems to support future arms control and security agreements.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Energy:

Thermal management in space
As deep space missions demand higher power, nuclear reactors produce significant heat. Without an atmosphere for convection, traditional solid metal radiators are too heavy. According to MIT, Hecla is investigating the liquid droplet radiator (LDR), which uses sheets of tiny droplets to radiate heat away, potentially reducing cooling system mass by an order of magnitude.
Radiation detection and Chernobyl
Hecla’s passion for radiation detection began in childhood and led him to research X-ray units and treaty verification methods at MIT. His experiences visiting Chernobyl shaped his commitment to nuclear safety and radioactive contamination management, eventually influencing his graduate research on radiation imaging and antineutrino detection.
Safeguards and space security
Hecla’s research extends to monitoring aerospace nuclear applications, such as tracking air-breathing nuclear propulsion and detecting fissile material from satellites. By developing compact neutron telescopes and tracking operational signatures, his work aims to create a technical foundation for future arms-control agreements.

zh.title: 麻省理工学院研究太空核能与辐射探测难题
zh.summary: 据MIT Energy发布的信息：麻省理工学院教授杰克·赫克拉（Jake Hecla）正在研究使太空核能成为可能的技术，重点是通过液滴辐射器解决散热难题。他的团队还在开发辐射探测与监测航空航天核系统的方法，以支持未来的军控与安全协议。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Energy发布的信息：

太空热管理
随着深空任务对功率的要求不断提高，核反应堆会产生大量热量。由于太空中没有大气层来进行对流散热，传统的固体金属散热器显得过于笨重。据麻省理工学院称，赫克拉正在研究液滴辐射器（LDR），利用微小液滴组成的液膜来散发热量，这有望将冷却系统的重量减少一个数量级。
辐射探测与切尔诺贝利
赫克拉对辐射探测的热情始于童年，并促使他在麻省理工学院研究X射线装置和条约核查方法。他实地造访切尔诺贝利的经历坚定了其对核安全与放射性污染管理的承诺，并最终影响了他关于辐射成像和反中微子探测的研究生课题。
安全保障与太空安全
赫克拉的研究还延伸到了监测航空航天核应用领域，例如追踪吸气式核推进系统以及探测卫星中的易裂变材料。通过开发紧凑型中子望远镜并追踪运行特征，他的工作旨在为未来的军控协议奠定技术基础。

en.title: Deploy frontier AI models on AWS Trainium with SGLang-Neuron
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon announces the public availability of SGLang-Neuron, enabling developers to serve frontier AI models and generate reinforcement learning rollouts on AWS Trainium chips. Developed by RadixArk in collaboration with Annapurna Labs, the integration lets users keep their familiar SGLang workflow while running natively on PyTorch.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

Background
Amazon announced that SGLang-Neuron is now publicly available through an AWS Deep Learning Container. Built by RadixArk in collaboration with Annapurna Labs, the tool brings SGLang's popular serving framework to AWS Trainium, Amazon's proprietary AI chip portfolio designed for cost-effective training and inference at scale.
Technical Details
SGLang-Neuron operates as an out-of-tree plugin that connects SGLang with AWS Trainium. The core SGLang framework handles the API server, request management, and RadixAttention, while the plugin manages Trainium-specific models, attention mechanisms, Mixture of Experts (MoE), and graph execution using native PyTorch and the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI). It also supports PD disaggregation, allowing prefill and decode phases to run on separate servers and transfer KV caches via Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA).
Practical Impact
Developers can now deploy models on Trainium using the exact same SGLang APIs and server interfaces they already use. This lowers the barrier to adopting AWS hardware for large-scale model serving and reinforcement learning workloads without requiring a complete rewrite of their serving pipelines.

zh.title: 亚马逊推出 SGLang-Neuron，支持在 AWS Trainium 芯片上部署前沿大模型
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊宣布公开推出 SGLang-Neuron，允许开发者在 AWS Trainium 芯片上部署前沿人工智能模型并生成强化学习数据。该集成由 RadixArk 与 Annapurna Labs 合作开发，让用户在使用熟悉的 SGLang 工作流 的同时，能够直接在原生 PyTorch 上运行。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

背景介绍
亚马逊宣布 SGLang-Neuron 现已通过 AWS 深度学习容器公开可用。该工具由 RadixArk 与 Annapurna Labs 合作开发，旨在将广受欢迎的 SGLang 模型服务框架引入亚马逊专有的 AWS Trainium 芯片，为大规模 AI 训练和推理提供更具成本效益的选择。
技术细节
SGLang-Neuron 采用独立于核心代码的插件设计，将 SGLang 与 Trainium 芯片连接起来。SGLang 的核心部分负责处理 API 服务器、请求生命周期和缓存管理，而该插件则通过原生 PyTorch 和专属内核接口（NKI）来处理 Trainium 特定的模型架构、注意力机制以及专家混合（MoE）模型。此外，它还支持 PD 分离架构，允许预填充（prefill）和解码（decode）阶段在不同服务器上运行，并通过高性能网络传输缓存数据。
实际影响
开发者现在可以使用与以往完全相同的 SGLang 接口在 Trainium 芯片上部署大模型。这大大降低了企业在转向 AWS 自研芯片时的迁移成本，让他们无需重构服务管道即可运行大规模 AI 推理和强化学习任务。

en.title: Bill Gates-backed Breakthrough Energy says global decarbonization would cost 7.5 trillion dollars
en.summary: According to MIT Climate: At an MIT energy conference, Breakthrough Energy CTO Eric Toone reported that global decarbonization would cost roughly 7.5 trillion dollars, or 5 percent of world GDP. Utilizing artificial intelligence to analyze costs, the firm emphasizes that success relies heavily on eliminating the green premium because people are generally unwilling to pay extra for eco-friendly alternatives.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Climate:

Background and Costs
Eric Toone, chief technical officer at Breakthrough Energy, spoke at MIT's annual energy conference, highlighting that rising global prosperity inherently drives up energy demand and greenhouse gas emissions. According to Toone, while decarbonizing the world economy is entirely feasible, the true challenge lies not just in the calculated 7.5 trillion dollar cost, but in the reality that consumers and even wealthy individuals are largely unwilling to pay extra for zero-carbon alternatives. By enlisting artificial intelligence, the organization estimated this multi-trillion-dollar price tag, which could potentially drop to 3.5 trillion dollars if emerging technologies succeed.
Technology Solutions
Breakthrough Energy Ventures has deployed approximately 3 billion dollars into roughly 140 companies tackling clean energy challenges. Noteworthy examples include Luxwall, which produces highly insulating windows capable of cutting commercial building energy use by 30 percent, and Form Energy, which is developing iron-air batteries designed to store power for up to a month. Other portfolio companies are addressing cement emissions, upgrading transmission lines, advancing geothermal drilling through adapted fracking technology, and creating magnetic containment solutions for fusion energy.
Industry Impact
Toone noted that while Breakthrough's investments are substantial, they represent only a fraction of broader global clean tech funding. The ultimate hurdle facing the energy transition is the sheer scale of existing infrastructure that must be replaced, making it critical to deploy these innovative technologies directly into emerging and developing economies to prevent future carbon-heavy infrastructure buildouts.

zh.title: 比尔·盖茨支持的突破能源称全球去碳化成本约为7.5万亿美元
zh.summary: 据MIT Climate发布的信息：在麻省理工学院的一场能源会议上，突破能源首席技术官埃里克·图恩表示，实现全球去碳化大约需要7.5万亿美元，约占全球GDP的5%。该机构利用人工智能分析了去碳成本，并强调成功的关键在于消除绿色溢价，因为消费者普遍不愿为环保产品支付额外费用。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Climate发布的信息：

背景与成本
突破能源首席技术官埃里克·图恩在麻省理工学院的年度能源会议上发言指出，全球繁荣程度的提升必然会推动能源需求和温室气体排放增加。图恩表示，虽然实现全球经济去碳化完全可行，但真正的挑战不仅在于经计算得出的7.5万亿美元成本，更在于现实情况是消费者乃至富裕阶层大都不愿为零碳替代品支付额外费用。通过借助人工智能进行分析，该机构估算出了这一庞大的总成本，并指出如果各项新技术取得成功，这一数字有望降至3.5万亿美元。
技术解决方案
突破能源风险投资公司已向约140家致力于清洁能源挑战的公司投入了大约30亿美元。其中的代表企业包括卢克斯沃（Luxwall）公司，其研发的高隔热窗户可将商业建筑的能耗降低30%；还有正在开发能够储存长达一个月电力的铁空气电池的Form Energy。其他投资组合还涉及水泥减排、输电线路升级、利用改进的水力压裂技术推进地热钻探，以及为聚变能开发磁场约束方案。
行业影响
图恩指出，尽管突破能源的投资规模不小，但它只是全球更广泛清洁技术资金的一小部分。当前能源转型面临的最大障碍是必须替换庞大的现有基础设施，因此至关重要的是将这些创新技术直接部署到新兴和发展中经济体中，从而避免未来再次建设重碳基础设施。

en.title: AI-related stocks send Taiwanese investors into a frenzy
en.summary: The global boom in artificial intelligence has made Taiwanese stocks a massive obsession for ordinary citizens. Driven by the critical role of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, people from all walks of life are closely tracking markets as chips become the ultimate strategic resource.
en.full_summary:
Background
In Taiwan, taxi drivers and everyday citizens are increasingly fixated on the stock market every morning as trading begins in Taipei. Although their daily jobs have no connection to high finance, many keep a watchful eye on the performance of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company to safeguard their personal savings and future.
Core Details
Local residents often refer to the company as the sacred mountain that protects the country, a sentiment that has intensified with the massive adoption of artificial intelligence. While companies like Nvidia design advanced AI processors in California, the actual physical production relies entirely on TSMC's manufacturing facilities on Taiwan's west coast.
Market Impact
Having long been essential for producing popular consumer tech products like Apple's iPhone processors, the sudden explosion of the artificial intelligence sector has pushed the company to unprecedented heights. Its market capitalization has surged dramatically over a three-year period, establishing it as a dominant economic force outside the United States.

zh.title: 台湾掀起人工智能股票投资热潮
zh.summary: 人工智能的全球狂热让台湾股票成了普通百姓日常紧盯的焦点。由于台积电在生产尖端芯片上占据着无可替代的关键地位，各行各业的人都在密切关注市场动态。
zh.full_summary:
背景情况
在台湾，许多普通市民在台北股市开盘前都会密切关注市场走势。尽管他们的日常工作与金融或半导体毫不相关，但许多人依然时刻关注着台积电的表现，以此来守护自己的个人积蓄与未来。
核心细节
当地人习惯将这家企业称为护国神山，随着人工智能在全球范围内被广泛采用，这种地位变得更加显著。虽然诸如英伟达这样的企业在加州设计先进的AI处理器，但实际的物理制造却完全依赖于台积电在台湾西海岸的工业园区。
市场影响
长期以来，该公司一直是苹果等消费电子巨头不可或缺的代工厂。而人工智能浪潮的爆发，将这家企业的股价推向了全新高度，其市值在短短三年内大幅飙升，成为美国以外全球市值最高的企业之一。

en.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
en.summary: Researchers have developed LLMON, an LLM-native markup language designed to explicitly communicate structure and semantics to models, bypassing the limitations of traditional JSON. By separating instructions from data using reserved special tokens, the newly released experimental Granite 4.1 LLMON preview models achieve significantly higher resistance to prompt injection attacks while maintaining general capabilities.
en.full_summary:
Background and Motivation
Large language models rely heavily on context to generate tokens, but traditional formats like JSON were designed for parsers rather than causal models. Because transformers struggle with long spans and statistical quotation matching, models can become brittle or vulnerable to attacks such as prompt injections. To fix this, developers created LLMON (LLM Object Notation), which uses an XML-like structure with reserved special tokens to cleanly separate instructions, data, and requirements.
Implementation and Capabilities
Today, experimental preview models derived from Granite 4.1 base models, specifically granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview and granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview, have been released alongside a GitHub toolkit. Unlike regular chat templates that flatten inputs into a single string, LLMON wraps semantically coherent components in meaningful tags and uses an execution block to bind specific instructions to their exact data payloads. Evaluated on the OPI benchmark, these models virtually eliminate static indirect prompt injections, showing significantly higher robustness compared to standard open-source and closed-source models while matching general capabilities.

zh.title: LLMON：专为大模型打造的原生标记语言，现已登陆 Granite 4.1 3B 与 8B
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了 LLMON，这是一种专为大模型设计的原生标记语言，用来明确地向模型传递结构和语义，从而解决传统 JSON 格式在大模型应用中的痛点。通过利用预留的特殊符号将指令与数据严格隔离，新发布的实验性 Granite 4.1 LLMON 预览版模型在保持通用能力的同时，大幅提升了抗提示词注入攻击的能力。
zh.full_summary:
背景与动机
大语言模型非常依赖上下文来生成后续内容，但像 JSON 这样的传统格式原本是为解析器设计的，而不是为因果语言模型准备的。由于大模型很难准确追踪长文本中的嵌套结构和括号，它们常常表现得很脆弱，甚至容易遭到提示词注入等攻击。为此，开发团队推出了 LLMON（LLM Object Notation），这是一种采用类似 XML 结构的标记语言，通过特殊的保留符号来明确划分指令、数据和各项要求。
实现细节与实际效果
基于 Granite 4.1 基础模型改进的两个实验性预览版——granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview 和 granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview 现已发布，并附带了相关的 GitHub 工具包。与将所有内容压缩成一个字符串的传统聊天模板不同，LLMON 会用有意义的标签包裹不同的语义组件，并通过执行块把特定的指令同对应的数据精确绑定。在 OPI 基准测试中，这些模型基本消除了间接提示词注入带来的安全隐患，在抗攻击能力上大幅超越了普通开源和闭源模型，同时保持了原有的通用性能。

en.title: Cardiovascular Drug Development Faces Major Setbacks and Upcoming Milestones
en.summary: BioSpace reviews recent cardiovascular drug trials, noting that several late-stage failures have questioned traditional targets like IL-6 and lipoprotein(a). Despite these setbacks, successes from companies like Eli Lilly and Merck, along with upcoming late-stage data, offer hope for future treatments.
en.full_summary:
BioSpace reports on a turbulent period for cardiovascular drug development, highlighted by a series of late-stage clinical trial failures. According to Oppenheimer analysts, the sector experienced six clinical failures within nine weeks. Notable setbacks include Novo Nordisk's IL-6 inhibitor ziltivekimab, which failed to reduce cardiovascular risks, and Novartis's antisense therapy pelacarsen, which lowered Lp(a) levels without generating clinical benefit. Additionally, AstraZeneca and Ionis Pharmaceuticals reported a disappointing Phase 3 result for their TTR silencer Wainua.

Despite these challenges, the sector has seen positive developments. The FDA approved Eli Lilly's Mounjaro to lower cardiovascular risks in type 2 diabetes patients, and Merck secured approval for an oral PCSK9 inhibitor. Furthermore, early-stage trials showed promising results for Verve's base editor VERVE-102 in lowering LDL cholesterol.

Looking ahead, the fourth quarter brings critical readouts. NewAmsterdam Pharma anticipates Phase 3 data for its CETP inhibitor obicetrapib, while Johnson & Johnson and Bristol Myers Squibb await results from a Phase 3 trial of the oral Factor XIa inhibitor milvexian for secondary stroke prevention.

zh.title: 心血管药物研发遭遇挫折，多项关键临床试验蓄势待发
zh.summary: BioSpace 盘点近期心血管药物临床试验指出，多款晚期药物接连失利，让业界对 IL-6 和脂蛋白(a)等传统靶点产生质疑。尽管遭遇挫折，礼来和默沙东等公司的成功获批，加上即将公布的后期数据，依然为未来治疗带来希望。
zh.full_summary:
BioSpace 报道了心血管药物研发领域经历的一段波折期，多项晚期临床试验遭遇滑铁卢。Oppenheimer 分析师指出，该领域曾在九周内出现六次临床失败。其中代表性挫折包括诺和诺德的 IL-6 抑制剂 ziltivekimab 未能降低心血管风险，以及诺华的反义疗法 pelacarsen 在成功降低脂蛋白(a)后未能产生临床获益。此外，阿斯利康与 Ionis 合作的 TTR 抑制剂 Wainua 也公布了令人失望的三期临床结果。

尽管面临挑战，行业仍迎来积极进展。美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准了礼来的 Mounjaro 用于降低 2 型糖尿病患者的心血管风险，默沙东也获得了首个口服 PCSK9 抑制剂的批准。同时，Verve 的碱基编辑药物 VERVE-102 在早期试验中展现出显著降低低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的效果。

展望未来，第四季度将迎来多项关键数据披露。NewAmsterdam Pharma 预计将公布其 CETP 抑制剂 obicetrapib 的三期临床数据，而强生与百时美施贵宝则在等待口服 Factor XIa 抑制剂 milvexian 用于二级中风预防的三期试验结果。

en.title: 1.15.41 - Software release featuring private URL security updates and dependency fixes
en.summary: Vidit-Ostwal released version 1.15.41, which introduces support for approved private URL hosts. This update resolves project dependency issues with PyMuPDF, improves the human-feedback resume workflow by retaining earlier step outputs, and refines the LiteLLM path.
en.full_summary:
Detailed Features

Vidit-Ostwal reports the release of version 1.15.41. The update introduces a new feature that allows approved private URL hosts, enhancing how external links and internal resources are managed within the software.
Bug Fixes and Improvements

The authors state several important bug fixes in this release. Projects are updated to depend on PyMuPDF 2.x. Additionally, a real storage URL has been removed from the URL read tests, and the LiteLLM path now properly strips the cache_breakpoint marker. The system also retains earlier step outputs during a human-feedback resume process.

zh.title: 1.15.41 - 包含私有网址安全更新与依赖修复的软件版本发布
zh.summary: Vidit-Ostwal 发布了 1.15.41 版本，开始支持 受信任的 私有网址主机。本次更新修复了项目对 PyMuPDF 的依赖问题，通过保留早期步骤的输出来改进 人工反馈 恢复工作流，并优化了 LiteLLM 路径。
zh.full_summary:
详细功能

Vidit-Ostwal 宣布发布 1.15.41 版本。该版本引入了一项新功能，允许使用 受信任的 私有网址主机，从而增强了软件内部对外链和内部资源的管理能力。
错误修复与改进

开发团队报告了在此次发布中的多项重要错误修复。项目已更新为依赖 PyMuPDF 2.x 版本。此外，网址读取测试中剔除了真实的存储网址，LiteLLM 路径 也正确剥离了 cache_breakpoint 标记，同时系统在人工反馈恢复流程中能够保留早期的步骤输出。

en.title: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model for Fast Execution and Agentic Workflows
en.summary: According to Google DeepMind: Google is introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new model designed for rapid execution and everyday agentic workflows. Available across Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and the Gemini app, Hydrogen offers flat pricing at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens while delivering significant speed and efficiency upgrades over its predecessor.
en.full_summary:
According to Google DeepMind:

Background and Positioning
Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen to bring cutting-edge intelligence and speed to everyday coding and agentic workflows. While frontier models like Carbon and Argon handle deep, long-horizon reasoning on complex problems, Hydrogen is built as an efficient execution engine for rapid tasks and multi-model collaboration.
Performance and Features
According to Google, Hydrogen surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high-thinking level. It features a 1-million-token context window with flat pricing of $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. In developer benchmarks, it triples its predecessor's Terminal-Bench scores and significantly reduces hallucinated claims. The model supports four adjustable thinking levels to balance quality, latency, and cost.
Ecosystem Integration
Hydrogen is rolling out globally across the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, the Gemini app, Google Search, and enterprise tools. Google is also introducing Orchestrator in Google Antigravity, a feature that dynamically switches between models like Carbon and Hydrogen within a single session to optimize task success rates while reducing token quota consumption.

zh.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，主打快速执行与智能体工作流
zh.summary: 据Google DeepMind发布的信息：谷歌推出了全新模型 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，旨在提供快速执行能力和日常的智能体工作流。该模型已全面上线谷歌各大开发和消费端产品，在保持极高性价比的同时，带来了显著的速度与效率提升。
zh.full_summary:
据Google DeepMind发布的信息：

背景与定位
谷歌正式发布了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，旨在将前沿的AI智能以高速度和高效率带入日常编程与智能体工作流中。虽然谷歌的旗舰模型 Carbon 和 Argon 专注于处理复杂的长周期推理任务，但 Hydrogen 的核心定位则是作为一个高效的执行引擎，胜任各类高频和多步骤的日常任务。
性能与关键细节
据谷歌称，Hydrogen 在默认的高思考水平下，其人工智能指数表现超越了 Argon。该模型支持 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，输入价格为每百万 token 1.50 美元，输出价格为每百万 token 7.50 美元。在开发者测试中，它的 Terminal-Bench 得分比上一代 Flash 模型提升了三倍以上，并大幅降低了错误信息的产生。此外，它提供了四个不同的思考层级，让用户可以根据实际需求在质量、延迟和成本之间自由权衡。
生态整合与应用
Hydrogen 目前正在向全球的开发者、企业和普通消费者全面推送，覆盖 Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini App 以及谷歌搜索。同时，谷歌在 Google Antigravity 中推出了 Orchestrator 功能，能够在单个会话中根据需要动态切换不同模型，从而在保证任务成功率的同时有效节省 token 消耗。

en.title: Google Search Gets Major Upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search globally, marking its biggest model upgrade to date. The update brings better intent understanding for complex questions, improved multi-topic query linking, more visual response formats, and richer language capabilities for everyday users.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

Google reports that Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now available globally for all users in Google Search, representing its largest model upgrade for the search engine so far.
Key Improvements
According to Google, the upgrade features better understanding of intent, allowing Search to handle multi-part questions, typos, and specific requests. It also uses advanced reasoning to improve query fan-out and linking, simultaneously searching subtopics to surface a wider range of relevant websites.
Visual and Language Experience
Users will see more visual responses, including images, structured layouts, comparison tables, and custom tools. Additionally, the system provides richer language understanding across all supported AI Mode languages.

zh.title: 谷歌搜索迎来大升级：内置全新的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型
zh.summary: 据Google AI发布的信息：谷歌正在全球搜索中推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，这是其搜索迄今为止最大的一次模型升级。该更新为用户带来了更强的意图理解能力、更广泛的网页链接关联、更直观的视觉化回答，以及更丰富的多语言处理支持。
zh.full_summary:
据Google AI发布的信息：

谷歌宣布，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 现已向全球谷歌搜索的所有用户开放，这是该搜索产品迄今为止最大的一次模型升级。
核心功能改进
据谷歌称，此次升级具备了更强的意图理解能力，能够处理多部分组成的问题、错别字以及具体的需求。它还通过先进的推理技术优化了查询发散与链接，通过同时检索相关子主题，帮助用户发现更多有价值的网站。
视觉与语言体验
用户将在搜索结果中看到更多视觉化回答，包括图片、结构化布局、对比表格和定制工具。此外，该模型在所有支持的 AI 模式语言中都提供了更深层次的语言理解支持。

en.title: Stratasys and Nano Dimension call off MarkForged acquisition
en.summary: Stratasys and Nano Dimension have mutually agreed to cancel the 42.5 million USD acquisition of MarkForged. According to Stratasys, the decision comes after realizing that the regulatory process would take much longer and cost more than expected. Both companies now believe the required approvals won't happen anytime soon, prompting them to scrap the deal entirely.
en.full_summary:
Background
Earlier this year, Stratasys and Nano Dimension agreed to an all-cash transaction worth 42.5 million USD that would allow Stratasys to acquire MarkForged from Nano Dimension.
Details
According to Stratasys, the original plan was subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals expected by the end of the year. However, by November, both parties concluded that these regulatory hurdles were unlikely to be cleared by the start of 2027. Under the original deal, Stratasys was set to purchase MarkForged's polymer, composite, and metal extrusion portfolio, while Nano Dimension would retain the metal binder jetting line that MarkForged previously acquired from Digital Metal.
Impact
Stratasys stated that the termination does not change the strength or direction of its standalone business, allowing the company to move forward with greater focus and flexibility. Meanwhile, with Nano Dimension exploring pivots away from the additive manufacturing industry, the future of MarkForged remains unclear.

zh.title: Stratasys 与 Nano Dimension 取消收购 MarkForged 交易
zh.summary: Stratasys 与 Nano Dimension 协商一致，取消了总额达 4250 万美元的 MarkForged 收购计划。Stratasys 表示，双方发现后续的监管审批流程比预期更长、成本更高，预计无法在短期内顺利过关，因此决定彻底终止这笔交易。
zh.full_summary:
背景
今年早些时候，Stratasys 与 Nano Dimension 达成了一项价值 4250 万美元的全现金交易，计划由 Stratasys 从 Nano Dimension 手中收购 3D 打印企业 MarkForged。
细节
根据 Stratasys 的声明，这笔交易原本预计在今年年底前完成常规的交割条件和监管审批。但到了 11 月，双方认为这些监管障碍在 2027 年初之前很难被扫清。按照原定计划，Stratasys 本打算买下 MarkForged 的聚合物、复合材料及金属挤出产品组合，而 MarkForged 之前从 Digital Metal 收购的金属粘结喷射产线则归 Nano Dimension 所有。
影响
Stratasys 表示，终止收购并不会改变其独立业务的实力与发展方向，反而能让公司以更大的专注度和灵活性推进既定战略。与此同时，由于 Nano Dimension 正考虑转型脱离增材制造行业，MarkForged 的未来去向目前仍不明朗。

en.title: US AI Data Centers Face Resistance from Local Politics and Community Opposition
en.summary: According to Silicon Valley 101's podcast featuring industry experts and investors, US AI data center expansion is increasingly constrained by community opposition and local political changes. While Wall Street worries about capital expenditure returns and potential hardware supply bottlenecks, local residents raise concerns over utility bills and environmental impacts, introducing new delay risks to infrastructure projects.
en.full_summary:
Policy and Community Pressures on Infrastructure
As US AI infrastructure investments scale up, data center projects are encountering unexpected hurdles from local zoning boards, state politics, and community opposition. Industry experts note that local residents in regions like Texas and California are increasingly pushing back against massive power and water consumption, raising concerns about utility costs and long-term community benefits. These local friction points, ranging from environmental permits to grid interconnection bottlenecks, threaten to increase project costs by 10% to 20% and cause widespread construction delays.
Market Dynamics and Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
Wall Street's recent sell-off in AI-related stocks reflects growing anxiety over the sustainability of massive capital expenditures and circular financing structures. Panelists discussed the potential mismatch between hardware supply and actual software demand, raising questions about whether data center slowdowns could create shortages in specific components while leaving upstream chip capacity vulnerable if token economics or model efficiency shift.

zh.title: 美股AI板块震荡：地方政治与社区反对成数据中心新瓶颈
zh.summary: 据《硅谷101》播客连线多位行业专家与投资人指出，美国AI数据中心的扩张正面临来自社区反对和地方政治变局的现实阻力。华尔街在担忧资本回报与算力供给瓶颈的同时，地方居民对电费和环境成本的忧虑已演变为项目延期风险的重要变量。
zh.full_summary:
政策与社区阻力成基础设施新瓶颈
随着美国AI基础设施投资规模持续扩大，数据中心项目正面临来自地方分区委员会、州级政治变局以及社区反对的现实阻力。业内专家指出，德州和加州等地的居民对巨额电力和水资源消耗的忧虑不断加剧，社区听证会上的反对声音正转化为对电费、供水和建设许可的实质性挑战。这些地方层面的摩擦与并网难题，不仅可能推高10%至20%的合规与建设成本，也加剧了项目延期的风险。
资本市场担忧与产业链传导
华尔街近期对AI板块的震荡反应，反映出市场对巨额资本开支持续性以及循环融资结构的审视。访谈嘉宾探讨了算力供给与模型需求之间的潜在错位，指出数据中心建设放缓可能会重塑产业链各环节的预期。如果基建项目因地方阻力而放缓，上游硬件与芯片的供需平衡将面临新的不确定性。

en.title: Blackstone backs Pfizer's monthly obesity treatment, while FDA nominee faces a tight vote
en.summary: Blackstone is backing Pfizer’s bet on a monthly obesity treatment. Meanwhile, the FDA commissioner nominee Heidi Overton is facing a tight Senate vote due to concerns over past vaccine policies, and Bristol Myers Squibb is shaking up its R&D leadership.
en.full_summary: Blackstone is providing financial backing for Pfizer's development of a monthly obesity treatment. In regulatory news, the Senate health committee is scheduled to vote next Wednesday on Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the FDA. Committee Chair Bill Cassidy remains undecided, describing her past role in shaping the Trump administration's vaccine policies as nearly disqualifying. Given the political split, a single Republican defection could block the nomination if all Democrats vote against her. Additionally, drugmaker Bristol Myers Squibb has restructured its research and development organization. Current Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi has assumed the additional role of head of R&D, while Robert Plenge, the current chief of research, will step down in March. Separately, Reuters reports that the FDA has shelved its Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher program.

zh.title: 黑石集团支持辉瑞的每月一次肥胖症疗法，FDA提名人面临紧张投票
zh.summary: 黑石集团正在支持辉瑞投资每月一次的肥胖症疗法。与此同时，由于对过去疫苗政策的担忧，FDA局长提名人海蒂·奥弗顿面临紧张的参议院投票，而百时美施贵宝也正在调整其研发领导层。
zh.full_summary: 黑石集团正在为辉瑞开发每月一次的肥胖症疗法提供资金支持。在监管方面，参议院卫生委员会计划于下周三对海蒂·奥弗顿担任FDA局长的提名进行投票。委员会主席比尔·卡西迪表示尚未决定立场，并称她过去在制定特朗普政府疫苗政策中所扮演的角色“几乎令人无法接受”。鉴于目前的政治分局势，只要有一名共和党人倒戈，且所有民主党人都投反对票，该提名就可能泡汤。此外，制药巨头百时美施贵宝对其研发组织进行了结构调整，现任首席医疗官克里斯蒂安·马萨切西将兼任研发负责人，而现任研究主管罗伯特·普伦格将于3月离职。另据路透社报道，FDA已经搁置了局长国家优先权凭证计划。

en.title: Neurosterix raises $105 million to advance schizophrenia drug
en.summary: Addex Therapeutics spinout Neurosterix secured $105 million in a Series B financing round led by RTW Investments. The company plans to use the funds to advance its oral M4-targeting candidate NTX-253 into mid-stage clinical trials for schizophrenia. Additionally, Neurosterix appointed three former Karuna Therapeutics leaders who previously worked on the newly approved schizophrenia drug Cobenfy.
en.full_summary:
Funding and Leadership
Neurosterix announced a $105 million Series B financing led by RTW Investments, with participation from GV and Janus Henderson Investors. The company also recruited three former Karuna Therapeutics leaders, appointing Andrew Miller as executive chair, Edmund Harrigan as an independent director, and Stephen Brannan as chair of the clinical advisory board.
Drug Development Strategy
The new capital will primarily fund mid-stage trials for NTX-253, an oral muscarinic M4 positive allosteric modulator designed to treat schizophrenia. The company aims to fine-tune brain signaling to reduce psychosis symptoms while avoiding the movement and metabolic side effects typical of traditional dopamine antagonists.
Market Context
The muscarinic receptor space has gained significant attention following Bristol Myers Squibb's approval of Cobenfy and its $14 billion acquisition of Karuna. Meanwhile, other competitors like AbbVie faced setbacks when their M4 candidate emraclidine failed mid-stage trials.

zh.title: Neurosterix 融资 1.05 亿美元推进精神分裂症新药
zh.summary: Addex Therapeutics 的分拆公司 Neurosterix 获得 1.05 亿美元 B 轮融资，由 RTW Investments 领投。该公司计划利用这笔资金将口服 M4 靶向候选药物 NTX-253 推进至精神分裂症的中期临床试验。此外，Neurosterix 还任命了三位曾参与近期获批精神分裂症药物 Cobenfy 的前 Karuna Therapeutics 领导者。
zh.full_summary:
融资与人事变动
Neurosterix 宣布完成由 RTW Investments 领投的 1.05 亿美元 B 轮融资，GV 和 Janus Henderson Investors 等机构参与跟投。同时，该公司迎来了三位前 Karuna Therapeutics 的高管加入，分别任命 Andrew Miller 为执行董事长、Edmund Harrigan 为独立董事、Stephen Brannan 为临床顾问委员会主席。
药物研发策略
这笔新资金将主要用于推进 NTX-253 的中期临床试验。这是一种口服的毒蕈碱 M4 阳性变构调节剂，旨在治疗精神分裂症。该公司的目标是通过微调大脑信号来减轻精神病症状，同时避免传统多巴胺拮抗剂常见的运动和代谢副作用。
市场背景
随着百时美施贵宝通过收购 Karuna 获得 Cobenfy 并将其推向市场，毒蕈碱受体领域备受瞩目。与此同时，其他竞争对手（如艾伯维）的同类 M4 候选药物在 eller 期临床试验中遭遇失败。

en.title: Sanofi-backed Windward aims for $204M IPO to fund respiratory drugs
en.summary: Swiss biotech Windward is planning a Nasdaq IPO to raise over $200 million, primarily to fund respiratory drugs licensed from China. The company aims to advance its phase 2 and phase 3 clinical trials for asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, backed by major pharmaceutical investors including Sanofi.
en.full_summary:
IPO Details and Financials
Swiss biotech Windward Bio has filed for a Nasdaq IPO, offering 10.3 million shares priced between $16 and $18 each. According to its regulatory filing, the company expects to raise approximately $203.8 million in net proceeds, which could increase to $228 million if underwriters exercise their full options.
Core Pipeline and Chinese Assets
The primary focus of the IPO proceeds is WIN378, an anti-TSLP monoclonal antibody acquired from Kelun-Biotech and Harbour BioMed in a $970 million deal. Windward plans to use up to $227.5 million to complete ongoing phase 2 studies in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma, alongside an upcoming phase 3 trial. Additionally, the company is developing WIN027, a dual-targeting antibody licensed from Qyuns Therapeutics, with funds allocated for a phase 2b COPD study and an atopic dermatitis trial.
Investor Support and Market Context
Windward is led by CEO Luca Santarelli and has a history of strong financial backing, including a $200 million series A and a $165 million series B round. Alongside the public offering, Sanofi has agreed to purchase $50 million of Windward's stock in a private placement, underscoring major industry interest in anti-TSLP therapies for immunological and respiratory conditions.

zh.title: 背靠赛诺菲的 Windward 拟通过 IPO 筹集 2.04 亿美元推进呼吸道药物研发
zh.summary: 瑞士生物技术公司 Windward 计划在纳斯达克进行首次公开募股，筹集超 2 亿美元资金，主要用于推进从中国引进的呼吸道药物。在赛诺菲等知名医药投资者的支持下，该公司正全力推进针对哮喘和慢阻肺的临床二期和三期试验。
zh.full_summary:
IPO 详情与财务目标
瑞士生物技术公司 Windward Bio 已提交纳斯达克 IPO 申请，计划发行 1030 万股股票，发行价区间为每股 16 至 18 美元。根据监管文件显示，该公司预计将筹集约 2.038 亿美元的净收益，如果承销商行使全部超额配售权，募资额有望达到 2.28 亿美元。
核心产品线与中国引进资产
此次募资的首要任务是推进 WIN378，这是一种抗 TSLP 单克隆抗体，此前 Windward 以 9.70 亿美元的交易额从科伦博泰和和铂医药引进。该公司计划投入高达 2.275 亿美元，用于完成慢阻肺和哮喘的现有临床二期研究，并启动新的三期试验。此外，该公司还在开发从荃信生物引进的双特异性抗体 WIN027，相关资金将用于开展慢阻肺和特应性皮炎的中期临床试验。
投资者支持与市场背景
Windward 由首席执行官卢卡·圣塔雷利领导，此前曾获得过多轮大额融资。除了此次公开募股外，赛诺菲已同意通过私募认购 5000 万美元的 Windward 股票，这凸显了整个行业对用于免疫和呼吸系统疾病的抗 TSLP 疗法的高度关注。

en.title: Jaya Baloo Joins Cohere as First CISO
en.summary: According to Cohere Blog: Cohere appoints Jaya Baloo as its first Chief Information Security Officer. Baloo, co-founder of AISLE and former CISO at Rapid7 and Avast, will help the company build a trusted sovereign AI platform as enterprise security demands increase.
en.full_summary:
According to Cohere Blog:

Cohere announces the appointment of Jaya Baloo as its first Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). Baloo brings over two decades of cybersecurity experience, having previously served as CISO at Rapid7, Avast, and KPN Telecom, and as co-founder of AI-native cybersecurity startup AISLE.

As enterprise adoption shifts from pilot projects to production, organizations—particularly governments and critical infrastructure operators—are demanding higher standards of security, governance, and control. Cohere states that Baloo's expertise in critical infrastructure security and quantum readiness will guide the company's strategy in delivering secure deployment infrastructure and frontier AI models.

zh.title: 前安全高管 Jaya Baloo 出任 Cohere 首位首席信息安全官
zh.summary: 据Cohere Blog发布的信息：AI 独角兽 Cohere 宣布任命 Jaya Baloo 为首位首席信息安全官。作为 AISLE 联合创始人及多部安全高管，她将助力 Cohere 构建更安全的企业级 AI 平台以应对合规需求。
zh.full_summary:
据Cohere Blog发布的信息：

AI 企业 Cohere 宣布任命行业资深专家 Jaya Baloo 为公司首位首席信息安全官（CISO）。Baloo 曾任 Rapid7、Avast 等公司的 CISO，并联合创立了 AI 原生网络安全公司 AISLE，在关键系统保护领域拥有超过二十年的经验。

随着企业和政府机构加速将 AI 落地到实际生产环境中，安全与合规性正成为核心考量因素。Cohere 表示，Baloo 的加入将强化其在主权 AI 平台建设上的安全战略，确保客户在部署大模型时拥有更高的控制力与数据信任度。

en.title: Ask Me Anything: The Verge reviews Apple's first smart display, HomeView
en.summary: The Verge's smart home reviewer Jen Tuohy has spent a week testing Apple's first smart display, the $299 HomeView, across various home settings and is hosting an AMA session for subscribers to share her hands-on experience and insights.
en.full_summary: Jen Tuohy, a senior smart home reviewer at The Verge, has tested Apple's newly released $299 HomeView smart display. Over the past week, she tried both the tabletop and wall-mounted versions across different rooms, including the kitchen, bedroom, office, and entryway, testing its cooking assistance, smart home controls, calling features, and new Siri AI capabilities. She also observed how different family members interacted with the device. Verge subscribers can now submit questions in the comments section, with the live answering session scheduled to begin at 2 PM ET.

zh.title: 苹果首款智能屏好用吗？The Verge 资深测评人在线答疑
zh.summary: The Verge 智能家居主笔 Jen Tuohy 花了一周时间，全面测试了苹果售价 299 美元的首款智能屏 HomeView，并为订阅用户开设了在线问答活动，解答关于这款新设备的各种实际使用体验。
zh.full_summary: The Verge 资深智能家居测评人 Jen Tuohy 对苹果售价 299 美元的首款智能屏幕设备 HomeView 进行了为期一周的深度测试。在测试期间，她将桌面版和壁挂版安装在厨房、卧室、办公室和玄关等多个场景，实际体验了做饭辅助、智能家居控制、通话功能以及全新的 Siri 人工智能功能。此外，她还观察了家中不同成员对设备的接受程度。目前，The Verge 的订阅用户已可以在评论区提问，作者将于美东时间下午 2 点开始集中解答。

en.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following personal scandals
en.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned from his position following revelations regarding his personal life. According to the report, Huang admitted to a relationship with an entrepreneur suspected by US intelligence of spying, and subsequently faced scrutiny over a second relationship with an executive at Nvidia. The company's board of directors accepted his resignation on Thursday following an emergency meeting.
en.full_summary:
Jensen Huang, the 63-year-old founder and CEO of Nvidia, has stepped down from his role after a series of personal revelations. On Sunday, November 8, Huang admitted to having a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese entrepreneur suspected by US intelligence agencies of spying for Beijing. Shortly after, on Wednesday, November 11, news emerged of a second romantic relationship with a subordinate who is an executive at Nvidia.

In response to these developments, Nvidia's board of directors convened urgently on Wednesday evening and announced his resignation on Thursday. Huang, who led the company since its founding in 1993, had previously shifted its focus toward artificial intelligence and ruled the organization with direct management over roughly 60 reports. He had not established a succession plan, leaving the tech giant suddenly without its long-time leader.

zh.title: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋因个人丑闻宣布辞职
zh.summary: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋因个人生活问题选择辞去职务。报道称，黄仁勋承认与一名被美国情报机构怀疑从事间谍活动的创业者有染，随后又被曝出与一名英伟达内部高管存在另一段关系。公司董事会在紧急会议后于周四宣布接受其辞职。
zh.full_summary:
现年63岁的英伟达创始人兼CEO黄仁勋在一系列个人丑闻曝光后卸任。11月8日周日，黄仁勋承认与中国女创业者Alice Huang存在恋情，后者正被美国情报机构怀疑为北京从事间谍活动。随后在11月11日周三，媒体披露了他与一名英伟达高管（下属）存在第二段传统恋爱关系的细节。

面对这些风波，英伟达董事会于周三晚间紧急开会，并于周四宣布了这位标志性CEO的辞职决定。黄仁勋自1993年公司成立以来一直掌舵英伟达，成功将其转型为人工智能领域的巨头。他此前曾管理着约60名直接下属，且未设立接班人计划，这使得这家科技巨头在失去长期领导者后面临突然的权力真空。

en.title: Chinese Workers Are Paying Their Own AI Bills to Stay Productive
en.summary: A growing number of white-collar workers in China are paying out of pocket for AI memberships and API credits because companies rarely reimburse these costs. As free tiers run out, buying model access has become a recurring household expense for tasks like drafting, coding, and translation. While efficiency gains vary, workers continue to subsidize tools that their jobs now quietly assume.
en.full_summary:
Background and Survey Data
Survey data indicate that generative AI users in China will exceed 700 million by mid-2026, with about a third using the tools for work. Research shows that more than a third of respondents pay for large-model access, and nearly three in ten buy dedicated AI office products. Outside a few tech giants, corporate reimbursement remains rare, leaving individuals, students, and early-career researchers to cover the shortfalls.
Spending and Use Cases
Workers use paid AI tools across four main clusters: drafting and slides, meeting notes and translation, data cleaning and light coding, and specialized work like contract review. Costs vary by user needs, ranging from a few hundred yuan a month for journalists to around 3,000 yuan for fund managers who rely on AI for research code. E-commerce platforms and telecom operators now offer token recharges alongside ordinary consumer goods, turning AI usage into a regular household bill.
Cost Factors and Future Outlook
Pricing design opacity and token-based metering drive up monthly expenses, as users often stack multiple subscriptions and burn credits on prompt tuning. Until employers treat AI access as standard infrastructure or vendors make pricing more transparent, workers will continue to subsidize the efficiency expected by their employers.

zh.title: 中国职场人正自掏腰包买AI工具来保住工作效率
zh.summary: 越来越多的中国白领员工开始自掏腰包购买AI会员和API额度，因为绝大多数企业并不报销这笔费用。随着免费额度用完，购买大模型服务已成为许多人处理日常工作的固定生活开销。尽管效率提升因人而异，但员工们仍在不断补贴那些工作默认需要的生产力工具。
zh.full_summary:
背景与调查数据
调查数据显示，到2026年中期，中国的生成式AI用户预计将超过7亿，其中约有三分之一将这些工具用于工作。研究表明，超过三分之一的受访者会为大模型访问付费，近三成的人购买了专门的AI办公产品。除了少数科技巨头之外，企业报销仍然非常罕见，这导致个人、学生和早期研究人员不得不自己承担相关费用。
支出情况与应用场景
职场人主要将付费AI工具用于四个领域：文案撰写、会议记录、数据清理以及专业合同审查等。不同群体的花费各不相同，记者每月花费几百元，而依赖AI编写研究代码的基金经理每月则要花大约3000元。随着电商平台和电信运营商开始销售代币充值服务，AI使用费已经变成了一种日常家庭账单。
成本因素与未来展望
由于计费设计不够透明以及按代币计费的普及，用户的每月开销不断增加，许多人甚至需要同时订阅多个模型。在雇主将AI访问视作标准办公基础设施，或者供应商让价格变得更加透明之前，员工们将不得不继续自费补贴工作所需的效率。

en.title: BMS R&D Head to Depart Amid Major Restructure
en.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb is combining its research and development into a single unit as the pharmaceutical giant faces impending patent expirations for its top-selling drugs. Chief Research Officer Robert Plenge will step down, with Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi taking over the unified team to accelerate drug development.
en.full_summary:
Restructure Details
Bristol Myers Squibb announced a major reorganization to merge its early research and clinical development into a single organization, effective at the start of next year. Robert Plenge, the Chief Research Officer, is set to leave his role by the end of the year and transition to an advisory capacity through March 2027. Cristian Massacesi, currently the Chief Medical Officer and development head, will lead the new unified R&D division.
Pipeline Pressures
According to the company, the move is designed to accelerate pipeline development and better integrate new technology. BMS is under mounting pressure as two of its blockbuster drugs, Eliquis and Opdivo, approach patent cliffs. Together, these two medications accounted for roughly half of the company's $48.2 billion total revenue, leaving analysts concerned about the risk profile of upcoming pipeline replacements like Cobenfy and milvexian.

zh.title: 百时美施贵宝重组研发部门，首席研发官将离职
zh.summary: 百时美施贵宝正在将研发部门合并为统一团队，以应对核心药物即将面临的专利到期压力。首席研发官罗伯特·普伦格将离职，由首席医疗官克里斯蒂安·马萨切西接管，旨在加速药物研发步伐。
zh.full_summary:
重组细节
百时美施贵宝宣布进行重大组织架构调整，将原本独立的早期研究与临床开发部门合并为一个统一的研发机构，该调整将于明年初正式生效。现任首席研发官罗伯特·普伦格将在今年底卸任，并转任顾问职务直至2027年3月。现任首席医疗官兼开发主管克里斯蒂安·马萨切西将接管这一新的统一研发部门。
研发管线压力
该公司表示，此举旨在加速药物研发并更好地整合新技术。随着旗下两大重磅药物 Eliquis 和 Opdivo 即将面临专利到期，百时美施贵宝正承受着巨大的营收压力。这两款药物的销售额约占公司482亿美元总营收的一半，分析师对未来用于填补空白的新药管线仍存潜在风险表示担忧。

en.title: Zimbabwean Author Cleared of Using AI for Award-Winning Story
en.summary: Following a month-long investigation, the prestigious Caine Prize concluded that Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza's winning short story was human-written. The inquiry was launched after an article questioned the story's authenticity based on AI-detection software, prompting widespread debate over fairness in literary awards.
en.full_summary:
Investigation Details
Simbarashe Kundizeza won the £10,000 Caine Prize for his short story *The Blue Fighter*. Shortly after, *The Atlantic* published an article suggesting the story was artificially generated, citing the Pangram detection tool.
Resolution and Impact
In response, the prize organizers conducted a thorough review, including interviews and metadata analysis of drafts. Chair Ellah Wakatama confirmed the story is human-written. The incident also sparked online outrage regarding whether minority writers face unfair algorithmic scrutiny.

zh.title: 津巴布韦作家被证实获奖小说并非人工智能代笔
zh.summary: 经过长达一个月的调查，著名的凯恩非洲作家奖得出结论，津巴布韦作家辛巴拉谢·孔迪泽扎的获奖短篇小说完全由人工创作。此前，有文章根据AI检测软件的结果质疑该作品涉嫌造假，曾在文学界引发广泛争议。
zh.full_summary:
调查背景与经过
津巴布韦作家辛巴拉谢·孔迪泽扎凭借短篇小说《蓝色斗士》赢得了1万英镑的凯恩奖。然而几天后，《大西洋月刊》发表文章，援引AI检测工具的分析结果，质疑该获奖作品是由人工智能生成的。
调查结果与行业反响
凯恩奖评委会随后展开了为期一个月的详细调查，通过访谈与元数据分析核实了手稿。评委会主席埃拉·瓦卡塔马确认该作品确系人类创作。这一风波同时在网络上引发了关于少数族裔作家是否更容易受到不公正指控的讨论。

en.title: AMD Announces Instinct MI430X GPU with Native FP64 and HBM4 Memory
en.summary: According to AMD Blogs: AMD announced the Instinct MI430X GPU, built on the CDNA 5 architecture, combining native FP64 compute with 432 GB of HBM4 memory. According to AMD, the design targets the convergence of scientific computing and AI workloads, and the hardware has already been selected for upcoming exascale systems in the US and Europe.
en.full_summary:
According to AMD Blogs:

Hardware Architecture and Specifications
AMD reports that the Instinct MI430X GPU is designed for the convergence of high-precision scientific computing and AI workloads. Built on the CDNA 5 architecture, it delivers up to 288 TFLOPS of peak native FP64 performance alongside 432 GB of HBM4 memory running at 23.3 TB/s bandwidth. For multi-GPU scaling, a node pairs a 6th Gen EPYC server CPU with four GPUs using a fully connected, switchless Infinity Fabric mesh.
Research on FP64 Emulation Limits
In a paper presented at SC26, AMD researchers evaluated the limits of Ozaki GEMM emulation on HPC systems. Their analysis suggests that less than 10% of the broader HPC ecosystem features workloads dense and GEMM-shaped enough to benefit from emulation, indicating that native double precision remains essential for stencils, sparse linear algebra, and molecular dynamics.
System Deployments and Projections
AMD states that the MI430X has been selected for several prominent European and US scientific systems, including Discovery at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Alice Recoque in France, and Herder in Germany. Performance figures provided by AMD are projected estimates based on engineering benchmarks comparing the MI430X to the previous-generation MI300A APU.

zh.title: AMD 发布搭载原生双精度与 HBM4 内存的 Instinct MI430X GPU
zh.summary: 据AMD Blogs发布的信息：AMD 发布了基于 CDNA 5 架构的 Instinct MI430X GPU，同时提供强大的原生双精度计算能力与 432 GB 的 HBM4 内存。AMD 表示，该芯片旨在融合科学计算与人工智能负载，目前已被美国和欧洲的多项超级计算机项目选为核心硬件。
zh.full_summary:
据AMD Blogs发布的信息：

硬件架构与核心参数
据 AMD 称，其新推出的 Instinct MI430X GPU 专为科学计算与人工智能的融合而设计。该芯片基于 CDNA 5 架构，拥有最高 288 TFLOPS 的原生 FP64（双精度）计算性能，并配备了高达 432 GB 的 HBM4 内存，带宽达到 23.3 TB/s。在多卡互联方面，单节点通过无交换机的 Infinity Fabric 网状架构将四块 GPU 与第六代 EPYC 服务器处理器紧密相连。
关于双精度模拟局限性的研究
在 SC26 会议上发表的一篇论文中，AMD 研究人员评估了通过低精度核心模拟 FP64 的局限性。他们的分析表明，在广泛的 HPC 生态系统中，不足 10% 的工作负载具备足够的密度来从这种模拟中获益，这证明了对于各类网格和稀疏线性代数等任务而言，原生双精度依然不可或缺。
系统部署与性能展望
AMD 表示，MI430X 已经获得美国橡树岭国家实验室的 Discovery、法国的 Alice Recoque 以及德国的 Herder 等多个旗舰级科学计算系统采用。不过需要注意的是，官方公布的性能提升数据目前均为工程预测值，系基于与上一代 MI300A 芯片的对比得出。

en.title: Can we finally fix growing drug shortages?
en.summary: In a recent podcast episode, industry experts discuss why drug shortages are worsening. They explore how combining predictive analytics with flexible manufacturing could help make essential medicines more accessible.
en.full_summary:
Background
In this episode of the Denatured podcast, BioSpace Director of Insights Jennifer C. Smith-Parker talks with Antheia CEO Christina Smolke and Cencora data and AI product head Kyle Pudenz about the rising threat of drug shortages.
Details and Approach
The discussion examines the root causes behind worsening medicine shortages. The guests explore potential solutions, focusing on how predictive supply-chain analytics can anticipate disruptions and how agile, distributed manufacturing can make the production of essential medicines more resilient and accessible to patients.

zh.title: 我们能彻底解决日益严重的药物短缺问题吗？
zh.summary: 在一期播客节目中，行业专家探讨了药物短缺问题为何日益严重。他们探讨了如何将预测分析与灵活的分布式制造相结合，从而让必需药品的供应更加稳定。
zh.full_summary:
背景与嘉宾
在播客节目《Denatured》的这期内容中，BioSpace洞察总监詹妮弗与Antheia首席执行官克里斯蒂娜以及Cencora数据与AI产品负责人凯尔共同探讨了日益严重的药物短缺威胁。
探讨的方向与方案
访谈深入分析了药品短缺情况不断恶化的背后原因。嘉宾们探讨了潜在的应对方案，重点关注如何利用预测性分析来预判供应链中断，以及如何通过灵活的分布式制造来增强基本药物的供应韧性，从而改善患者的用药可及性。

en.title: Meta Signs Clean Manufacturing Agreements for Data Center Supply Chains
en.summary: According to Meta Newsroom AI: Meta announces long-term purchase agreements with low-carbon producers to bring clean manufacturing to its data center supply chains, aiming to set an industry standard.
en.full_summary:
According to Meta Newsroom AI:

Background
Meta reports that it is taking steps to green its data center supply chains by targeting upstream manufacturing processes.
Details
According to Meta, the company has entered into long-term purchase agreements with various low-carbon producers across its supply chain network.
Impact
Meta states that these agreements are designed to bring clean manufacturing directly to its data center operations and help set an industry standard for low-carbon supply chain practices.

zh.title: Meta 签署清洁制造协议以推进数据中心供应链低碳化
zh.summary: 据Meta Newsroom AI发布的信息：Meta 宣布通过与低碳生产商签署长期采购协议，将清洁制造引入其数据中心供应链，旨在为行业树立标准。
zh.full_summary:
据Meta Newsroom AI发布的信息：

背景
Meta 表示正在采取行动，通过把目标对准上游制造环节，来推进其数据中心供应链的绿色转型。
细节
据 Meta 称，该公司已与其供应链网络中的多家低碳生产商签署了长期采购协议。
影响
Meta 表示，这些协议旨在将清洁制造直接引入其数据中心业务，并帮助为低碳供应链实践树立行业标准。

en.title: D-Wave Named a Market Shaper in Gartner Quantum Computing Report
en.summary: According to D-Wave News: D-Wave Quantum Inc. announced it has been recognized as a Market Shaper in the Gartner Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing. According to the company, this inclusion highlights its dual-platform approach and its progress in delivering enterprise-grade quantum software and scalable hardware architectures.
en.full_summary:
According to D-Wave News:

D-Wave Quantum Inc. announced it has been recognized as a Market Shaper in the Gartner Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing - Established Vendors as of November 2026, placing among six vendors in the upper right quadrant. Gartner defines Market Shapers as organizations building solutions capable of fundamentally replacing classical computing bottlenecks rather than simply augmenting existing workflows, delivering scalable fault-tolerant architectures and high-fidelity logical qubits.

D-Wave CEO Dr. Alan Baratz stated that the recognition reflects the transformative potential of the company's technology and its execution capabilities. D-Wave provides both quantum annealing and gate-model systems, software, and services, offering enterprise customers access to its Leap quantum cloud service and on-premises systems.

zh.title: D-Wave 在高德纳量子计算报告中被评为市场塑造者
zh.summary: 据D-Wave News发布的信息：D-Wave Quantum Inc. 宣布其在高德纳（Gartner）量子计算新兴市场象限报告中被评为市场塑造者。据该公司称，这一认可凸显了其双平台技术路线以及在交付企业级量子软件和可扩展硬件架构方面的进展。
zh.full_summary:
据D-Wave News发布的信息：

D-Wave Quantum Inc. 宣布，在截至 2026 年 11 月的高德纳（Gartner）量子计算新兴市场象限报告中，该公司被评为市场塑造者，并进入了该象限右上角的六家供应商之列。高德纳指出，市场塑造者正在构建能够根本性替代传统计算瓶颈的解决方案，提供可扩展的容错架构和高保真逻辑量子比特。

D-Wave 首席执行官阿兰·巴拉茨（Alan Baratz）博士表示，这一认可反映了该公司技术的变革潜力及其执行能力。D-Wave 目前提供量子退火和门模型系统、软件及服务，并通过其 Leap 量云服务和本地系统为企业客户提供支持。

en.title: MiniMax Open-Sources H3-Image Model with Native 4K and Advanced Reasoning
en.summary: Chinese AI company MiniMax has open-sourced its flagship image generation model, H3-Image, featuring native 4K resolution and advanced spatial reasoning. The model aims to eliminate the typical artificial look of AI images by handling intricate details, complex text layouts, and even CAD-style mechanical breakdowns. Positioned as a strong competitor in multimodal AI, the model is available via open-source and low-cost API pricing.
en.full_summary:
Background
MiniMax, known for its focus on multimodal AI development, has followed up on its video model releases by introducing H3-Image, a new SOTA-level image generation model designed to tackle both aesthetic quality and logical reasoning in visual tasks.
Capabilities and Performance
According to tests and company reports, H3-Image significantly reduces the artificial appearance common in AI-generated images, successfully rendering human skin textures, realistic lighting, and complex reflections. Beyond aesthetics, the model demonstrates strong spatial awareness and reasoning. It can generate standard orthographic three-view drawings from reference photos, create mechanical explosion diagrams with assembly logic, and accurately typeset and solve complex academic content such as calculus exams.
Ecosystem and Impact
Supporting up to 16 reference images for character and style consistency, H3-Image delivers native 4K resolution (16MP) with generation speeds under 20 seconds. By offering the model as open-source alongside competitively priced API access, MiniMax aims to lower the barrier for commercial applications ranging from industrial design and gaming concepts to marketing materials.

zh.title: MiniMax开源H3-Image生图模型，支持原生4K与复杂逻辑推理
zh.summary: 国内AI公司MiniMax开源了其旗舰图像生成模型H3-Image，支持原生4K分辨率与强大的空间理解能力。该模型通过逼真的细节处理、复杂的文本排版以及CAD机械拆解等功能，大幅减少了传统AI画图的塑料感。作为一款多模态领域的重磅底座，它不仅支持开源，还提供了白菜价的API调用服务。
zh.full_summary:
背景与定位
专注于多模态技术路线的AI企业MiniMax，在推出开源视频旗舰模型后，再次发布了全新的旗舰图像生成模型H3-Image。该模型旨在突破传统AI生图在美学质感与逻辑推理上的瓶颈，为全球开发者提供一个兼具美商与智商的开源底座。
核心能力与表现
根据实测显示，H3-Image有效改善了过去AI生图常见的塑料感与恐怖谷效应，能够精准还原人类皮肤纹理、复杂光影以及微小细节。在逻辑与空间理解方面，该模型表现出极强的泛化能力，不仅能根据外观图自动生成标准的CAD三视图与带有装配逻辑的机械拆解爆炸图，还能完美渲染高数试卷等高密度学术文本并给出解题步骤。
效率与行业影响
H3-Image支持高达16张参考图输入，保障了角色一致性与分镜连贯性，同时实现了原生4K分辨率的快速输出。除了开源供开发者自由定制外，其API调用价格也相对亲民。这一进展表明，垂直领域的图像模型正在通过高精度和低成本，加速向工业设计、游戏概念和跨境营销等严肃生产力场景渗透。

en.title: Biogen faces a major test with upcoming Phase 3 lupus trial results
en.summary: Biogen is preparing to release the results of twin Phase 3 studies for its lupus drug, litifilimab, in early December. This upcoming data serves as a crucial test for the research and development overhaul initiated by CEO Chris Viehbacher, carrying high stakes for the company's growth strategy.
en.full_summary:
Biogen is approaching a pivotal moment as it anticipates data from the TOPAZ-1 and TOPAZ-2 Phase 3 clinical trials evaluating the drug litifilimab for lupus, scheduled for the first half of December. According to STAT reporter Adam Feuerstein, this upcoming readout represents more than just a standard drug evaluation.
Strategic Stakes
The impending results serve as a major test for the R&D revamp and growth strategy implemented by CEO Chris Viehbacher since taking the helm in 2022. Because the company previously experienced a positive Phase 3 outcome with another lupus drug called dapirolizumab over two years ago, expectations and risks are both running high for this new portfolio readout.

zh.title: 渤健即将迎来关键的第三阶段红斑狼疮临床试验结果考验
zh.summary: 生物医药公司渤健正准备在 12 月初公布其红斑狼疮药物 litifilimab 的两项三期临床研究结果。即将揭晓的数据将是对其现任首席执行官推动的研发改革的一次关键检验，对公司的发展战略至关重要。
zh.full_summary:
渤健正迎来一个关键时刻，其用于治疗红斑狼疮的药物 litifilimab 的 TOPAZ-1 和 TOPAZ-2 三期临床试验结果预计将于 12 月上半月公布。据 STAT 记者 Adam Feuerstein 报道，即将到来的数据披露不仅仅是一次普通的药物评估。
战略考验
这些即将揭晓的结果是对首席执行官 Chris Viehbacher 自 2022 年上任以来实施的研发改革与增长战略的一次重大考验。鉴于该公司两年多前在另一款红斑狼疮药物 dapirolizumab 的三期试验中取得了积极结果，外界对此次新药数据的公布既充满了期待，也伴随着不小的风险。

en.title: Alnylam faces pressure to solve its heart drug challenges
en.summary: Columnist Adam Feuerstein re-evaluates his previous prediction about biotech company Alnylam reaching a $100 billion valuation. He notes that Alnylam must successfully address its heart drug challenges to sustain its market growth and fulfill its earlier potential.
en.full_summary: In his newsletter column, biotech writer Adam Feuerstein reflects on a previous comparison between Alnylam and Vertex from August 2025. While Alnylam showed rapid growth driven by its cardiomyopathy treatment Amvuttra, aiming for a market value comparable to Vertex's $100 billion, Feuerstein points out that the company now faces critical hurdles. Specifically, Alnylam needs to navigate its heart drug issues to justify its ambitious valuation and maintain investor confidence in a competitive biotech market.

zh.title: 生物医药公司 Alnylam 需要解决其心脏药物的难题
zh.summary: 专栏作家亚当·福厄斯坦重新评估了他此前关于生物医药公司 Alnylam 达到 1000亿美元市值 的预测。他指出，Alnylam 必须成功解决其 心脏药物难题，才能维持市场增长并实现先前的潜力。
zh.full_summary: 在其专栏文章中，生物医药作家亚当·福厄斯坦回顾了2025年8月关于 Alnylam 与 Vertex 的对比预测。虽然 Alnylam 曾凭藉心肌病治疗药物 Amvuttra 推动了快速增长，并试图追赶 Vertex 的千亿美元市值，但福厄斯坦指出，该公司目前面临着关键障碍。具体而言，Alnylam 需要妥善处理其 心脏药物问题，才能支撑其雄心勃勃的估值，并在竞争激烈的生物医药市场中维持投资者信心。

en.title: AM Solutions launches D3 post-processing system for EOS P 770 additive manufacturing platform
en.summary: AM Solutions reports the introduction of the D3 post-processing system, designed to unpack large polymer parts from EOS P 770 3D printers. According to the company, the system automates unpacking for heavy builds up to 90kg, eliminates compressed air to protect delicate parts, and is currently undergoing beta testing at FKM Additive Manufacturing ahead of its Formnext 2026 debut.
en.full_summary:
System Design and Workflow
According to AM Solutions, the D3 system is divided into three sequential stations within a fully enclosed setup. After a build job cools, an actuator moves the parts and powder into a chamber for vibration processing, followed by powder screening into Polyboxes. The process takes approximately 20 minutes for a PA 12 build job. The system avoids compressed air, using the surrounding powder as a protective cushion to prevent friction and impact damage during cleaning.
Powder Management and Recovery
Project Manager Alexander Gückel notes that the D3 features an optional 'Unpacking Plus' function, which enables powder recovery rates of up to 95 percent. This function also separates thermally less-stressed powder from the peripheral zones of the build job from the heavily stressed powder near the parts, allowing operators to selectively return peripheral powder to the powder loop.
Industry Context and Beta Testing
The D3 is currently undergoing beta testing at FKM Additive Manufacturing. Managing Director Matthias Henkel states that the automation helps reduce manual work and employee exposure to polymer powder. Vanessa Seidenschwarz, Head of Product and Program Management Polymer at EOS, adds that the system contributes to scalable additive manufacturing for large-format production. The D3 is scheduled to premiere live at Formnext 2026.

zh.title: AM Solutions 为 EOS P 770 3D 打印平台推出 D3 后处理系统
zh.summary: 据 AM Solutions 称，该公司推出了 D3 后处理系统，用于处理 EOS P 770 3D 打印机的聚合物零件。据介绍，该系统能为重达 90 公斤的大型打印件提供自动化拆箱，取消压缩空气以保护脆弱零件，目前正在 FKM Additive Manufacturing 进行测试，计划在 2026 年 Formnext 展会上首次亮相。
zh.full_summary:
系统设计与工作流程
据 AM Solutions 介绍，D3 系统在一个全封闭装置内分为三个连续工位。打印作业冷却后，推动器将零件和粉末送入振动处理室，随后通过筛网将粉末排入 Polyboxes。对于 PA 12 打印作业，整个过程大约需要 20 分钟。该系统避免使用压缩空气，而是利用周围的粉末作为保护垫，以防止在清理过程中产生摩擦和碰撞损伤。
粉末管理与回收
项目经理 Alexander Gückel 表示，D3 具备可选的“Unpacking Plus”功能，可实现高达 95% 的粉末回收率。该功能还能将打印作业外围区域受热应力较小的粉末与零件附近受应力较大的粉末分离开来，使操作员能够有选择地将外围粉末重新投入粉末循环中。
行业背景与测试
目前，D3 正在 FKM Additive Manufacturing 进行测试。董事总经理 Matthias Henkel 表示，自动化有助于减少手工劳动和员工对聚合物粉末的接触。EOS 聚合物产品与项目管理负责人 Vanessa Seidenschwarz 补充说，该系统有助于实现大尺寸生产的可扩展增材制造。D3 计划在 2026 年 Formnext 展会上进行实地首秀。

en.title: Max Jaderberg on Isomorphic Labs' Vision for AI-Driven Drug Discovery
en.summary: In a podcast conversation with Elad Gil, Isomorphic Labs president Max Jaderberg discusses the company's vision to shift drug discovery into a process of precision engineering through predictive AI models. Jaderberg highlights how AlphaFold's success served as a proof of concept for deep learning in biology, and predicts that compounding learnings at scale will improve clinical trial success rates and speed, potentially reducing animal testing and extending human healthspan.
en.full_summary:
Isomorphic Labs president Max Jaderberg spoke with Elad Gil about the company's approach to transforming drug discovery from empirical trial and error into a computational discipline. Jaderberg noted that traditional drug development is slow and costly, and argued that success with models like AlphaFold demonstrates how deep learning can generalize in biology. He explained that Isomorphic focuses on building disease-agnostic drug design engines capable of handling various target classes and modalities.

According to Jaderberg, scaling AI models allows them to compound learnings and achieve generalizability, which could increase the probability of success in real-world clinical trials. He shared his perspective that accurate molecular engineering may eventually reduce the reliance on animal testing through in-silico models and could enable sophisticated multidrug cocktails targeting complex biological pathways. Jaderberg also discussed the long-term outlook for treating diseases and improving human healthspan as computational optimization advances.

zh.title: Isomorphic Labs 总裁 Max Jaderberg 谈 AI 驱动的药物发现愿景
zh.summary: 在与 Elad Gil 的播客对谈中，Isomorphic Labs 总裁 Max Jaderberg 讨论了该公司通过预测性 AI 模型将药物发现转变为精密工程的愿景。Jaderberg 指出 AlphaFold 的成功为生物学深度学习提供了概念验证，并预测随着规模化学习的累积，将提升临床试验的成功率与速度，并有望减少动物实验并延长人类健康寿命。
zh.full_summary:
Isomorphic Labs 总裁 Max Jaderberg 与 Elad Gil 探讨了该公司将药物发现从经验试错转变为计算学科的方法。Jaderberg 指出，传统的药物开发既缓慢又昂贵，而 AlphaFold 等模型的成功证明了深度学习如何在生物学领域实现泛化。他解释说，Isomorphic 专注于构建不限疾病领域的药物设计引擎，能够处理各类靶点和模式。

据 Jaderberg 称，扩大 AI 模型规模使其能够累积学习并实现泛化，这可能会提高现实世界临床试验的成功率。他分享了自己的看法，即通过计算机模拟模型，精准的分子工程最终可能会减少对动物实验的依赖，并能够实现针对复杂生物学途径的多药联合疗法。Jaderberg 还讨论了随着计算优化推进，治疗疾病和改善人类健康寿命的长期前景。

en.title: ESA Explains Delay in Signing MaiaSpace Launcher Challenge Contract
en.summary: The European Space Agency has explained that negotiations with MaiaSpace are delayed because the company chose launch service contracts instead of technical development funding, unlike its competitors. While other firms secured most of their money for development, MaiaSpace opted entirely for launch support, making the paperwork more complicated.
en.full_summary:
Background
During the 2025 Ministerial Council meeting, member states committed €902.16 million to the European Launcher Challenge, a program designed to support commercial rocket developers.
Details
While three other companies—PLD Space, Isar Aerospace, and Rocket Factory Augsburg—chose to take the majority of their funding for technical development under Component B, MaiaSpace secured €183.4 million entirely under Component A, which subsidises launch service contracts.
