ESA stated that this unique preference has made the contract negotiations more complicated than the others.
Impact
Although ESA officials previously indicated that the agreement was close to being finalized, the contract with MaiaSpace has not yet been officially signed, creating a noticeable delay compared to its peers.

zh.title: 欧洲航天局解释为何推迟签署 MaiaSpace 发射挑战合同
zh.summary: 欧洲航天局透露，由于 MaiaSpace 选择了与竞争对手不同的发射服务合同而非技术开发资金，导致相关合同签署工作被推迟。其他公司主要申请了技术开发资金，而 MaiaSpace 全部选择了发射支持，这让谈判变得更加复杂。
zh.full_summary:
背景
在 2025 年部长级理事会会议期间，成员国向欧洲发射挑战赛承诺投入 9.0216亿欧元 的资金，旨在支持商业火箭开发商。
细节
其他三家公司（PLD Space、Isar Aerospace 和奥芬巴赫火箭工厂）主要选择通过 B 组件来获取技术开发资金，而 MaiaSpace 获得的 1.834亿欧元 则全部投向了用于补贴发射服务合同的 A 组件。欧洲航天局表示，这种独特的资金选择偏好让合同谈判变得比其他公司更加复杂。
影响
尽管欧空局官员此前曾表示协议即将敲定，但与 MaiaSpace 的合同至今尚未正式签署，与同行相比出现了明显的延误。

en.title: MIT researchers develop a new training method for faster and more trustworthy climate AI models
en.summary: According to MIT Climate: MIT researchers have created a new training technique that dramatically speeds up the production of climate emulators, which are AI models used to simulate future climate scenarios. By using optimized synthetic data instead of traditional realistic emission trajectories, the method cuts down data requirements and helps the AI adapt to unfamiliar scenarios that traditional models usually fail to handle.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Climate:

Traditional earth system models used for climate projection are extremely powerful, but they take months to run on supercomputers for just a single scenario. To solve this, scientists use climate emulators, which are fast AI models that mimic full-scale systems. However, training these emulators usually requires running complex models on six to eight realistic future emission scenarios, making the data creation process slow and costly.

According to MIT researchers, emulators trained exclusively on realistic scenarios often fail to adapt when faced with unfamiliar or novel situations. To address this, the team developed an algorithm that generates a synthetic dataset of optimized, non-traditional climate scenarios tailored to boost predictive performance. By introducing rapid variations and high-frequency oscillations into the training data, the algorithm allows the emulator to extract much more information about the overall system while requiring far fewer full-scale model runs.

The resulting emulators proved capable of accurately predicting outcomes in scenarios they had never seen during training, such as local pollutant control policies where some emissions rise while others fall. Published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, this technique aims to reduce the months or years typically spent on emulator production, helping researchers and decision-makers get updated climate tools much faster.

zh.title: 麻省理工学院研究人员开发出新训练方法，让气候AI模型更快更可靠
zh.summary: 据MIT Climate发布的信息：麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种全新的训练技术，能大幅加速气候模拟器（一种用于预测未来气候的AI模型）的制作过程。通过使用优化后的合成数据来代替传统的真实排放轨迹，该方法不仅大幅减少了所需数据量，还能帮助AI适应传统模型通常无法应对的陌生场景。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Climate发布的信息：

用于气候预测的传统地球系统模型虽然功能强大，但在超级计算机上运行单个场景往往就需要几个月的时间。为了解决这个问题，科学家们开始使用气候模拟器，也就是能够模仿完整系统的快速AI模型。不过，训练这些模拟器通常需要基于六到八种现实的未来排放场景来运行复杂模型，这使得数据创建过程既缓慢又昂贵。

据麻省理工学院的研究人员称，仅在现实场景上训练出来的模拟器，在面对陌生或新奇的情况时往往无法很好地适应。为了应对这一挑战，该团队开发了一种算法，能够生成一组优化后的、非传统的合成气候场景数据集，从而提升模型的预测性能。通过在训练数据中引入快速变化和高频波动，该算法让模拟器能够从整体系统中提取更多的信息，同时大大减少了对完整大规模模型运行的依赖。

研究表明，利用这种技术训练出来的模拟器，能够准确预测其在训练期间未曾见过的场景结果，例如某些排放上升而其他排放下降的局部污染物控制政策。这项研究已发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上，旨在减少通常用于制作模拟器的数月甚至数年时间，帮助研究人员和决策者更快地获得更新的气候工具。

en.title: Meta's AI Muse launches dedicated email addresses, allowing users to delegate messaging
en.summary: Meta has rolled out dedicated @muse.ai email addresses for its personal AI agent, Muse. Users can now assign the AI to handle tasks such as sending reservation emails or summarizing long messages, with availability expanding from paid subscribers to all users over time.
en.full_summary:
According to ITmedia, Meta's personal AI agent Muse introduced dedicated email addresses ending in @muse.ai starting November 11. Reports from Japanese users confirming successful account setups emerged by November 12, indicating availability in Japan alongside the official rollout in the US and Canada.

The feature is initially available to paid subscribers, with plans to expand to free users. Users can set up their Muse email by chatting with the agent or navigating the settings menu to configure a custom address and sender display name. Verified external email addresses can also be linked to issue commands to Muse.

Functionally, users can instruct Muse via chat to dispatch emails to stores, such as restaurant reservations. Additionally, users can forward schedule-related emails to their Muse address for automatic calendar integration or forward long messages for AI-generated summaries.

zh.title: Meta旗下AI“Muse”推出专属邮箱，可帮用户收发邮件
zh.summary: Meta的个人AI助手“Muse”近期推出了专属邮箱地址。用户现在可以放手让AI帮忙发送餐厅预约邮件或是总结长篇大论，这项功能目前正从付费用户逐步向所有人开放。
zh.full_summary:
据ITmedia报道，Meta的个人AI助手“Muse”从11月11日起开始为用户提供以@muse.ai结尾的专属邮箱地址。日本用户在12日前也相继报告成功申请到了该邮箱，显示该功能在美加地区正式上线的同时，在日本也同步开启了测试与使用。

目前该功能率先面向付费用户开放，未来计划覆盖所有免费用户。用户可以通过与Muse对话，或者在设置界面的“连接器”中选择“Muse邮件”来进行配置，自定义邮箱前缀和显示名称。此外，用户还能通过其他邮箱进行验证，从而向Muse发送指令。

在实际应用方面，用户可以在聊天界面让Muse代发邮件，例如给餐厅发送预约信。同时，用户也可以把行程相关的邮件转发到Muse的专属邮箱里，让它自动写入日历，或者把长篇大论的邮件发给它进行快速总结。

en.title: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Java teams can now build autonomous AI agents using Spring AI and Amazon Bedrock, combining familiar enterprise patterns with production-ready managed infrastructure.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

Building autonomous AI agents in enterprise Java environments has traditionally been challenging because standard agent frameworks fail to address scalability, security, and operational governance out of the box. According to Amazon, the integration of Spring AI with Amazon Bedrock and the AgentCore platform bridges this gap, allowing Java developers to use familiar idioms like dependency injection, auto-configuration, and composable advisors.
Core Capabilities
The solution demonstrates how AI moves beyond simple prompt-response interactions toward agents equipped with planning, tool use, and memory. The architecture outlines two main systems: a single-agent travel assistant for tool calling and memory, and a multi-agent intelligent document processing (IDP) platform. The IDP system utilizes specialized agents, a rules engine, and alerting to route and process documents securely.
Production Infrastructure
To prepare agents for production, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore provides managed runtime environments, conversation memory, and identity management. The system incorporates enterprise-grade security, Micrometer observability, and resiliency patterns like exponential backoff retries and circuit breakers, ensuring Java applications can transition smoothly from prototypes to secure production deployments.

zh.title: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 Spring AI 构建自主 AI 智能体
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：Java 团队现在可以借助 Spring AI 和 Amazon Bedrock 构建自主 AI 智能体，将熟悉的企业开发模式与生产就绪的托管基础设施结合起来。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

在企业 Java 环境中构建自主 AI 智能体一直面临挑战，因为标准智能体框架无法直接解决扩展性、安全性和运维治理问题。据亚马逊称，Spring AI 与 Amazon Bedrock 及 AgentCore 平台的结合弥补了这一空白，使 Java 开发者能够使用依赖注入、自动配置和组合顾问等熟悉的开发习惯。
核心能力
该方案展示了人工智能如何超越简单的提示词响应交互，演变为具备规划、工具调用和记忆能力的智能体。架构介绍了两个主要系统：用于工具调用和记忆的单智能体旅游助手，以及多智能体智能文档处理平台。文档处理系统利用专业智能体、规则引擎和警报机制来安全地路由和处理文档。
生产基础设施
为了让智能体做好投产准备，Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 提供了托管运行时环境、会话记忆和身份管理。该系统融入了企业级安全、Micrometer 可观测性以及指数退避重试和熔断器等韧性模式，确保 Java 应用能够从原型平稳过渡到安全的生产部署。

en.title: ByteDance Plans Meta Muse Rival; Claude Enforces Strict IP Bans
en.summary: A roundup of major tech news: ByteDance is developing an AI assistant similar to Meta Muse, while Anthropic enforces strict regional bans on Claude. Meanwhile, OpenAI reports strong third-quarter revenue reaching $10 billion, and Apple announces the permanent closure of its support community.
en.full_summary:
ByteDance is accelerating its AI efforts, with co-founder Zhang Yiming outlining plans to introduce an advanced AI agent within weeks to rival Meta Muse and narrow the gap with US labs by 2030. Meanwhile, Anthropic's new risk-control policy went into effect, targeting users in unsupported regions and blocking consumer subscriptions from relaying requests.

en.title: anthropics/skills: Public repository for Claude Agent Skills
en.summary: ⭐ 193,971 | This repository provides Claude's official skill implementations, which are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that help Claude handle specialized workflows. It lets developers build reusable custom capabilities, automate complex tasks, and reference production-grade document processing code.
en.full_summary:
What are Agent Skills

Skills are self-contained folders consisting of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to drastically improve performance on specialized tasks. Whether it is following your company's brand guidelines, analyzing internal enterprise workflows, or automating daily tasks, skills ensure consistent execution.
Repository Contents and Production Skills

The repository serves as a showcase for agent capabilities, spanning creative applications, technical tasks, and enterprise communications. Crucially, it includes the actual document creation and editing skills that power Claude's document capabilities under the hood—such as docx, pdf, pptx, and xlsx handling—shared openly under the Apache 2.0 license.
How to Use and Install

Developers can easily integrate these skills using Claude Code by registering the repository as a plugin marketplace or running direct installation commands. The repository also provides a clear template structure containing a SKILL.md file with standard YAML frontmatter for anyone looking to create custom skills from scratch.

zh.title: anthropics/skills：Claude 智能体技能官方开源仓库
zh.summary: ⭐ 193,971 | 这个仓库提供了 Claude 官方的技能实现，本质上是一堆包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹，能教 Claude 搞定各种专业活儿。它能让开发者轻松打造专属的定制能力、自动化各种繁琐任务，还能直接参考生产级别的文档处理代码。
zh.full_summary:
什么是智能体技能

技能本质上是包含指令、脚本和资源的独立文件夹，能够让 Claude 动态加载，从而大幅提升它处理专业任务时的表现。不管是按照公司的品牌规范写文档、分析特定的企业工作流，还是自动化个人日常任务，技能都能确保每次都做得又好又稳。
仓库内容与生产级实现

这个仓库展示了 AI 智能体的各种绝活，涵盖了创意设计、技术开发以及企业日常沟通等多个领域。最给力的是，它把支撑 Claude 强大文档处理能力的底层技能（包括 docx、pdf、pptx 和 xlsx 的编辑与生成）全开源了，全部采用 Apache 2.0 协议，供开发者直接参考。
如何使用与安装

开发者可以通过 Claude Code 轻松把这个仓库当作插件市场来用，直接运行几条简单的命令就能完成安装。同时，仓库里还提供了一个标准的模板结构，里面只有一个带 YAML 头部信息的 SKILL.md 文件，方便任何人从零开始 创建自定义技能。

en.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology: A Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers
en.summary: ⭐ 11,830 | Auto Ontology is an open library by NVIDIA that builds a trusted context layer for enterprise data. It solves the problem of AI agents hallucinating or giving wrong answers by mapping out where data lives and what it means. It features automatic schema ingestion and explainable AI workflows for reliable text-to-SQL querying.
en.full_summary:
Detailed Features

Auto Ontology acts as a bridge between your raw databases and AI agents. It automatically ingests database schemas, profiles columns, and infers table relationships to build a semantic graph of your enterprise data. Developers can use it to translate natural language questions into accurate SQL queries powered by NVIDIA NIM, ensuring that every answer comes with verifiable provenance and execution steps.
System Architecture

The project is designed with a modern microservices architecture. It includes a Next.js frontend for the Web UI, a FastAPI Python backend for chat and catalog management, an ingestion worker for vector embeddings, and a PostgreSQL database equipped with pgvector to store both application data and the semantic ontology.
Installation and Usage

Getting started is straightforward using Docker Compose. You simply need to clone the repository, configure your environment variables including your NVIDIA API key in a .env file, and run Docker Compose to spin up the local stack. Once running, you can connect your databases and start asking questions through the built-in chat interface or integrate it with other tools via the MCP server.

zh.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology：用于构建语义图推理层的 Python 框架
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,830 | Auto Ontology 是英伟达开源的一个框架，专门为企业数据打造可靠的上下文层。它能解决 AI 智能体容易胡说八道或给出错误答案的痛点，通过自动梳理数据库里的表结构和业务含义，实现靠谱的可解释 AI 查询。
zh.full_summary:
详细功能

Auto Ontology 充当了原始数据库和 AI 智能体之间的桥梁。它通过自动读取数据库结构、分析字段并推导表与表之间的关系，为企业数据构建出一个语义知识图谱。开发者可以用它把大白话问题转换成精准的 SQL 查询，并借助英伟达 NIM 模型，确保每一个回答都附带可追溯的数据来源和执行步骤。
系统架构

该项目采用了现代化的微服务架构设计。它包含一个基于 Next.js 的前端网页界面、用于处理聊天和目录管理的 FastAPI Python 后端、负责向量嵌入的后台工作进程，以及搭配 pgvector 扩展的 PostgreSQL 数据库，用来存放应用数据和语义图谱。
安装与使用

使用 Docker Compose 可以非常轻松地跑起整个项目。你只需要克隆代码库，在 .env 文件中配好英伟达 API 密钥等环境变量，然后运行 Docker Compose 就能一键启动本地服务。启动后，你就可以连接自己的数据库，通过内置的聊天界面直接提问，或者通过 MCP 服务器将其无缝接入其他开发工具中。

en.title: Theoretical Limits of Language Model Alignment
en.summary: According to Apple Machine Learning: Researchers investigate the fundamental limits of aligning language models under KL-divergence constraints, deriving an optimal reward improvement formula governed by Jeffreys divergence. The study proves that reward ensembling mitigates reward hacking and shows empirically that best-of-N sampling approaches the theoretical limit while PPO and GRPO remain suboptimal.
en.full_summary:
According to Apple Machine Learning:

Lucas Monteiro Paes and co-authors explore the fundamental information-theoretic limits of language model alignment, specifically examining reinforcement learning and best-of-N alignment under a KL-divergence budget.
Theoretical Findings and Estimator
The authors derive a closed-form expression for optimal reward improvement governed by a Jeffreys divergence term rather than traditional KL divergence. By reformulating this expression as a covariance under the base model, they provide a practical estimator that predicts achievable alignment gains using only base model samples.
Reward Hacking and Ensembling
Extending the analysis to proxy reward settings, the authors demonstrate that the gap between ideal and proxy alignment, known as reward hacking, grows when reward error is large or the KL penalty factor decreases. They also provide a theoretical justification for reward ensembling, proving it mitigates this issue.
Empirical Results
Empirical computations of the KL-reward Pareto frontier for safety and summarization tasks reveal that best-of-N sampling closely approaches the derived theoretical limit, whereas PPO and GRPO remain substantially suboptimal, highlighting the need for algorithmic improvements.

zh.title: 大模型对齐的理论极限在哪？
zh.summary: 据Apple Machine Learning发布的信息：研究人员探讨了在大模型对齐中受限于 KL 散度时的理论极限，推导出了由杰弗里斯散度（Jeffreys divergence）决定的最优奖励提升公式。研究证明了奖励集成能够有效缓解奖励作弊（reward hacking）现象，并且实验表明，best-of-N 采样方法极度接近这一理论极限，而传统的 PPO 和 GRPO 算法仍有较大差距。
zh.full_summary:
据Apple Machine Learning发布的信息：

Lucas Monteiro Paes 及其合著者深入研究了大模型对齐的底层信息论极限，重点探讨了在 KL 散度预算约束下的强化学习与 best-of-N 对齐方式。
理论发现与评估器
作者推导出了最优奖励提升的闭式表达式，该表达式由杰弗里斯散度而非传统的 KL 散度主导。通过将该表达式重新表述为基模型下的协方差，他们提供了一个实用的估计器，仅凭基模型样本就能预测出可实现的对齐收益。
奖励作弊与集成
在代理奖励设置下，作者进一步证明了理想对齐与代理对齐之间的差距（即奖励作弊）会随着奖励误差增大或 KL 惩罚因子减小而扩大。同时，他们为奖励集成技术提供了理论支撑，证明其能够有效缓解奖励作弊问题。
实验结果
针对安全性和摘要任务计算出的 KL-reward 帕累托前沿表明，best-of-N 采样能够紧密贴合理论极限，而 PPO 和 GRPO 算法则明显处于次优状态，这表明未来需要更优秀的算法来降低推理成本并实现最优对齐。

en.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
en.summary: This guide provides scripts and containers to fine-tune 3D model TRELLIS.2 using LoRA on specific 3D assets, either locally or via Hugging Face Jobs. By training only the sparse-structure and shape components on a footwear dataset, the authors significantly improved geometric accuracy and performance on held-out test objects.
en.full_summary:
Background
3D generation has wide applications in robotics, simulation, and entertainment, but standardizing different file formats and representations remains challenging. While TRELLIS.2 improved 3D structure representation, general-purpose models often fail to produce accurate geometry for specific tasks, such as shoes where the base model frequently generates incorrect soles.
Implementation
The authors used a subset of the Google Scanned Objects dataset containing 188 footwear objects. To adapt TRELLIS.2 efficiently without catastrophic forgetting, they applied LoRA adapters exclusively to the sparse-structure flow DiT and the shape flow DiT, while freezing the texture generation stage. Training was executed using Hugging Face Jobs on A100 GPUs or locally via Docker.
Results
Quantitative evaluation on held-out objects showed major improvements. The fine-tuned model achieved a mean F-score of 0.803 compared to the base model's 0.276, reduced the Chamfer distance from 0.174 to 0.033, and increased normal consistency, proving that targeted fine-tuning successfully adapts general 3D models for specific object categories.

zh.title: 3D生成模型微调完全指南
zh.summary: 本指南提供了相关脚本和容器，支持用户在本地或通过 Hugging Face Jobs，使用 LoRA 技术对热门 3D 生成模型 TRELLIS.2 进行微调。通过仅对鞋类数据集的稀疏结构和形状组件进行训练，作者显著提升了模型生成物体的几何精度和测试表现。
zh.full_summary:
背景介绍
3D 生成技术在机器人、仿真和娱乐领域应用广泛，但统一各种文件格式和表示方法一直是个难题。虽然 TRELLIS.2 模型改善了 3D 结构表征，但通用模型在处理特定任务时往往无法生成准确的几何形状，例如在生成鞋子时，基础模型经常会把鞋底细节做错。
实施方案
作者使用了包含 188 件鞋类物体的 Google 斯堪尼斯对象数据集子集。为了在避免遗忘原有能力的同时高效适配模型，他们将 LoRA 适配器专门应用到了稀疏结构流 DiT 和形状流 DiT 组件中，同时冻结了纹理生成阶段。整个训练过程通过 Hugging Face Jobs 在 A100 GPU 上运行，或通过 Docker 在本地执行。
实验结果
在测试集上的量化评估显示出显著改进。微调后的模型平均 F 分数从基础模型的 0.276 提升到了 0.803，倒角距离（Chamfer distance）从 0.174 降至 0.033，法线一致性也有所提高，证明了有针对性的微调能够成功让通用 3D 模型适应特定的物体类别。

en.title: ParseBench-2: Severity-aware document parsing benchmark
en.summary: According to LlamaIndex Blog: LlamaParse has released ParseBench-2, a new document parsing benchmark that introduces human-defined severity scores to better evaluate parser errors. The updated benchmark more than doubles its document corpus, adds forms as a sixth dimension, and ranks 41 default parser configurations, with LlamaParse Agentic Plus leading overall.
en.full_summary:
According to LlamaIndex Blog:

Background and Improvements
Traditional document parsing benchmarks often rely on brittle metrics that overpenalize harmless formatting changes while underpenalizing critical data errors, such as swapping digits in a number. ParseBench-2 addresses this by introducing severity-tuned scoring based on 330 expert-defined error types across six dimensions: text, formatting, tables, charts, layout, and forms. The benchmark corpus has been expanded from 2.1k to 4.3k real-world enterprise documents, including 1,025 charts and 500 form pages from 30 countries.
Performance Insights and OCRia-1.5
In the evaluation of 41 default configurations, LlamaParse Agentic Plus led overall with a score of 89.8, outperforming direct vision models and competing specialized parsers. Charts emerged as the widest capability gap among systems, with scores ranging from 1.2 to 92.6. Additionally, LlamaParse introduced OCRia-1.5, a new family of document parsing models powering its cost-effective and agentic parsing modes, aiming to deliver higher accuracy at lower processing costs.

zh.title: ParseBench-2：引入错误严重程度评估的文档解析基准
zh.summary: 据LlamaIndex Blog发布的信息：LlamaParse 发布了 ParseBench-2 文档解析基准，引入了基于人类判断的错误严重程度评分机制，能更准确地评估解析器错误的影响。该版本将文档语料库扩大了一倍以上，新增了表单作为第六个评估维度，并对 41 种默认解析器配置进行了排名，其中 LlamaParse Agentic Plus 综合得分领先。
zh.full_summary:
据LlamaIndex Blog发布的信息：

背景与改进
传统的文档解析基准往往采用脆弱的评估指标，会对无害的格式变化过度惩罚，却对关键数据错误（如数字颠倒）惩罚不足。ParseBench-2 引入了基于专家定义的 330 种错误类型的严重程度评分机制，涵盖文本、格式、表格、图表、布局和表单六个维度。该基准的文档语料库从 2.1k 扩大到 4.3k 个真实企业文档，包含 1,025 个图表以及来自 30 个国家的 500 页表单。
性能洞察与 OCRia-1.5
在对 41 种默认配置的评估中，LlamaParse Agentic Plus 以 89.8 分的总分领先，表现优于直接视觉模型和其他专业解析器。图表成为了系统间能力差距最大的领域，得分从 1.2 分到 92.6 分不等。此外，LlamaParse 还推出了全新文档解析模型系列 OCRia-1.5，用于支撑其成本效益和智能代理模式，旨在以更低的成本提供更高的解析准确率。

en.title: FDA analysis of 30 years of AAV gene therapy submissions highlights common regulatory hurdles
en.summary: An FDA analysis of gene therapy applications from 1995 to 2025 shows rapid growth in adeno-associated virus development and identifies common reasons for regulatory holds, aiming to help developers avoid pitfalls.
en.full_summary: Researchers affiliated with the US Food and Drug Administration reviewed investigational new drug applications submitted to the Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research spanning three decades from 1995 to 2025. The evaluation outlines the expansion of adeno-associated virus development over thirty years and highlights recurring factors that trigger regulatory holds during the review process. The authors note that the opinions and perspectives presented reflect the individual authors and do not necessarily represent official agency policies, while offering retrospective insights designed to guide successful product development.

zh.title: 美国食药监局分析三十年腺相关病毒基因疗法申报，梳理常见监管卡点
zh.summary: 美国食药监局对1995年至2025年间的基因疗法临床试验申请进行了分析，发现腺相关病毒开发呈快速增长态势，并指出了导致项目被叫停的常见原因，以此帮助开发者避坑。
zh.full_summary: 美国食药监局相关研究人员回顾了生物制品评估和研究中心在1995年至2025年这三十年间收到的新药临床试验申请。该评估梳理了腺相关病毒开发的扩张历程，并指出了在审评过程中触发监管搁置的反复出现的因素。作者指出，文中呈现的观点仅代表作者个人，不一定代表官方机构政策，但这些回顾性洞察旨在为成功的产品开发提供指导。

en.title: OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Developers can now use OpenAI Codex with Amazon Bedrock for enterprise coding assistance, choosing between native AWS access or managed gateways. The approach integrates with existing IAM identities and observability tools to keep engineering workflows secure.
en.full_summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: OpenAI Codex can now use Amazon Bedrock for inference, allowing platform teams to provide developers with AI coding tools without managing a separate access stack. Organizations can choose from Native AWS Access, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, or an existing Large Language Model Gateway based on their control requirements. The setup integrates corporate identity providers like Okta with AWS IAM Identity Center, ensuring that developer requests are properly authenticated and attributed. For monitoring, teams can deploy the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry to track metrics on Amazon CloudWatch dashboards while keeping sensitive code and data protected through strict configuration boundaries.

zh.title: 在亚马逊云科技上运行 OpenAI Codex
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：开发者现在可以使用亚马逊云科技运行 OpenAI Codex，通过原生 AWS 访问或托管网关来处理编程工作。该方案能与现有的 身份验证 和监控工具无缝集成，在保证安全的同时提升开发效率。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

OpenAI Codex 现在可以通过亚马逊云科技进行模型推理，让平台团队无需单独搭建一套访问系统，就能为开发者提供 AI 编程工具。企业可以根据控制需求，在原生 AWS 访问、AgentCore 网关或现有的大模型网关之间进行选择。

该方案将 Okta 等企业身份提供商与 AWS IAM 身份中心结合，确保开发者的每次请求都能被正确验证和追踪。在监控方面，团队可以使用 OpenTelemetry 收集指标并在 CloudWatch 仪表盘 上查看，同时通过严格的配置边界来保护敏感代码和数据安全。

en.title: Is Claude Fable 5.2 worth it for office workers? Comparing it with Opus and Sonnet
en.summary: Anthropic's top-tier AI model Claude Fable 5.2 was tested against Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 on tasks like summarizing lengthy government reports and preparing presentation slides. While Fable 5.2 excels at understanding user intent and crafting user-friendly slides, it is significantly more expensive and time-consuming, making Opus and Sonnet more practical choices for everyday tasks.
en.full_summary:
The article evaluates Anthropic's new flagship AI model, Claude Fable 5.2, against Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 across two typical office tasks: summarizing a 268-page government white paper into a 15-minute presentation, and conducting background research for a media interview.

In the presentation-making task, Fable 5.2 followed the time constraint best, structuring the slides neatly with well-thought-out actionable takeaways and speaker notes. However, it took about 1.6 times longer and cost roughly twice as much as Opus 5.5, and 3.6 times as much as Sonnet 5.5. In the research task, all three models performed similarly well in grasping key contexts, though Fable 5.2 provided deeper localized insights at a higher cost.

Third-party benchmarks indicate that Fable 5.2 leads in general intelligence but slightly trails in specific knowledge-work tasks like briefcase handling. Ultimately, while Fable 5.2 offers a more human-like output and better intent-matching for creative presentation structuring, its high cost means office workers should primarily rely on Opus 5.5 or Sonnet 5.5 for daily routines, reserving Fable 5.2 for high-stakes, heavy-duty information processing.

zh.title: 上班族有必要用Claude Fable 5.2吗？对比Opus和Sonnet的实测表现
zh.summary: Anthropic最新推出的顶级AI模型Claude Fable 5.2在长篇报告总结和演示文稿制作等任务中，与Opus 5.5和Sonnet 5.5进行了对比实测。结果显示，虽然Fable 5.2更懂用户意图、能做出更好用的资料，但它的费用和时间成本也最高，日常办公使用Opus或Sonnet更加划算。
zh.full_summary:
文章测试了Anthropic新旗舰模型Claude Fable 5.2在两项常见办公任务中的表现：将268页的白皮书浓缩为15分钟的演示文稿，以及为采访做背景调查，并与Opus 5.5和Sonnet 5.5进行了对比。

在做PPT的任务中，Fable 5.2最完美地执行了“15分钟”的限制，生成的幻灯片逻辑清晰、重点突出。但代价是其耗时是Opus的1.6倍，费用高出两倍。而在背景调查任务中，三款模型表现相差无几，但Fable依然是最贵的一个。

综合第三方评测来看，Fable 5.2虽然综合智力领先，但在知识工作基准测试中略逊于前代。对于普通上班族而言，考虑到高昂的使用成本，日常工作建议继续使用性价比较高的Opus或Sonnet，只有在需要砸资源追求极致效果的场景下才用Fable 5.2。

en.title: 1.15.40 - Core Updates and Feature Enhancements
en.summary: This update brings several key improvements, notably removing chromadb from the embedding function layer and adding support for jsonl in rag data discovery. It also fixes async hook issues and improves agent stability, making AI development more reliable and smooth.
en.full_summary:
Key Features
This release introduces significant structural changes, including the complete removal of chromadb from the embedding function layer to streamline operations. Additionally, it adds exact historical state lookup by row id, integrates jsonl into rag data type discovery, scaffolds standalone agents as JSON by default, and introduces comprehensive backend record lifecycle and pagination tests.
Bug Fixes and Documentation
On the maintenance side, the update ensures that after_llm_call hooks now properly run on asynchronous calls. It also addresses potential failures by stopping agents whose CrewAI AMP apps cannot be resolved, and updates the Arize agent evaluation guide URL for developers.

zh.title: 1.15.40 版本发布 - 核心功能升级与优化
zh.summary: 这个版本带来了一些关键改进，最引人注目的是从嵌入函数层移除了 chromadb，并支持了通过 jsonl 处理 rag 数据。同时它还修复了异步调用的问题，让 AI 开发过程更加稳定。
zh.full_summary:
核心功能更新
本次更新带来了多项架构层面的优化，其中最核心的是从嵌入函数层中彻底移除了 chromadb，从而简化了底层操作。此外，新版本还支持通过行 ID 精确查找历史状态、将 jsonl 格式融入 rag 数据类型发现中、默认以 JSON 格式脚手架独立智能体，并增加了后端记录生命周期和分页测试。
修复与文档
在修复和维护方面，本次更新确保了 after_llm_call 钩子能够在异步调用时正常运行。同时，它还能在无法解析 CrewAI AMP 应用时自动停止智能体，并更新了开发者所需的 Arize 智能体评估指南链接。

en.title: AWS Neuron SDK Release 2.33.1 - Bug fixes for AWS AI chip development toolkit
en.summary: This is a bug fix update for the AWS Neuron SDK, which is the official software development kit used by developers to build and run AI models on Amazon's custom machine learning chips. It mainly cleans up issues found in the previous version to keep your AI workloads running smoothly without unexpected hiccups.
en.full_summary:
What is AWS Neuron SDK
AWS Neuron SDK is the essential toolkit provided by Amazon Web Services for developers looking to train and deploy deep learning models efficiently using Amazon's custom-built Inferentia and Trainium chips.
Release 2.33.1 Details
This specific release brings important bug fixes built directly on top of the v2.33.0 foundation. While it doesn't introduce brand-new features, it ensures greater system stability for production environments relying on AWS infrastructure.
How to Use
Developers can easily upgrade their existing environments by referencing the official AWS documentation and integrating these patches into their current machine learning pipelines.

zh.title: AWS Neuron SDK 2.33.1 版本发布 - 针对亚马逊AI芯片开发工具包的错误修复
zh.summary: 这是 AWS Neuron SDK 的一个错误修复更新。这个工具包是专门用来帮助开发者在亚马逊自研的机器学习芯片上运行 AI 模型的。它主要修复了前一个版本里的小毛病，让你的 AI 任务跑得更顺畅，不再出莫名其妙的岔子。
zh.full_summary:
这是个啥工具
AWS Neuron SDK 是亚马逊云科技专门为开发者准备的核心开发工具包，用来帮助大家在亚马逊自家造的 AI 芯片上高效地训练和运行深度学习模型。

怎么开始用

en.title: Google Research uses wearables and AI to forecast personalized health habits
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google Research has developed an experimental AI framework that turns passive wearable data into a coachable health age, helping users understand how daily habits like sleep and steps impact their long-term cardio-metabolic health. By combining a world model with personalized habit simulations, the system goes beyond simple fitness tracking to forecast how lifestyle changes will improve future well-being.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

Background
Heart disease, kidney conditions, and metabolic disorders like type 2 diabetes form an interconnected web known as cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome. These issues often develop silently years before symptoms appear, and while smartwatches easily track past activity, translating that data into meaningful, actionable guidance remains a major challenge.
Framework Details
Google's new framework introduces a coachable health age model, which avoids simply guessing a user's birth year. Instead, it relies on published epidemiological studies linking behaviors like resting heart rate, steps, and sleep to disease risk. It is paired with Sensor World Model, an action-conditioned model pre-trained on millions of user-weeks of data to forecast how 20 physiological markers will evolve over 12 weeks under different daily routines.
Impact
Evaluated across multiple cohorts and through blind tests with medical professionals, this multimodal approach combines continuous wearable data with routine blood biomarkers to map multi-organ aging. While currently an investigational research prototype, it lays the groundwork for future prospective trials aimed at helping people build lasting, healthy habits.

zh.title: 谷歌研究利用穿戴设备和人工智能预测个性化健康习惯
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：谷歌研究团队推出了一套实验性人工智能框架，能把日常穿戴设备的被动数据转化为可干预的健康年龄，帮助用户看清睡眠和步数等习惯如何影响长远的心血管与代谢健康。通过结合世界模型与个性化习惯模拟，该系统突破了单纯的运动追踪，能预测生活方式的改变将如何改善未来的身体状况。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

背景介绍
心脏病、肾脏疾病以及2型糖尿病等代谢紊乱形成了一个紧密相连的网络，被称为心血管-肾脏-代谢综合征。这些健康隐患往往在症状出现前的数年就已悄然萌芽。虽然智能手表能轻松记录过去的活动，但要把这些数据变成有指导意义的实际行动却非常困难。
框架细节
谷歌的新框架推出了一种可干预的健康年龄模型，它不再单纯去猜测用户的出生年份，而是基于已有的流行病学研究，将静息心率、步数和睡眠等日常行为与疾病风险挂钩。它还配合了一个名为传感器世界模型的情境预测模型，该模型通过海量匿名数据预训练，能够预测在不同的日常起居下，二十多项生理指标在未来十二周内会发生怎样的变化。
实际影响
该多模态方法在多个研究队列中进行了评估，并通过了医学专家的盲测，将持续的穿戴设备数据与常规血液生物标志物结合起来，用以描绘多器官衰老情况。尽管目前它仍属于实验性研究原型，但它为未来的前瞻性试验奠定了基础，有望帮助人们培养持久的健康习惯。

en.title: Ex-employee sues Eli Lilly over alleged off-label marketing of weight loss drug
en.summary: A former Eli Lilly sales representative has filed a lawsuit claiming she was fired after reporting that the company unlawfully promoted its diabetes medication for weight loss before receiving official regulatory approval, highlighting ongoing scrutiny within the booming obesity treatment market.
en.full_summary: According to the lawsuit, the former sales representative alleges that Eli Lilly pushed its diabetes drug Mounjaro for weight loss purposes prior to proper regulatory clearance. The worker claims she was terminated after raising internal concerns about this practice. This case brings fresh attention to the intense commercial pressures and regulatory boundaries surrounding the rapidly expanding market for GLP-1 and obesity medications.

zh.title: 前员工起诉礼来公司涉嫌违规推广减肥药
zh.summary: 礼来公司的一名前销售代表提起诉讼，称她在举报公司在未获得官方监管批准前，就将糖尿病药物违规当作减脂瘦身产品推广后遭到了解雇，这凸显了蓬勃发展的减肥药市场正面临着持续的合规审查。
zh.full_summary: 根据诉讼内容，这名前销售代表指控礼来公司在获得正式监管批准之前，就大力推销其糖尿病药物 Mounjaro 用于减重。这位员工表示，自己在对这种做法提出内部质疑后遭到解雇。这起案件让外界再次关注到围绕 GLP-1 和肥胖症药物市场迅猛扩张所带来的巨大商业压力与监管边界。

en.title: Can AI Foundation Models Actually Explain How the Brain Works?
en.summary: Tech giants and academic labs are pouring millions into training AI foundation models on massive amounts of brain data. While these models get good at predicting brain activity, top scientists are locked in a debate over whether accurate predictions actually mean we understand the brain, or if we are just building another black box that we still have to figure out.
en.full_summary:
The Brain Data Rush
Researchers are applying the recipe behind large language models to neuroscience, training neural networks on vast brain recordings. Meta, Stanford, and startups have released or are building brain foundation models, hoping that scale will make them smarter.
The Great Debate
Optimists argue that models reproducing brain activity can act as stand-ins for living subjects and help us discover new biological insights. Skeptics counter that fitting brain data does not guarantee the model works like a real brain, nor does it grant mechanistic understanding. Scaling laws for brain data also remain murky compared to language models.
The Path Forward
Some suggest combining data-driven models with task-trained models, while others argue that true intelligence requires modeling the whole body and physical interactions, reminding the field that scaling data might not be a silver bullet.

zh.title: AI 脑模型能真正解释大脑是如何工作的吗？
zh.summary: 科技巨头和学术实验室正砸下巨资，用海量的大脑数据来训练 AI 基础模型。虽然这些模型在预测大脑活动方面越来越准，但顶尖科学家们对预测准确是否等于真正理解大脑展开了激烈辩论，大家担心这可能只是造出了另一个需要重新破解的新黑盒。
zh.full_summary:
脑数据淘金热
研究人员正将大语言模型的成功配方搬到神经科学领域，通过在海量大脑神经记录上训练神经网络来构建基础模型。Meta、斯坦福大学以及多家机构正纷纷押注这一方向，希望通过扩大规模让模型不断变聪明。
核心大辩论
乐观派认为，能复制大脑活动的模型未来可以替代活体实验，并帮助人类发现新的生物学规律。而怀疑派则反驳称，能拟合大脑数据并不代表模型和真实大脑的运作机制一样，更不等于我们真正理解了大脑。此外，与语言模型不同，大脑数据的扩展规律目前依然是个未知数。
前路在何方
部分学者建议将纯数据驱动的模型与任务驱动的模型结合起来，而另一些人则坚持认为，真正的智能离不开对整个身体和物理交互的建模，这提醒着行业盲目堆砌数据可能并不是万灵药。

en.title: AI is taking over R&D: What this means for the food industry
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the food and beverage industry, with about 90% of R&D leaders now regularly using the technology to cut costs and speed up product development. However, companies must carefully protect trade secrets and restructure their internal workflows to safely balance powerful AI tools with crucial human expertise.
en.full_summary:
The Rapid Rise of AI in Food R&D
A new report by agritech consultancy Bright Green Partners reveals that roughly 90% of food and beverage R&D leaders routinely use artificial intelligence. Driven by intense market competition where nearly three-quarters of leaders have seen rivals beat them to store shelves, companies are turning to AI to streamline new product development. With AI costs dropping significantly and autonomous experimentation projected to account for nearly 20% of NPD time by 2030, adoption is accelerating.
Data Security and Workflow Challenges
Despite the clear benefits, integrating AI into food science comes with notable risks. Companies are deeply concerned about exposing sensitive test results and proprietary formulations to external AI models. To mitigate these risks, organizations are deploying enterprise-grade security environments, building internal solutions, or enforcing strict contractual safeguards. Additionally, companies must bridge fragmented internal knowledge and establish cross-functional ownership between R&D, IT, and business teams rather than relying on isolated pilot projects.
The Human Edge
While automated systems and cheaper AI tools are reshaping the industry, human expertise remains irreplaceable. Because off-the-shelf AI tools are accessible to everyone, a company's unique human insight provides the actual competitive edge. The most successful food companies are starting small to identify bottlenecks, demonstrating clear value, and thoughtfully reimagining their workflows to thrive in an AI-driven market.

zh.title: 人工智能接管食品研发：食品行业正在发生什么变化
zh.summary: 人工智能正在迅速改变食品饮料行业，大约90%的研发负责人现在经常使用该技术来降低成本并加速产品开发。不过，企业必须仔细保护商业机密，并重组内部工作流程，以便在强大的AI工具与至关重要的人类专业知识之间找到平衡。
zh.full_summary:
人工智能在食品研发中的快速崛起
农业科技咨询公司 Bright Green Partners 的一份新报告显示，大约90%的食品饮料研发负责人已经在日常工作中使用了人工智能。在激烈的市场竞争驱动下，近四分之三的领导者曾经历竞争对手率先将产品推向货架的困境，这促使企业纷纷转向AI以简化新产品开发。随着AI成本的大幅下降以及预计到2030年自主实验将占到新产品开发时间的近20%，相关技术的应用正在加速普及。
数据安全与工作流程挑战
尽管好处显而易见，将AI融入食品科学也伴随着明显的风险。企业非常担心将敏感的测试结果和独家配方暴露给外部AI模型。为了降低这些风险，各大机构正在部署企业级的安全环境、构建内部解决方案，或执行严格的合同保障。此外，企业必须弥合碎片化的内部知识，在研发、IT和商业团队之间建立跨部门权责划分，而不是仅仅依靠孤立的试点项目。
人的核心优势
虽然自动化系统和更便宜的AI工具正在重塑整个行业，但人类的专业知识依然不可替代。由于现成的AI工具对所有人开放，企业独特的人类洞察力才构成了真正的竞争优势。最成功的食品公司正在从小处着手以找出瓶颈、证明清晰的价值，并周密地重新设计工作流程，以便在AI驱动的市场中脱颖而出。

en.title: Google launches Gemini Decisions API for fast, low-cost multimodal choices
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google has introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by a new Gemini Decision 1 model. It is built for fast, bounded choices like tool selection and policy checks, processing multimodal inputs and up to 1,000 questions in a single forward pass without generating answer text token by token. This slashes end-to-end latency to 150-250 ms and cuts costs significantly.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

How it works
Instead of generating answer text token by token like traditional language models, Gemini Decision 1 scores candidate options in a single forward pass. It supports text, images, audio, video, and PDFs up to 256K tokens, allowing developers to ask up to 1,000 independent questions simultaneously. Every answer includes a confidence score, letting developers route ambiguous cases to fallback systems or human reviewers.
Pricing and Performance
The model delivers a median latency of 150-250 ms end-to-end and is priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed. Google reports that it is nearly 5x cheaper than standard generative alternatives across shared benchmark suites.
Real-World Applications
Internal teams at Google are already using the API as a low-latency control plane. Examples include dynamic model routing in Gemini Notebook to reduce query latency by up to 40%, rapid design iteration in Stitch, instant emoji selection in Google Labs, and safety layers for Model Context Protocol tools in Google Search.

zh.title: 谷歌推出 Gemini Decisions API，实现极速低成本的多模态决策
zh.summary: 据Google AI发布的信息：谷歌推出了 Gemini Decisions API，背后由全新的 Gemini Decision 1 模型驱动。它专为工具选择和合规检查等限定选项场景打造，能在一轮前向计算中处理多模态输入和多达 1,000 个问题，无需逐个生成文字。这把响应延迟大幅压缩到 150-250 毫秒，并且显著降低了使用成本。
zh.full_summary:
据Google AI发布的信息：

工作原理
跟传统大模型逐个字蹦答案不同，Gemini Decision 1 采用单次前向计算直接给候选选项打分。它支持文本、图片、音频、视频和最多 25.6 万个 Token 的 PDF，开发者可以在单次请求中同时问多达 1,000 个独立问题。每个答案都会附带一个置信度分数，方便代码自动把拿不准的情况转给人工或者备用方案。
性能与价格
它的端到端延迟能控制在 150 到 250 毫秒之间，定价为每百万输入 Token 0.10 美元，而且完全不收输出 Token 的钱。谷歌表示，在同类基准测试中，它的成本比常规生成式方案便宜将近 5 倍。
实际应用
谷歌内部团队已经开始把这个 API 当作低latency的控制中枢来用。比如，Gemini Notebook 用它来实现动态模型路由，把日常查询的延迟降低了最多 40%；Stitch 用它快速迭代设计；Google Labs 用它秒选表情包；谷歌搜索也用它来做工具的安全防护层。

en.title: langchain-typesafe 0.1.0 - Bringing Type Safety to LangChain Applications
en.summary: This project is a tool that helps developers write safer and more reliable AI applications using LangChain by adding type safety. It solves the common headache of silent runtime bugs caused by data type mismatches in AI workflows. Key updates include dropping old Python versions to boost performance, and introducing a new classification decision model.
en.full_summary:
Overview

The langchain-typesafe library is designed to make building AI applications with LangChain much safer by enforcing strict type checking. As AI pipelines grow more complex, passing the wrong data types into prompts or chains can cause frustrating runtime errors. This tool catches those mistakes early during development.
What's New in 0.1.0

In this release, the project has dropped support for Python 3.10 to align with its end-of-life, setting Python 3.11 as the new minimum requirement. Additionally, it updates the minimum langchain-core requirement to version 1.8.0. Users staying on older Python versions can still use the 0.0.x branch.
Key Features

Beyond technical housekeeping, this update introduces a brand new TypeSafeClassifier designed to act as a reliable decision model within your AI workflows. Meanwhile, the older experimental middleware has been officially deprecated to streamline the codebase.

zh.title: langchain-typesafe 0.1.0 - 为 LangChain 应用带来类型安全
zh.summary: 这个项目是一个能帮开发者在使用 LangChain 时写出更安全、更可靠 AI 应用的工具，核心作用是引入了类型安全。它解决了 AI 工作流中因为数据类型对不上而引发各种隐藏报错的头疼问题。亮点包括放弃老旧 Python 版本以提升性能，并新增了一个分类决策模型。
zh.full_summary:
项目概述

langchain-typesafe 库旨在通过强制执行严格的类型检查，让使用 LangChain 构建 AI 应用变得更加安全。随着 AI 管道变得越来越复杂，将错误的数据类型传入提示词或链中往往会导致让人头疼的运行时错误。这个工具能够在开发阶段尽早发现这些错误。
0.1.0 版本更新说明

在这个新版本中，项目取消了对已停止维护的 Python 3.10 的支持，将 Python 3.11 设为了最低运行门槛。同时，它也将 langchain-core 的最低版本要求提升到了 1.8.0。还在使用老版本 Python 的用户可以继续使用 0.0.x 分支。
核心功能与改进

除了常规的技术升级，这次更新还引入了一个全新的 TypeSafeClassifier，用作你 AI 工作流中的可靠决策模型。同时，为了精简代码库，官方已经正式弃用了旧的实验性中间件。

en.title: MIT and Northeastern engineers design stronger, more resilient metamaterials inspired by nature
en.summary: According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing: Researchers have created a new type of metamaterial by introducing controlled disorder inspired by natural networks like leaf veins and dragonfly wings. Unlike traditional materials built from repeating identical blocks, these new materials use varying sizes of beams to distribute damage and absorb impacts much better. This breakthrough could lead to safer helmets, stronger armor, and advanced acoustic equipment.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing:

Background
For decades, synthetic metamaterials have been designed using a single building block, or unit cell, copied and pasted to form a precise, periodic microstructure. While this ordered approach improves overall performance, it has a major flaw: if one region cracks, the surrounding identical cells quickly buckle, leading to catastrophic failure.
Details
To overcome this limitation, a team from MIT and Northeastern University turned to network science, a field traditionally used to study complex systems like the internet or neural connections. Using a specialized algorithm, the researchers generated a physical network of intersecting beams with varying sizes and thicknesses, mimicking the web-like structures found in nature. By 3D-printing these patterns into polymer samples, they created scale-rich metamaterials that avoid the localization effect seen in ordered structures.
Impact
Physical tests showed that these network-inspired materials offer a widely controllable range of stiffness, resist sudden impacts more effectively, and can successfully cushion fragile objects. This design framework opens the door to next-generation protective gear, impact-absorbing structures, and specialized materials that control vibrations.

zh.title: 麻省理工和东北大学借鉴自然界网络，设计出更强韧的超材料
zh.summary: 据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：研究人员从叶脉和蜻蜓翅膀等自然界网络中汲取灵感，通过引入受控的无序性，创造出了一种新型超材料。与以往采用重复相同模块的传统材料不同，这种新材料利用不同尺寸的支撑梁来分散损伤并更好地吸收冲击力。这一突破有望应用于制造更安全的头盔、更坚固的护甲以及先进的声学设备。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：

背景
几十年来，合成超材料的设计通常采用单一建筑模块即所谓的单胞，通过复制和粘贴来形成精确的周期性微观结构。虽然这种有序的方法提升了整体性能，但它有一个重大缺陷：一旦某个区域出现裂纹，周围相同的单胞就会迅速屈曲，导致整个结构崩溃。
细节
为了克服这一局限，麻省理工学院和东北大学的研究团队将目光投向了通常用于研究互联网或神经连接等复杂系统的网络科学。研究人员利用专门的算法，生成了一个由大小和厚度各异的相交支撑梁组成的物理网络，模仿了自然界中的网状结构。通过将这些图案3D打印成聚合物样品，他们创造出了多尺度超材料，从而避免了有序结构中常见的局部失效效应。
影响
物理测试表明，这些受网络启发的材料具有可控的刚度范围，能更有效地抵抗突发冲击，并能成功缓冲易碎物品。这一设计框架为下一代防护装备、吸能结构以及控制振动的专用材料打开了大门。

en.title: AMSIS Appoints Steffen Reinfurth as Co-CEO
en.summary: AMSIS GmbH has named Steffen Reinfurth as co-CEO alongside founder Vasily Ploshikhin. Reinfurth will handle sales and strategy, while Ploshikhin focuses on research, as the company pushes to scale its metal additive manufacturing simulation software.
en.full_summary:
AMSIS GmbH has restructured its leadership by appointing Steffen Reinfurth as co-CEO alongside company founder Vasily Ploshikhin. Reinfurth, who previously served as Managing Director and CSO, brings two decades of experience in the additive manufacturing industry and previously founded AMECOS GmbH.

In the shared leadership model, Reinfurth will concentrate on sales, marketing, and product strategy. Meanwhile, Ploshikhin will direct his efforts toward innovation, research, and new technology development.

The leadership shift comes as AMSIS looks to transition from technology development to commercial industrialization. The company specializes in simulation software that connects the physics of metal additive manufacturing with practical factory decisions, helping manufacturers optimize their production processes.

zh.title: 3D打印模拟公司AMSIS任命Steffen Reinfurth为联席CEO
zh.summary: 3D打印模拟技术公司AMSIS任命Steffen Reinfurth为联席CEO，与创始人Vasily Ploshikhin共同管理公司。Reinfurth将主攻销售与战略，而创始人则专注于技术研发，此举旨在加速其金属3D打印模拟软件的商业化落地。
zh.full_summary:
3D打印模拟技术公司AMSIS近日调整了管理层结构，任命Steffen Reinfurth为联席CEO，与公司创始人Vasily Ploshikhin共同执掌企业。Reinfurth此前担任董事总经理兼首席科学官，在增材制造行业拥有长达二十年的丰富经验，此前还曾创立过专注于3D打印技术的咨询公司。

在全新的双CEO管理模式下，两人进行了明确的分工。Reinfurth将全面负责销售与产品战略，而创始人Ploshikhin则专注于底层技术创新与研发。

此次人事变动标志着AMSIS正从单纯的技术研发阶段，加速迈向商业化落地。该公司主打金属3D打印的物理仿真模拟技术，旨在帮助制造企业解决日常生产中的实际难题，优化生产流程。

en.title: Using Kidney Genetics to Make Clinical Trials More Precise
en.summary: Broad kidney disease labels often hide important biological differences, which can mess up clinical trials. In a recent podcast, Dr. Ronen Schneider from Natera explains how genetic testing combined with real-world health data helps drug developers find the right patient groups. By looking at genes alongside actual patient histories, teams can design better trials, pick the right goals, and avoid hidden surprises in their studies.
en.full_summary:
Background
Traditional labels for chronic kidney disease are often too broad, lumping together patients with very different underlying biology. This hidden diversity can cause clinical trials to fail or produce misleading results because the treatment is not being tested on the right people.
Details and Impact
Dr. Ronen Schneider discusses how tools like RenasightIQ combine genetic results with clinical histories, lab work, and insurance claims from over 300,000 patients. By evaluating genotypes as trial variables, drug developers can better understand natural disease progression, choose smarter endpoints, and improve patient recruitment. This approach helps teams spot hidden variations in past studies and stress-test future strategies using real-world data.

zh.title: 用肾脏遗传学让临床试验更精准
zh.summary: 笼统的慢性肾病标签常常掩盖了关键的生物学差异，从而给临床试验带来风险。Natera的肾脏遗传学医学总监Ronen Schneider博士在播客中解释了如何利用基因检测和纵向临床数据，帮助药物研发团队精准锁定患者群体。通过将基因结果与真实世界的病史相结合，研发团队能够优化试验设计、选择合适的终点并减少盲目性。
zh.full_summary:
背景
传统的慢性肾病分类往往过于宽泛，把底层生物学机制完全不同的患者混为一谈。这种隐藏的异质性会导致临床试验失败或结果产生误导，因为药物并没有针对真正对症的患者群体进行测试。
细节与影响
Ronen Schneider博士在节目中探讨了Natera的RenasightIQ如何将基因检测结果与来自30万多名患者的病史、实验室数据及理赔数据相结合。通过将基因型作为试验变量，药物研发团队可以更好地理解疾病的自然发展史、选择更准确的疗效终点，并优化患者招募。这种方法不仅能帮助团队重新审视以往研究中的盲区，还能利用真实世界数据对未来的研发策略进行压力测试。

en.title: PepGen shares almost double as DM1 oligonucleotide achieves 'best in class' splicing
en.summary: PepGen's experimental drug for myotonic dystrophy type 1 achieved a record splicing correction of 46.5% in a mid-stage clinical trial, outperforming competitors and causing its stock price to nearly double. The positive safety profile and potential for higher doses offer new hope for treating this rare genetic disease.
en.full_summary:
PepGen announced that its experimental oligonucleotide PGN-EDODM1 achieved a mean splicing correction of 46.5% at week 13 in a Phase 2 trial for myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1). This result significantly outperforms competitors like Dyne Therapeutics, Novartis, and Ionis, which have typically achieved less than 30% correction. Analysts praised the outcome as a best-case scenario, and the news sent PepGen's stock soaring 92% to $4.61.

Beyond genetic metrics, investigators noted meaningful clinical improvements in patients' muscle control, mobility, and grip strength. The data came from the lowest dose group of 10 mg/kg, and a higher 12.5 mg/kg dose arm is currently being evaluated, with results expected in the first half of 2027. Despite a lingering partial clinical hold from the FDA regarding animal safety data, PepGen successfully advanced trials internationally and launched a $125 million public offering to fund further development.

zh.title: PepGen股价暴涨近一倍，其治疗肌强直性营养不良的新药临床数据惊艳
zh.summary: 生物医药公司 PepGen 的罕见病新药在临床试验中取得了 创纪录的疗效，纠正率高达 46.5%，远远甩开行业竞争对手。这一重大突破直接带动该公司 股价几乎翻倍，为这种顽固的遗传病治疗带来了全新希望。
zh.full_summary:
生物医药公司 PepGen 近日宣布，其用于治疗 1 型肌强直性营养不良的药物 PGN-EDODM1 在二期临床试验中表现亮眼。在第 13 周时，患者平均基因剪接纠正率达到了 46.5%，远超竞争对手通常不到 30% 的水平。受此消息鼓舞，该公司股价单日暴涨 92%。

除了亮眼的实验室数据，研究人员还观察到患者在肌肉控制、行动能力和握力等方面出现了 实际功能改善。更令人期待的是，这只是最低剂量组的表现，更高剂量的试验结果预计在 2027 年上半年揭晓。尽管此前曾遭遇美国 FDA 的部分临床暂停，PepGen 依然凭借海外临床站点的亮眼数据，顺势启动了 1.25 亿美元的公开股票发售以推进后续研发。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker AI Adds Usage-Based Pricing for Real-Time Streaming
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon SageMaker AI is launching usage-based metering for bidirectional streaming inference, solving a long-standing billing headache for real-time speech AI. Previously, live audio streams lasting minutes couldn't easily report periodic consumption through traditional request-response headers. The new companion metadata streaming solution establishes a dedicated WebSocket alongside the inference stream, allowing model providers to report actual usage like audio seconds directly to AWS Marketplace. Deepgram serves as the launch partner for this feature.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

Background
Real-time speech AI applications like voice agents and live transcription rely on bidirectional streaming. However, billing for these long-lived sessions was difficult because traditional AWS Marketplace software metering only worked for standard request-response APIs, where the billable quantity is known instantly at the end of a request. For live streams lasting 30 minutes, hourly pricing often charged customers even during quiet periods, failing to reflect true consumption.
Technical Details
To fix this, Amazon SageMaker AI now opens a second WebSocket connection alongside the main data stream. This companion metadata connection operates on a dedicated path, allowing model servers to send JSON text frames reporting incremental usage. Providers send metrics using the inference.count dimension and ConsumedUnits quantities. Developers can choose whether a dropped metadata connection should terminate the inference session or continue in data-only mode, balancing reliability with metering continuity.
Industry Impact
This update fundamentally aligns software charges with actual consumption for real-time AI workloads. Enterprise customers benefit from consolidated AWS billing and private offers without managing separate vendor relationships, while model providers gain a standardized path to monetize streaming AI seamlessly through AWS Marketplace.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker AI 为实时流式传输推出按量计费功能
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊 SageMaker AI 推出了双向流式推理的按量计费功能，解决了实时语音 AI 长期以来的计费难题。过去，持续数分钟的实时音频流无法通过传统的请求响应头轻易报告期间消耗。全新的伴随元数据流方案在推理流旁建立了一个专用的 WebSocket，允许模型提供商将音频秒数等实际用量直接报告给 AWS Marketplace。语音 AI 公司 Deepgram 成为了这一功能的首发合作伙伴。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

背景
语音助手和实时转写等实时语音 AI 应用严重依赖双向流式传输。然而，为这些长时间运行的会话计费非常困难，因为传统的 AWS Marketplace 软件计费仅适用于标准的请求-响应 API，即可计费数量在请求结束时即可立即可知。对于持续长达 30 分钟的直播流，按小时计费往往在静默期也会向客户收费，无法真正反映实际消耗。
技术细节
为了解决这个问题，亚马逊 SageMaker AI 现在在主数据流旁开辟了第二条 WebSocket 连接。这个伴随的元数据连接运行在专用路径上，允许模型服务器发送报告增量用量的 JSON 文本帧。提供商使用 inference.count 维度和 ConsumedUnits 数量来发送指标。开发者可以自行选择当元数据连接断开时是终止推理会话还是继续进行纯数据模式，从而在可靠性与计费连续性之间取得平衡。
行业影响
这一更新从根本上将软件收费与实时 AI 工作负载的实际消耗进行了对齐。企业客户可以享受合并的 AWS 账单和私有优惠，无需管理单独的供应商关系；而模型提供商则获得了一条标准化通道，能够通过 AWS Marketplace 无缝实现流式 AI 的商业化。

en.title: Capricor pumps up spending and factory prep while waiting for FDA verdict on muscle disease drug
en.summary: Capricor Therapeutics saw its operating expenses surge 70% in the third quarter as it ramps up manufacturing for its upcoming Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy. With an FDA decision looming, the company's San Diego facility is fully prepped for an initial launch, though past regulatory hurdles and a mixed advisory vote still cast some uncertainty over the approval.
en.full_summary:
Capricor Therapeutics has significantly accelerated its financial and operational preparations ahead of a crucial FDA decision regarding its cell therapy, deramiocel, scheduled for November 22. During the third quarter, the company's spending jumped to $44.7 million, marking a 70% increase compared to the same period last year, driven primarily by precommercial activities and the scale-up of manufacturing capabilities at its San Diego facility.

During a recent earnings call, CEO Linda Marbán confirmed that the first-floor cleanroom is fully operational, having passed a pre-license inspection and equipped to supply doses for up to 250 patients annually. Furthermore, Capricor is already expanding into the second floor to eventually support 2,000 to 2,500 patients per year, with validation scheduled for the first half of next year.

Despite these proactive measures, the path to commercialization remains bumpy. Capricor's previous filing faced rejection due to manufacturing deficiencies, and an advisory committee recently voted against the therapy, leaving its approval status uncertain. If the FDA rejects the current application, company leadership plans to carefully evaluate the feedback to determine if additional clinical trials are warranted.

zh.title: 等待FDA裁决之际，Capricor加大生产投入为新药上市做准备
zh.summary: 随着杜氏肌营养不良症细胞疗法即将迎来FDA裁决，Capricor Therapeutics在第三季度的运营费用大幅飙升70%。尽管此前曾遭遇监管阻力且顾问委员会投票遇挫，该公司位于圣迭戈的工厂目前已做好了上市前的生产准备，全力迎接即将到来的关键时刻。
zh.full_summary:
在迎来针对其细胞疗法deramiocel的关键FDA裁决前夕，Capricor Therapeutics大幅加快了资金投入与生产准备步伐。第三季度，该公司的支出飙升至4470万美元，比去年同期增长了70%，主要用于扩大圣迭戈工厂的产能以及开展各项上市前的筹备工作。

公司CEO琳达·马尔班在财报电话会议上表示，圣迭戈工厂的一层洁净室已经准备就绪，不仅通过了上市前的检查，还能每年为多达250名患者提供药物。与此同时，公司正在对二楼进行产能扩展，预计在完成验证后，年产能将提升至2000到2500名患者水平，以满足长期的市场需求。

不过，该疗法的商业化之路并非一帆风顺。由于此前曾因生产和化学控制问题遭到FDA拒绝，加上近期顾问委员会投出了反对票，外界对此次能否顺利获批仍存疑虑。如果此次未能获得FDA批准，管理层表示将审慎评估反馈，考虑是否需要通过进一步的临床试验来证明其有效性与安全性。

en.title: AlphaGenome 2 predicts how DNA changes affect specific human cells
en.summary: According to Google DeepMind: Google has announced AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that predicts how DNA sequence variations impact specific human cell types and disease states. Trained on over 100 million individual cell profiles, the model identifies twice as many causal variants as its predecessor, helping scientists uncover the cellular roots of various diseases.
en.full_summary:
According to Google DeepMind:

AlphaGenome 2 is a next-generation DNA sequence model designed to bridge the gap between single-cell biology and human genetics. Unlike the original version which analyzed broad tissues in parallel, AlphaGenome 2 uses a conditional architecture to evaluate how a million-letter DNA sequence behaves in one specific cell type or state at a time. Trained on over 107 million individual cell profiles from humans and mice, the model can predict gene expression, chromatin accessibility, and DNA methylation across specialized cells. It can also generalize to unseen cell states, such as those triggered by diseases or vaccinations, without requiring retraining.

In benchmark tests, AlphaGenome 2 successfully identified nearly twice as many causal variants and directional gene effects compared to previous tools. It has already demonstrated the ability to pinpoint complex disease drivers, such as identifying a regulatory variant that overactivates the ETS2 gene in gut immune cells to cause inflammatory bowel disease. The tool is now available for non-commercial research via an API, with commercial access offered in private preview, and future integration planned for Google's agentic development platform.

zh.title: AlphaGenome 2 能预测基因变异如何影响特定人体细胞
zh.summary: 据Google DeepMind发布的信息：谷歌发布了全新人工智能模型 AlphaGenome 2，它可以预测基因变异如何影响特定的人体细胞类型与疾病状态。该模型通过学习超过一亿个单细胞数据，能识别出两倍于前代模型的致病变异，帮助科学家更好地找出疾病的细胞根源。
zh.full_summary:
据Google DeepMind发布的信息：

AlphaGenome 2 是一款旨在连接单细胞生物学与人类遗传学的新一代 DNA 序列模型。与前代版本同时分析广泛组织不同，AlphaGenome 2 采用了条件架构，每次针对一种特定的细胞类型或状态来评估百万长度的 DNA 序列。该模型在超过 1.07 亿个来自人类和小鼠的单细胞剖面上进行训练，能够预测基因表达、染色质可及性以及 DNA 甲基化。它还具备极强的泛化能力，无需重新训练就能适应疾病或疫苗接种等未见过的细胞状态。

在基准测试中，AlphaGenome 2 识别出的致病变异和定向基因效应数量达到了前代工具的近两倍。它已经展现出精确定位复杂疾病驱动因素的能力，例如在肠道免疫细胞中找出了导致炎症性肠病的调控变异。目前，该模型已通过 API 向非商业研究人员开放，商业研究则提供私密预览，未来还计划整合到谷歌的智能代理开发平台中。

en.title: Databricks' new AI agent acts as a truth-teller for CEOs
en.summary: Databricks has launched an upgraded version of its AI agent Genie, designed to handle complex, multi-step business tasks completely on its own. CEO Ali Ghodsi demonstrated how he uses the tool internally to get unfiltered feedback, such as analyzing employee survey complaints and reviewing failed sales pitches. This unvarnished truth helps leaders overcome communication barriers in large organizations where subordinates often hide bad news from top management.
en.full_summary:
Databricks recently updated its AI agent Genie, giving it the ability to execute multi-step tasks using a custom-built enterprise context ontology. During a live demonstration, CEO Ali Ghodsi showed how he relies on the agent for internal operations, including evaluating low scores on employee satisfaction surveys, summarizing poorly executed sales pitches, and prepping for public appearances.

The core value of this tool lies in solving a classic corporate challenge known as Dunbar's number. As companies grow past 150 employees, CEOs lose direct personal connections, and employees become hesitant to deliver negative news upward. Genie acts as an autonomous sounding board that bypasses corporate filters, surfacing operational issues that leaders urgently need to address.

To address enterprise adoption concerns, Ghodsi noted that Genie can run safely on internal company data without privacy risks. Furthermore, companies can manage the rising financial costs of running AI agents by utilizing Databricks’ Unity Gateway, which allows organizations to set strict usage limits and swap in more affordable open-weight models.

zh.title: Databricks 新推出的 AI 智能体成了大老板的“实话实说”神器
zh.summary: Databricks 推出了升级版的 AI 智能体 Genie，能够独立完成需要长时间处理的复杂多步骤工作。公司 CEO 阿里·戈德西演示了他如何用这个工具获取毫无粉饰的实话，比如分析员工满意度调查中的差评以及复盘失败的销售陈述。这种能力帮助大公司的领导者突破沟通壁垒，听到平时下属不敢对高管直言的真实反馈。
zh.full_summary:
Databricks 最近升级了旗下的 AI 智能体 Genie，让它能够借助企业内部的数据上下文，自主完成需要多个步骤的长周期工作。在实际演示中，公司 CEO 阿里·戈德西展示了他是如何利用这个工具处理内部事务的，包括分析员工满意度调查中的低分原因、总结搞砸的销售拜访，以及为公开访谈做准备。

这个工具的核心价值在于解决了企业管理中的邓巴数效应。当公司规模超过 150 人时，CEO 很难与所有人保持直接联系，员工面对高管时往往报喜不报忧。Genie 就像是一个能够绕过企业层级过滤的自动化助手，帮领导者挖出那些必须面对的真实问题。

为了打消企业的顾虑，戈德西表示 Genie 能够安全地处理企业内部数据，避免了隐私泄露的风险。同时，针对企业担心 AI 智能体带来高昂使用成本的问题，Databricks 提供了 Unity Gateway 产品，允许公司设置使用上限并随时替换更便宜的开源模型。

en.title: Faeth’s oral cancer combo clears phase 2, challenging big drug injection therapies
en.summary: Faeth Therapeutics reported that its oral cancer therapy combination, called Piktor, hit key efficacy goals in a phase 2 trial for endometrial cancer. The drug achieved a 33% confirmed overall response rate, outperforming expectations and offering a pill-based alternative to injectable treatments like ADCs and chemotherapies.
en.full_summary:
Faeth Therapeutics tested its combination therapy, named Piktor—consisting of serabelisib and sapanisertib—alongside intravenous paclitaxel in 42 patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer. The trial yielded a 33% confirmed overall response rate and a preliminary median progression-free survival of 7.4 months. These results surpass the 30% response rate benchmark set by market analysts, rivaling standard injectable options like immunotherapies and antibody-drug conjugates.

While major pharmaceutical companies heavily focus on injectable antibody-drug conjugates that often rely on topoisomerase I inhibitors, patient resistance remains a challenge. Faeth's oral approach targets the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway at multiple points, offering a distinct mechanism of action. The company now plans to discuss a randomized phase 3 trial with the FDA and expects to release data from an ongoing breast cancer study next year.

zh.title: 派森生物口服抗癌组合二期临床数据过关，向注射大分子疗法发起挑战
zh.summary: 派森生物宣布，其研发的口服抗癌药物组合在一项子宫内膜癌二期临床试验中达到关键疗效目标。该疗法取得了33%的确认客观缓解率，表现超越预期，有望为患者提供一种替代注射疗法的口服新选择。
zh.full_summary:
派森生物对其名为Piktor的口服药物组合（包含serabelisib和sapanisertib）进行了二期临床试验，并联合紫杉醇治疗42名晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌患者。试验结果显示，该疗法的确认客观缓解率为33%，初步中位无进展生存期为7.4 months。这一表现超过了分析师预期的30%达标线，足以媲美目前的免疫疗法和抗体偶联药物等注射治疗方案。

目前大型药企多押注于需要注射的抗体偶联药物，但患者容易对这类药物产生耐药性。派森生物的口服疗法通过多靶点抑制PI3K/AKT/mTOR通路，提供了差异化的作用机制。该公司计划与美国食药监局沟通推进三阶段随机临床试验，并预计在明年公布乳腺癌相关临床数据。

en.title: Kyorin pays $140M for Japan rights to Edesa’s respiratory drug
en.summary: Edesa Biotech has partnered with Kyorin Pharmaceutical to bring its late-stage respiratory drug to Japan in a deal worth up to $140 million. Kyorin will handle all local development and commercialization costs, while also gaining a first refusal right for other potential medical uses.
en.full_summary:
Edesa Biotech has signed a licensing agreement with Japan's Kyorin Pharmaceutical for its anti-TLR4 antibody, paridiprubart, aimed at treating acute respiratory distress syndrome. Kyorin is paying $12 million upfront and could shell out up to $134 million in milestone payments, alongside royalties.

Paridiprubart previously showed promise in a phase 3 study involving COVID-19 patients, prompting Edesa to broaden its focus toward general ARDS. Recent exploratory analyses also suggested the drug could help patients suffering from ARDS and acute kidney injury simultaneously. Kyorin will fully fund local development and plans to leverage its existing respiratory expertise to push the treatment forward in Japan.

zh.title: 杏林制药斥资1.4亿美元获得Edesa呼吸系统药物日本独家权益
zh.summary: Edesa生物技术公司与杏林制药达成合作，将旗下的后期呼吸系统药物引入日本，交易总额高达1.4亿美元。杏林制药将承担在日本的所有开发和商业化费用，并获得其他潜在适应症的优先谈判权。
zh.full_summary:
Edesa生物技术公司与日本杏林制药达成了一项重磅许可协议，将其用于治疗急性呼吸窘迫综合征的抗TLR4抗体paridiprubart引入日本市场。根据协议，杏林制药将支付1200万美元首付款，未来还将支付高达1.34亿美元的里程碑款项以及销售提成。

此前，这款抗体在一项针对新冠引起的急性呼吸窘迫综合征的3期临床试验中表现出良好潜力，促使Edesa将研发重点扩展至更广泛的适应症。近期的探索性分析还表明，该药物对伴有急性肾损伤的患者同样具有降低死亡率的潜力。杏林制药将全资负责该药在日本的开发和商业化，并希望凭借其在呼吸道疾病领域的经验，推动这款创新疗法在日本落地。

en.title: Looking Beyond the First Answer Towards Delivering Impact
en.summary: Scientific research rarely gives a simple first answer, and real progress often comes from looking beyond setbacks to find new questions. Ipsen's Chief Business Officer shares how looking past failed hypotheses in areas like rare diseases and oncology can lead to valuable new treatments through smart partnerships and acquisitions.
en.full_summary:
Looking Beyond Setbacks
In drug development, a failed hypothesis in one disease area does not mean the underlying science is dead. For instance, data that missed expectations in treating liver diseases can sometimes point toward effective paths in primary biliary cholangitis, showing that biochemical markers can reveal hidden potential if researchers are willing to look differently.
Strategic Acquisitions and Expertise
Companies must combine deep therapeutic expertise with the courage to pursue overlooked opportunities. Ipsen's moves, such as acquiring Memo Therapeutics for kidney-related conditions and Kartos Therapeutics for oncology, highlight how complete data analysis can guide companies into new fields without starting from scratch.
The Future of Medicine
The future of healthcare will not rely on repeatedly asking the same dead-end questions. True innovation demands the discipline to follow evidence and the courage to pivot, turning unexpected scientific outcomes into meaningful therapies for patients.

zh.title: 不被最初的结果局限，在医药研发中寻找新可能
zh.summary: 科学研究很少能一帆风顺地给出简单答案，真正的突破往往来自于看透挫折并提出新问题。易普森的首席业务官分享了如何在罕见病和肿瘤等领域的失败假设中，通过明智的合作与收购，找到全新的治疗机会。
zh.full_summary:
透过挫折看本质
在药物研发中，某个疾病领域的假设失败并不意味着底层科学走到了尽头。例如，在肝病治疗中未能达到预期的临床数据，有时反而能为原发性胆汁性胆管炎指明有效的方向，这表明只要研究人员愿意换个角度思考，生物标志物就能揭示出隐藏的价值。
战略收购与专业积累
药企必须将深厚的治疗领域专业知识与探索被忽视机会的勇气结合起来。易普森收购专注于肾脏相关疾病的 Memo Therapeutics 以及专注于肿瘤学的 Kartos Therapeutics 等举措，充分说明了全面分析数据如何能够引领企业无需从零开始就进入全新领域。
医药行业的未来
医疗健康的未来不取决于重复那些走进死胡同的老问题。真正的创新需要遵循证据的纪律和勇于转换方向的决心，将意料之外的科学结果转化为真正造福患者的疗法。

en.title: Adobe's new AI experiments let you walk inside photos and interview virtual characters
en.summary: Adobe has previewed several experimental AI features at its Max conference, including tools that turn flat photos into explorable 3D scenes, let you build animated characters through FaceTime-like conversations, and simplify audio mixing and photo editing. These tech previews hint at how future creative workflows might become more intuitive.
en.full_summary: Adobe's annual Max conference showcased a new batch of experimental AI tools known as 'sneaks,' focusing on making complex creative tasks more intuitive. Project Screen Test allows users to develop AI characters by holding conversations with them to define their personalities, backstories, and voices before generating animated scenes. Another tool, Project Sight Span, transforms flat images into 3D environments where users can navigate, change perspectives, and generate missing backgrounds. Additionally, Project Sound Bender offers real-time audio mixing on a color-wheel-like canvas, and Project Rinse Repeat automatically applies intricate photo edits to multiple subjects in a single image. While these are currently just tech previews with no guaranteed release, they reflect Adobe's strategy to integrate generative AI deeper into its Creative Cloud platform.

zh.title: Adobe 最新 AI 实验功能让你走进照片并现场面试虚拟角色
zh.summary: Adobe 在年度大会上展示了一批实验性 AI 功能，包括能把平面照片变成 3D 探索空间、通过像视频通话一样聊天来 塑造动画角色，以及简化音频和修图的工具。这些前瞻技术展示了未来创意工作将变得多么直观好用。
zh.full_summary: Adobe 在年度 Max 大会上展示了一批被称为“Sneaks”的实验性 AI 工具，旨在让复杂的创作流程变得更直观。其中，“Project Screen Test”允许用户通过与 AI 角色进行类似视频通话的对话来设定其性格和背景，从而更精准地生成动画角色。另一项功能“Project Sight Span”能把普通平面照片变成 3D 场景，让用户在里面自由走动并改变视角。此外，“Project Sound Bender”提供了一种通过方块画布实时混音的有趣方式，“Project Rinse Repeat”则能把复杂的修图效果一键复制到照片中的其他人身上。虽然这些功能目前只是技术预览，不一定会全部上线，但它们清楚地表明了 Adobe 正加速将生成式 AI 融入其创意生态中。

en.title: Plurai raises $13 million to make AI agents reliable using autonomous driving tech
en.summary: AI agents are great at demos, but they frequently fail in real-world corporate environments because they can't handle unexpected scenarios. A startup called Plurai has raised $13 million to fix this problem by applying autonomous driving simulation techniques to business software. By creating a digital twin of a company's systems, Plurai helps train smaller, open-weight models that perform better and cost significantly less than big frontier models.
en.full_summary:
The Problem with AI Agents
While AI agents are generating massive hype, benchmarks show they still struggle to function without heavy supervision. Much like early autonomous driving software, agents operate probabilistically in unpredictable environments, leading to costly mistakes like ignoring corporate policies or breaking down when handling multiple datasets.
The Autonomous Driving Solution
Plurai's founders, veterans of autonomous vehicle tech, realized that AI agents face the exact same reliability hurdles that self-driving cars once did. To solve this, Plurai builds a digital twin of a company's electronic systems, mapping out potential agent workflows and generating synthetic data to prepare models for tricky edge cases.
Future Impact
Beyond simply testing agents, Plurai uses its collected data to post-train small, open-weight models tailored to specific businesses. Tests show these customized models can outperform mid-tier frontier models at a fraction of the cost, giving IT leaders a sustainable way to deploy AI without breaking the bank on massive general-purpose models.

zh.title: 初创公司 Plurai 获 1300 万美元融资，想用自动驾驶技术治好 AI 代理的“不靠谱”
zh.summary: 现在的 AI 代理虽然听起来很厉害，但在真实工作里却经常掉链子，遇到复杂情况就容易出错。一家名叫 Plurai 的初创公司最近拿到了 1300 万美元融资，他们打算把自动驾驶的模拟测试技术搬到企业软件里。通过给公司的电子系统弄个“数字双胞胎”，他们能帮企业训练出更便宜、更好用的专属 AI 模型，解决大模型用不起、记不住的问题。
zh.full_summary:
AI 代理的痛点
虽然各种 AI 代理现在被吹得天花雀 organisational，但实际测试表明，它们离开人工盯着根本没法独立干活。就像当年的自动驾驶一样，AI 代理在面对复杂的真实环境时总是概率性地犯错，比如订机票时忘了公司的报销政策，或者处理多个数据库时直接死机。
自动驾驶的降维打击
Plurai 的创始人有着自动驾驶技术的背景，他们发现 AI 代理面临的难题和当年的无人车如出一辙。为了解决这个问题，Plurai 会为公司的电子系统做一个“数字双胞胎”，把所有可能的业务流程画成图，并利用合成数据让 AI 模型提前经历各种奇葩边缘情况的考验。
行业实际影响
除了测试代理，Plurai 还能利用收集到的数据去微调小型的开源模型。测试表明，这些量体裁衣的小模型不仅效果能赶超大牌大模型，成本还能降低几个数量级。对于想要控制成本的企业 IT 负责人来说，这种方式提供了一条更务实的落地路径。

en.title: AI100 2026 report highlights embodied intelligence as a grand challenge
en.summary: The AI100 2026 report points out that while generative AI is booming, physical AI remains a major hurdle. Despite rapid progress in robotics, bridging the gap between lab demos and real-world deployment requires solving complex physical world challenges.
en.full_summary:
Background
The AI100 is a long-term study that checks in every five years on how artificial intelligence is changing society. The 2026 edition looks at everything from generative AI scaling to cybersecurity, international governance, and scientific discovery.
Key Details
Experts highlighted six grand challenges, putting embodied intelligence at the top for robotics. Over the past five years, robotics has seen massive leaps by combining natural language processing with vision-language-action models. Notably, the report highlights that China leads in industrial robots and humanoid robot production.
Real-World Impact
Despite cool demos, a huge gap exists between testing capabilities and actual deployment outside controlled environments like warehouses. Overcoming the real-world complexity requires breakthroughs in long-horizon planning, dexterous manipulation, and potentially new learning paradigms.

zh.title: AI100最新报告发布：具身智能被列为核心大挑战
zh.summary: 最新的AI100 2026报告指出，尽管生成式AI发展火热，但具身智能依然是行业面临的重大挑战。虽然机器人技术进步飞快，但要真正走出实验室应对复杂现实，还有很长的路要走。
zh.full_summary:
背景介绍
AI100是一个每五年评估一次人工智能发展及其社会影响的长期项目。2026年的最新报告重点关注了生成式AI规模化、网络安全、国际治理以及科学发现等多个维度的变化。
关键细节
专家组在报告中提出了六大科学挑战，其中具身智能对机器人领域最为关键。过去五年里，通过将自然语言处理与视觉语言行动模型相结合，机器人技术取得了飞跃。报告还特别指出，中国在工业机器人和人形机器人产量上处于全球领先地位。
实际影响
尽管各种酷炫的演示层出不穷，但在仓库等受控环境之外，实验室能力与实际落地之间仍存在巨大鸿沟。要攻克现实世界的复杂性，行业需要在长期规划和灵巧操作上取得突破，甚至可能需要全新的学习方法。

en.title: Baidu Unveils Ernie 5.5 Flash Preview, Mastering End-to-End Coding for Games and 3D
en.summary: Baidu just dropped its new Ernie 5.5 Flash Preview model, focusing heavily on advanced programming capabilities. Beyond writing simple code, this model can independently handle complex end-to-end tasks like generating 3D environments, building playable games, and editing videos using automated loops, matching top-tier global competitors.
en.full_summary:
Key Features
The new Ernie 5.5 Flash Preview boasts 280-billion total parameters, activating only 14-billion per inference, while supporting a 1-million token context window and generating over 200 tokens per second.
Practical Capabilities
Unlike traditional AI assistants that require human supervision for debugging, this model uses execution trajectories and automated loops. It runs code in real environments, inspects visual or logical errors, and fixes them iteratively, successfully generating a playable browser game and a full Blender garden from scratch.
Ecosystem Impact
Baidu announced that the model weights will soon be open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, alongside discounted API pricing on the Qianfan platform, lowering the barrier for developers to build complex applications.

zh.title: 纯代码造游戏建模！百度发布文心5.5 Flash Preview并宣布即将开源
zh.summary: 百度刚刚发布了全新的文心5.5 Flash Preview模型，这次把技能点全加在了编程上。它不仅能写代码，还能独立完成游戏开发、3D建模和视频编排等复杂任务，实现真正的端到端交付，实力足以和全球顶尖模型正面硬刚。
zh.full_summary:
核心亮点
百度这次推出的文心5.5 Flash Preview总参数量达到2800亿，单次推理仅激活140亿参数。它支持百万级上下文，生成速度超过每秒200个Token，在编程与Agent评测中展现出了极强的竞争力。
复杂任务处理
传统AI写代码往往需要人类全程陪跑帮忙调试，而文心5.5通过引入Agent执行轨迹和自动循环机制，能够自己在真实环境中运行代码、检查错误并不断修改，最终无需人工介入就能搓出能玩的网页游戏或3D苏州园林。
开源与生态
为了让开发者真正用起来，百度宣布该模型即将采用Apache 2.0许可证开源，同时在智能云千帆平台推出API限时五折优惠，大大降低了开发者的使用门槛。

en.title: BioSpace launches tracker for 2026 biotech IPOs
en.summary: BioSpace is launching a weekly tracker to monitor the stock performance of U.S. biotechs that go public in 2026. After a long dry spell, biotech IPOs are finally making a comeback, but keeping an eye on how they perform after their debut is crucial for the industry.
en.full_summary: BioSpace has introduced a dedicated IPO dashboard designed to follow U.S. biotechnology companies making their public market debuts in 2026. Following a prolonged period of sluggish activity where new listings were rare, the sector is experiencing a resurgence in public offerings. However, successfully ringing the opening bell is merely the first hurdle for these companies. The new tool aims to provide continuous transparency by refreshing weekly on Wednesdays, capturing the latest closing prices and incorporating newly listed firms to help industry observers evaluate post-debut trajectory.

zh.title: 生物科技媒体推出2026年上市药企表现追踪看板
zh.summary: 生物科技媒体 BioSpace 推出了一款全新看板，用来追踪 2026年上市 的美国生物科技公司的股票表现。经历了一段长时间的低谷后，药企IPO终于回暖，但大家更关心的其实是它们 上市后的表现 到底怎么样。
zh.full_summary: 生物科技媒体 BioSpace 近期上线了一个专门的IPO追踪面板，旨在实时观察 2026 年在美国上市的生物医药公司的股价走势。过去几年里，新股上市一直处于冷清状态，如今这一板块终于迎来了复苏的迹象。不过，对这些初创药企来说，成功敲钟上市只是第一步，后续的市场表现才是真正考验。为了让业内人士看得更清楚，这个追踪页面会在每周三进行更新，不仅提供最新的收盘价数据，还会随时把新上市的公司加进来，方便大家随时了解它们的真实战绩。

en.title: AI Datacentres Plan Massive On-Site Gas Power Stations Despite Climate Risks
en.summary: Developers of AI datacentres across the US, UK, and Europe are planning to build on-site gas power stations on a huge scale, aiming to generate 181 gigawatts of fossil-fuel capacity. Driven by the urgent need for power, this massive rollout risks locking in high carbon emissions that could equal the annual pollution of millions of cars.
en.full_summary:
Background
As the artificial intelligence boom drives up electricity demand, data centre developers face severe delays in connecting to national power grids. To bypass these bottlenecks and achieve faster power delivery, companies in the US, the UK, and mainland Europe are turning to fossil fuels.
Key Details
According to research by BloombergNEF, planned data centres across these regions propose building on-site gas-fired capacity totaling 181 gigawatts. About 90% of these projects are planned in the US, where they could emit roughly 345 million metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent annually, matching the emissions of about 72.8 million cars. By 2035, global AI data centre electricity demand is predicted to nearly quadruple to 2,354 terawatt-hours, accounting for 7% of global demand.
Impact
While developers claim these gas generators are temporary measures while waiting for grid access, experts warn that economic incentives once they are online could keep them running for years. In the UK, the government has even greenlit temporary on-site fossil fuel generation for fast-tracked data centres, sparking strong criticism from environmental campaigners over long-term climate commitments.

zh.title: 由于电网连接延迟，AI 数据中心计划大规模自建燃气电厂
zh.summary: 由于接入国家电网的等待时间太长，美国、英国和欧洲的 AI 数据中心开发商正计划大规模自建燃气电厂，总发电能力高达 181吉瓦。这种追求建设速度的做法不仅加剧了气候风险，还可能导致长期的化石燃料锁定隐患。
zh.full_summary:
背景情况
随着人工智能行业的爆发式增长，数据中心对电力的需求呈指数级飙升。然而，由于国家电网的接入审批和建设滞后，开发商们面临着巨大的“用电荒”。为了尽快让设施投入运营，欧美许多数据中心开始把目光转向自建发电设施。
关键细节
根据彭博新能源财经（BloombergNEF）的研究显示，美、英及欧洲大陆计划中的数据中心正提议建设总计 181吉瓦 的燃气发电能力。其中，约 90% 的项目计划在美国落地，每年可能产生约 3.45 亿吨的二氧化碳当量，相当于 7280万辆 燃气汽车的年碳排放量。预测显示，到 2035 年，AI 数据中心的用电量将激增至原来的近四倍。
行业影响
虽然开发商声称这些燃气发电厂只是等待电网连接期间的临时措施，但专家和环保人士普遍担忧，一旦这些发电机组建成并投入运行，巨大的经济效益可能会诱使企业长期使用，从而带来持久的碳排放风险。例如，英国政府近期已允许部分重点数据中心在等待期间建设并运行临时化石燃料电厂，引发了外界对气候承诺能否兑现的强烈质疑。

en.title: IBM Announces 2026 As The Year Of Quantum Advantage And Outlines Future Roadmap
en.summary: According to IBM Quantum: The research community has reached quantum advantage in 2026, executing verifiable computations beyond classical methods. IBM introduced its fastest processor yet, the Nighthawk r2, which delivers a 25x throughput gain over previous generations and supports complex workloads with over 7,500 quantum operations.
en.full_summary:
According to IBM Quantum:

Hardware and Speed
IBM introduced the Nighthawk r2 processor, featuring 120 programmable qubits and square-lattice connectivity. It achieves up to 100,000 samples per second, a 25x throughput increase compared to Heron. This speed enables researchers to execute frontier circuits more efficiently and serve as a proving ground for future error correction.
Path to Starling and Integrations
Looking toward the 2029 fault-tolerant system IBM Quantum Starling, IBM is co-designing components in parallel, reducing Josephson junctions by half and demonstrating reliable chip-to-chip interconnects using l-couplers. On the software side, new managed workflows and directed execution models allow teams to scale hybrid quantum-classical workloads across billions of samples.
Practical Applications
With 39 active or completed client projects in 2026, IBM is translating verified performance into real-world solutions across chemistry, materials, energy, and finance. Tools like Qiskit Fermions and the optimization mapper are helping industries tackle complex problems, including protein-ligand simulations and energy grid optimizations.

zh.title: IBM 宣布 2026 年为量子优势元年并公布未来发展路线图
zh.summary: 据IBM Quantum发布的信息：研究界在 2026 年正式实现了量子优势，运行了超越传统方法且可严格验证的计算。IBM 推出了迄今为止最快的处理器 Nighthawk r2，其吞吐量比上一代提升了 25 倍，支持超过 7,500 次量子操作的复杂工作负载。
zh.full_summary:
据IBM Quantum发布的信息：

硬件与速度突破
IBM 推出了全新的 Nighthawk r2 处理器，拥有 120 个可编程量子比特及方格晶格连接。它的重置架构实现了每秒高达 10万 个样本的吞吐量，比 Heron 提升了 25 倍。这种高速特性使研究人员能够高效运行前沿电路，并为未来的纠错技术提供绝佳的测试平台。
容错路线与集成层
迈向 Starling 与系统集成
为了实现在 2029 年推出容错量子计算机 IBM Quantum Starling 的目标，IBM 正在并行共设计各项组件，将每个模块的约瑟夫森结数量减半，并成功利用 l-coupler 实现了可靠的芯片间连接。在软件方面，全新的托管工作流与定向执行模型让团队能够跨数十亿个样本扩展混合量子经典工作负载。
实际应用落地
凭借 2026 年多达 39 个进行中或已完成的客户项目，IBM 正在将验证过的量子性能转化为化学、材料、能源和金融等领域的实际解决方案。Qiskit Fermions 和优化映射器等新工具正帮助各行各业解决复杂问题，包括蛋白质配体模拟和电网优化。

en.title: Novartis Gene Therapy Faces Tumor Probe, FDA Warns on GLP-1 Eye Risks
en.summary: Novartis's gene therapy Zolgensma is under FDA investigation after nine patients developed tumors. Meanwhile, the FDA requires a safety warning for all GLP-1 weight loss drugs regarding a rare vision-threatening eye condition, as the agency faces a busy month of drug decisions.
en.full_summary: This week in biotech brings several major regulatory and clinical updates. Novartis confirmed that nine patients receiving its spinal muscular atrophy gene therapy Zolgensma have developed tumors, prompting an FDA investigation. Additionally, Novartis and Ionis shared details from their failed cardiovascular trial for pelacarsen, casting doubt on targeting lipoprotein(a). In regulatory news, the FDA is ordering all 12 market-approved GLP-1 receptor agonists, including popular drugs from Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly, to add labels warning of a rare eye disease that can cause blindness. Meanwhile, the FDA faces a stacked November schedule with decisions expected on therapies from Summit Therapeutics, Vertex, and Capricor Therapeutics.

zh.title: 诺华基因疗法面临肿瘤调查，FDA对GLP-1眼部风险发出警告
zh.summary: 诺华的基因疗法Zolgensma因9名患者长出肿瘤而遭到FDA调查。同时，因存在引发罕见眼病的风险，FDA要求所有GLP-1减肥药加上安全警告，并且本月该机构还将对多款新药做出审批决定。
zh.full_summary: 本周生物医药行业迎来了多项重磅监管和临床进展。诺华证实，使用其脊髓性肌萎缩症基因疗法Zolgensma的患者中有9人长出了肿瘤，这引发了FDA的调查。此外，诺华与合作伙伴Ionis公布了其心血管药物pelacarsen失败试验的详细数据，这让外界对靶向脂蛋白(a)的疗效产生了更多质疑。在监管方面，FDA要求市场上所有12款获批的GLP-1受体激动剂（包括诺和诺德和礼来的热门药物）更新标签，警告可能增加罕见眼病的风险。同时，FDA在这个11月面临着繁重的审批任务，将对Summit Therapeutics、Vertex和Capricor Therapeutics等公司的多款疗法做出最终决定。

en.title: Google uses AI to recreate the early memories of legendary artist Dr. Esther Mahlangu
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google Arts & Culture launched the first online retrospective for 91-year-old South African artist Dr. Esther Mahlangu. Because her early life before 1980 had no photo records, the team used synthetic memories and Google's Veo video technology to recreate her childhood stories, showing how AI can help preserve cultural heritage.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

Background
Google Arts & Culture teamed up with curators, researchers, and tech experts to celebrate the 91st birthday of Dr. Esther Mahlangu, a legendary South African artist famous for her vibrant, traditional Ndebele patterns.
Details
While gathering materials for her online retrospective, the team realized that her life before 1980 was missing from archives. To fill this gap, they worked with Google DeepMind and design studios to launch a synthetic memories project. By conducting interviews and workshops with Mahlangu, they collected stories from her childhood, such as discovering her painting talent at age 10. They then generated still images and used Veo to turn memories into videos.
Impact
