This project features over 45 stories and exhibits, proving that advanced tools like AI can creatively bridge historical gaps while respecting personal memories, offering a fresh way to protect and share global art history.

zh.title: 谷歌利用AI还原了传奇艺术家埃丝特·马兰古早年的珍贵记忆
zh.summary: 据Google AI发布的信息：谷歌艺术与文化平台为91岁的南非国宝级艺术家埃丝特·马兰古推出了首个在线回顾展。由于她1980年之前的早年生活缺乏影像记录，团队通过AI合成记忆技术和谷歌的Veo视频工具，把她口述的童年故事还原成了动态画面，展示了科技在文化遗产保护中的新玩法。
zh.full_summary:
据Google AI发布的信息：

背景介绍
谷歌艺术与文化平台联合多方策展人和研究人员，为南非传奇艺术家埃丝特·马兰古庆祝91岁生日，并推出了她的首个大型在线回顾展，向这位用艺术惊艳世界的女性致敬。
技术细节
在整理展览资料时，策展团队发现马兰古1980年之前的生平几乎是一片空白，没有任何影像或照片留存。为了补全这段历史，团队联合谷歌DeepMind以及设计工作室，开启了一项“合成记忆”项目。通过与马兰古深入访谈，他们收集了她从10岁起学画画的口述故事，然后利用AI根据这些描述生成图像，并用Veo视频工具把老人的早期记忆变成影像。
行业影响
这个线上回顾展收录了超过45个故事与展览。它不仅向全球展示了马兰古的艺术生涯，更重要的是，它为整个人类社会提供了一种新思路：如何用尊重历史和个人记忆的方式，让科技赋能文化保护。

en.title: Shengshu's AI Feature Film Flops as Hong Kong IPO Approaches
en.summary: Shengshu Technology's much-hyped AI-assisted feature film Sanxingdui: Future Past has bombed at the box office, bringing in just 1.68 million yuan in eleven days with abysmally low attendance. The commercial failure casts a shadow over the company's upcoming Hong Kong IPO and exposes the harsh reality that current AI video tools are great for short clips, but still a far cry from full-length cinematic storytelling.
en.full_summary:
Box Office Reality Check
Shengshu Technology positioned its Vidu model as a powerhouse for professional filmmaking, culminating in the release of China's first AI-assisted feature film, *Sanxingdui: Future Past*. However, with a meager box office of 1.68 million yuan and near-empty theaters on weekdays, the movie became a public counterexample rather than a commercial showcase, dealing a blow to the company's valuation narrative just as its Hong Kong IPO approaches.
Market Pressures and Margins
While Shengshu has raised over 6 billion yuan and boasts a valuation above $2 billion, the broader market mood for AI has soured. Video generation APIs are locked in a brutal price war, with costs dropping to mere pennies per second. Independent startups struggle to compete against tech giants who can endlessly subsidize inference, making pure video generation a tough business with low customer loyalty.
The World Model Pivot
Recognizing the limits of simple video generation, Shengshu has increasingly branded itself as a general world-model company, expanding into robotics and physical simulation. Yet, critics and industry leaders remain skeptical, noting that predicting pixels is a poor substitute for true physical understanding, and real-world deployment for robots remains a distant, expensive dream.

zh.title: 生数科技首部AI电影票房惨淡，港股上市前夕遭遇现实拷问
zh.summary: 生数科技参与技术支持的首部AI辅助长片电影《三星堆：未来启示录》在上映十几天后票房惨淡，仅收获约168万元，工作日甚至出现单场观影人数不足一人的尴尬情况。这场本想用来给上市造势的商业秀却翻了车，彻底暴露了目前AI视频技术只能应付短片段，还撑不起真正电影大片的尴尬现实。
zh.full_summary:
票房遭遇滑铁卢
生数科技一直希望证明其Vidu模型能够进入专业电影工业，并将其技术支持的中国首部AI辅助长片《三星堆：未来启示录》视为金字招牌。然而，该片上映11天仅斩获约168万元票房，工作日场均观影人数甚至不到一人。这场本打算在港股上市前夕用来镀金的商业展示，最终却成了反面教材。
价格战与盈利困境
虽然生数科技成立不到四年已融资超60亿元，估值超过20亿美元，但当前的资本市场对AI热潮已经趋于冷静。视频生成领域正陷入激烈的价格战，API价格不断被压低到几分钱每秒。对于独立初创企业来说，在巨头们不断补贴硬件和算力的背景下，单靠卖视频生成服务很难维持高昂的运营成本。
世界模型的远水与近渴
为了讲出更有想象力的资本故事，生数开始将自己包装成世界模型公司，试图将Vidu的数字生成能力延伸到机器人等物理领域。然而，业内专家指出，仅仅通过预测像素很难真正理解物理规律，机器人的实际落地仍然路途遥远。如何摆脱纯靠烧钱的困境，是摆在所有AI视频初创企业面前的现实难题。

en.title: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair and China spy links
en.summary: Nvidia’s stock dropped nearly 10% in two days after reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with a woman suspected by U.S. intelligence of spying for China. The company's board has hired an outside law firm to investigate, a rare crisis that corporate governance experts say lacks clear precedent, while investors have already filed a class action lawsuit.
en.full_summary:
Nvidia is facing a severe corporate governance crisis after it was revealed that CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, a woman U.S. intelligence believes was spying for China. Following the news, Nvidia's stock sank about 9.5% over two days.
The Investigation and Legal Hurdles
The board has hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an internal investigation. Legal experts note that the inquiry will focus on whether laws were broken, internal policies were violated, and whether the board was misled. Meanwhile, Nvidia is already facing a proposed class action lawsuit alleging that executives concealed the relationship while describing business dealings with the woman's former employer as routine. Experts point out that while affairs are common, the intersection with potential national security compromises is uncharted territory.
Governance and Succession Concerns
The scandal has also drawn scrutiny to Nvidia's internal management, including its famously flat organizational structure and the employment of Huang's children within the company. Experts criticized the practice of hiring family members at a publicly traded tech giant, though they noted that Huang does not hold dual-class shares, meaning the board retains more leverage to act compared to companies with founder-controlled voting structures.

zh.title: 英伟达董事会正就CEO黄仁勋的婚外情及涉嫌间谍风波展开内部调查
zh.summary: 在传出CEO黄仁勋与一名被美情报机构怀疑为中国间谍的女性有婚外情后，英伟达股价两天内跌了近10%。公司董事会已聘请外部律师事务所展开调查。治理专家表示这种情况史无前例，而投资者目前已发起集体诉讼。
zh.full_summary:
英伟达正面临一场严峻的公司治理危机。此前有报道称，CEO黄仁勋与被美国情报机构怀疑为中国间谍的艾丽斯·黄（Alice Huang）存在婚外情。受此消息影响，英伟达股价在两天内下挫了约9.5%。
调查与法律挑战
英伟达董事会已聘请知名律所Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz展开内部调查。法律专家指出，调查的核心在于黄仁勋是否违法、是否违反内部政策以及是否误导了董事会。与此同时，英伟达已面临投资者提出的集体诉讼，指控其隐瞒了这段关系。专家表示，虽然高管婚外情并不鲜见，但涉及国家安全风险的情况则非常罕见。
治理与接班人隐患
这场风波也暴露了英伟达在公司治理上的潜在问题，例如过于扁平的组织架构以及黄仁勋的子女在公司任职的现象。专家批评在如此规模的上市公司中安排家族成员任职并不恰当，但好在黄仁勋并未持有双重股权，这意味着在极端情况下，董事会比那些创始人绝对控股的公司拥有更大的干预空间。

en.title: Fire Damage Delays Installation of Simulated Lunar Greenhouse in Germany
en.summary: A fire at a contractor's facility has delayed the installation of Germany's simulated lunar greenhouse. The project, designed to test crop growth for future space missions, is now pushed back to 2027.
en.full_summary:
Background
The EDEN-LUNA greenhouse is being developed by the German Aerospace Center to study technologies for growing fresh food during extended missions to the Moon and Mars. It builds on the successful EDEN ISS greenhouse project operated in Antarctica.
Details
A fire broke out at an external contractor's facility while the greenhouse container was being refurbished. Although the German Aerospace Center previously stated in September that the timeline would shift to 2027, the specific reason of the fire was only revealed recently through a parliamentary inquiry. Officials have not yet disclosed the exact extent of the damage.
Impact
The incident has pushed back the installation at the LUNA facility in Cologne from 2026 to the second quarter of 2027. Once completed, the upgraded greenhouse will test robotic assistance and nutrient recovery systems to prepare astronauts for future space exploration.

zh.title: 德国月球模拟温室因火灾推迟安装
zh.summary: 由于外包工厂发生火灾，德国用于测试太空种菜的月球模拟温室项目遭遇延误。这项旨在研究未来深空任务粮食种植的项目，预计安装时间已推迟至2027年。
zh.full_summary:
背景与项目来源
德国航空航天中心正在开发 EDEN-LUNA 温室项目，旨在研究如何在未来长期登陆月球和火星的任务中种植新鲜蔬菜。该项目延续了此前在南极洲成功运行的南极温室试验经验。
火灾与延误细节
在温室集装箱翻新期间，一家外部承包商的工厂不幸发生火灾。尽管德国航空航天中心此前在9月份就曾透露项目延期，但直到议会质询后才首次公开火灾原因。目前官方尚未详细透露具体的受损程度。
实际影响
这场事故导致该温室在科隆 LUNA 设施的安装计划从原定的 2026 年推迟到了 2027年第二季度。未来建成后，这座升级版的温室将用于测试机器人辅助种植及养分回收系统，为人类的深空探测任务做准备。

en.title: Luo Yonghao sells AI coding tool on livestream, lowering software development threshold
en.summary: Tech livestreamer Luo Yonghao showcased the AI coding platform TRAE, demonstrating how people with zero coding experience can build functional software using natural language. This event highlights a broader shift in the tech industry from selling raw AI computing tokens to delivering ready-to-use software tools, marking a new era where anyone can become a developer.
en.full_summary:
During a recent double-11 livestream, veteran entrepreneur Luo Yonghao demonstrated the capabilities of TRAE, an AI development platform. Despite claiming he cannot write a single line of code, Luo used natural language prompts to generate data reports, create presentation slides, and build a custom voice-input desktop application within hours.

This trend reflects a maturing AI market where abstract chat models are giving way to practical coding agents that handle messy background tasks like environment configuration. Industry reports indicate that software development is undergoing its biggest paradigm shift since the graphical user interface, empowering non-technical creators and independent workers to build custom digital tools without hefty outsourcing costs.

zh.title: 罗永浩直播卖AI编程工具，把写软件门槛打成白菜价
zh.summary: 知名主播罗永浩在直播间现场演示了全链路AI开发平台TRAE，让完全不懂编程的普通人也能靠想法直接做软件。这场直播标志着AI行业正在从单纯卖算力原料，转向交付能直接解决问题的成品工具，降低了大众使用技术的门槛。
zh.full_summary:
在这场备受关注的直播中，罗永浩化身“产品经理”，现场向几万观众展示了如何用AI全链路开发平台TRAE来解决职场痛点。他不仅让AI在几分钟内生成了带有图表的短剧调研报告和双版本发布会PPT，还凭一张手绘草图直接搓出了一款全局可用的语音输入法软件。整个过程省去了传统软件开发中繁琐的配环境、装依赖等脏活累活。

业内分析指出，这一现象契合了生成式AI市场从概念膨胀期向务实落地期的转变。随着智能体和代码生成技术的普及，普通职场人和独立创作者不再需要高昂的外包成本或漫长的学习周期，只要有清晰的业务构思，就能借助工具把脑洞变成现实，推动软件开发进入“超级个体”时代。

en.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop: Computer use CLI for AI agents
en.summary: ⭐ 21,545 | agent-desktop lets an AI agent see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree. It avoids screenshots or pixel matching by returning JSON-based refs for UI elements, allowing agents to click, type, and verify actions reliably.
en.full_summary:
Overview
agent-desktop is a command-line interface and C library designed to give AI agents native computer-use capabilities. Instead of relying on brittle screenshots or pixel-matching techniques, it leverages official OS accessibility APIs to read desktop applications directly, presenting them as structured JSON trees.
How It Works
The tool inspects the target application and assigns a unique reference (ref) to every interactive UI element. The calling agent queries a snapshot, performs actions like clicking or typing using the ref, and checks the updated UI state in a continuous loop. By default, it operates headless, interacting with UI elements without needing to move the mouse pointer or steal active focus.
Ecosystem and Integration
agent-desktop natively supports macOS, Windows, and Linux by wrapping platform-specific accessibility APIs like AX API, UI Automation, and AT-SPI. It also includes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server mode out of the box, allowing developers to easily expose all desktop commands as tools to any compatible AI assistant.

zh.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop：为 AI 智能体打造的桌面端控制命令行工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 21,545 | agent-desktop 让 AI 智能体能够通过操作系统的无障碍树（accessibility tree），直接查看并控制 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上的桌面应用。它完全抛弃了传统的截图或像素匹配，转而返回清晰的 JSON 引用，让智能体能够稳妥地点击、输入并验证操作结果。
zh.full_summary:
项目概述
agent-desktop 是一个功能强大的命令行工具和 C 语言库，旨在为 AI 智能体赋予原生操作电脑的能力。它不依赖脆弱的屏幕截图或复杂的像素匹配，而是直接读取操作系统的无障碍接口，把桌面应用转成结构化的 JSON 树结构供智能体理解。
核心工作原理
该工具会扫描目标应用，并为每一个可以交互的界面元素分配一个独一无二的引用编号。智能体通过获取快照、利用引用编号来模拟点击或输入文字，并在操作后通过新快照验证结果。默认情况下，它采用无头模式运行，在后台直接与 UI 交互，既不抢占焦点也不需要移动鼠标指针。
生态与集成
通过底层封装各大操作系统的无障碍 API（如 macOS 的 AX API、Windows 的 UI Automation 以及 Linux 的 AT-SPI），agent-desktop 完美支持主流桌面平台。此外，它原生内置了 MCP 服务模式，能把所有桌面控制命令无缝转换为标准的 AI 工具供各种大模型调用。

en.title: Alibaba's T-Head Seeks Hong Kong IPO to Fund AI Chip Ambitions
en.summary: Alibaba has applied to spin off its in-house chip unit, T-Head, for an independent listing in Hong Kong. As the company accelerates its external commercialization and grapples with heavy AI infrastructure costs, this move allows the chipmaker to directly tap capital markets.
en.full_summary: Founded in 2018, T-Head has evolved from an IoT chip explorer into a full-stack data center chip supplier covering computing, storage, and networking. Supported by Alibaba's heavy investments, its Zhenwu AI chips have been deployed across more than 650 external enterprise customers, making it a leading domestic player. However, as Alibaba's capital expenditures surge for AI development, spinning off T-Head provides a way for the chipmaker to raise funds independently while easing the parent company's balance sheet.

zh.title: 阿里巴巴旗下平头哥冲刺港股，自研芯片寻求独立融资
zh.summary: 阿里巴巴已申请将旗下自研芯片业务平头哥分拆并在香港独立上市。随着该业务加速外部商业化并面对沉重的AI基建投入，此举能让这家芯片公司直接对接资本市场，减轻母公司的现金流压力。
zh.full_summary:
发展历程与业务版图
平头哥成立于2018年，最初主要做物联网芯片，如今已经成长为国内极少数具备算存网全栈自研能力的数据中心芯片供应商。其真武系列AI芯片和倚天系列CPU等产品，已经在自动驾驶、金融等20多个行业的数百家外部客户中实现大规模应用，出货量稳居国产第一梯队。
拆分背后的资本考量
芯片研发是个极其烧钱的长跑。阿里巴巴近年为了押注AI，单季资本开支大幅飙升，自由现金流承压明显。让平头哥赴港独立上市，既能帮芯片业务打通直接融资的渠道，也能为阿里集团腾出宝贵的财务空间。
行业大势与未来悬念
在国产AI芯片迎来上市热潮的背景下，平头哥的独立闯关备受瞩目。未来它的营收数据、毛利率以及与阿里云的关联交易，将成为市场检验国产算力真实价值的重要风向标。

en.title: What happens to AI if the US can't build data centers?
en.summary: If the US halts new data center projects due to power and policy constraints, the growth of computing power will face a massive roadblock. While current models will run fine, training the next generation of AI will slow down significantly, forcing the industry to prioritize energy efficiency and token limits.
en.full_summary:
As multiple US states freeze data center approvals due to mounting electricity and infrastructure pressures, up to 41% of planned capacity faces cancellation risks. If this extreme scenario unfolds, American data center growth would flatline by 2028 at around 120 to 150 GW, cutting expected expansion by half.

While existing massive clusters can still handle current model iterations, building the multi-gigawatt facilities needed for future frontier models by 2030 becomes nearly impossible. This shortage forces a dramatic shift: effective computing growth drops sharply, and labs must choose between training larger models or serving user queries under fixed power limits.

Consequently, the industry will pivot toward efficiency-first strategies, such as optimizing tokens per watt, exploring distributed training, and leaning into post-training or edge computing. This constraint could inadvertently narrow the technology gap for efficient model developers and open new windows for alternative players.

zh.title: 当美国无法建设数据中心，会对AI产生怎样的冲击
zh.summary: 如果美国因电力和政策限制叫停新建数据中心，算力增长将遭遇急刹车。虽然现有模型不受影响，但下一代AI的训练速度将明显放缓，逼着整个行业不得不锱铢必较地拼能效比和限制调用量。
zh.full_summary:
随着美国多个州因电力和环保压力暂停数据中心审批，多达四成以上的规划产能面临搁浅风险。如果这种极端情况变成现实，美国的数据中心总容量将在2028年前后见顶，定格在120到150吉瓦左右，直接砍掉了原本预期的巨幅增长。

算力供应急刹车
虽然现有的超级园区能保证当前一代模型的训练不受影响，但那些计划在2030年前登场、需要数个吉瓦电力才能喂饱的下一代超级模型将失去温床。电量锁死后，AI实验室将面临残酷的选择题：每一度电是拿去训练更大的模型，还是留给日常的推理和智能体服务。

效率至上的新路线
在电量固定的硬约束下，行业将被迫转向省电技术。硬件考核标准会彻底变成“每瓦电能产出多少token”，跨机房分布式训练、后训练优化以及端侧小模型分流会成为主流。对于长期在低成本和高能效路线上摸索的玩家来说，这场算力危机反而成了一个拉近差距的好机会。

en.title: BotPsy: A Tiny 0.8B Personal Assistant Model That Beats Larger AI
en.summary: Tether AI Research introduces BotPsy, a 0.8B-parameter model designed for on-device agentic workflows. Built on Qwen3.5-0.8B, it achieves state-of-the-art tool use for its size, outperforming many larger models while keeping user data private.
en.full_summary:
BotPsy was developed by Tether AI Research to address the high costs, privacy risks, and operational vulnerabilities of relying exclusively on cloud-based frontier LLMs. By focusing on a sub-billion-parameter size, the model is optimized for efficient, secure on-device deployment.
Training Methodology
The model undergoes a four-stage post-training process. This begins with supervised fine-tuning on tool-use conversations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using specialized 4B teachers. It concludes with two rounds of reinforcement learning using rule-based and verification-driven rewards to master tool usage and general tasks.
Performance and Efficiency
Despite having only 0.8B parameters, BotPsy roughly doubles the agentic capability of its base model. It outperforms several larger models, including the 2.5× larger Qwen3.5-2B-Think, on multiple tool-use and multi-turn benchmarks while using fewer reasoning tokens.

zh.title: BotPsy：不到十亿参数的端侧个人助理，性能反超大模型
zh.summary: Tether AI Research 推出了 BotPsy，这是一个专为端侧智能工作流设计的 0.8B 参数模型。它基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 构建，在同尺寸中实现了 最先进的工具调用 性能，表现超越了许多更大体积的模型，同时保护了用户数据的隐私。
zh.full_summary:
BotPsy 由 Tether AI Research 开发，旨在解决完全依赖云端前沿大模型带来的高成本、隐私风险和运营漏洞。通过将参数量控制在十亿以下，该模型针对高效、安全的端侧部署进行了优化。
训练方法
该模型经历了四个阶段的后训练过程。首先是对工具调用对话进行监督微调，接着使用专门的 4B 教师模型进行多教师策略蒸馏，最后通过两轮基于规则和验证奖励的强化学习，全面掌握工具调用和通用任务。
性能与效率
尽管只有 0.8B 参数，BotPsy 的智能代理能力大致为其基础模型的两倍。它在多个工具调用和多轮对话基准测试中，表现超越了包括体量大 2.5 倍的 Qwen3.5-2B-Think 在内的多个更大模型，同时使用的推理 token 更少。

en.title: Why the creator of the first chatbot turned against AI
en.summary: This podcast episode looks back at Joseph Weizenbaum, the computer scientist who created the very first chatbot but later became a fierce critic of artificial intelligence. It explores why he firmly believed that computers should never be confused with humans.
en.full_summary: The Guardian's long-read podcast revisits a 2023 piece by Ben Tarnoff about Joseph Weizenbaum, a pioneer who witnessed the birth of AI. Despite building ELIZA, an early program that simulated human conversation, Weizenbaum grew deeply alarmed by how people projected human emotions onto machines. He argued that there are fundamental aspects of human thought and feeling that computers can never replicate, warning society against blindly trusting technology over human empathy and judgment.

zh.title: 为什么世界上第一个聊天机器人的发明者后来反对人工智能
zh.summary: 这期播客回顾了计算机科学家约瑟夫·魏森鲍姆的故事，他创造了历史上第一个聊天机器人，后来却成了人工智能的坚决反对者。节目探讨了他为什么坚信计算机绝不能被混淆为人类。
zh.full_summary: 《卫报》深度长文播客重新回顾了本·塔诺夫于2023年撰写的一篇关于约瑟夫·魏森鲍姆的文章。作为人工智能萌芽阶段的见证者，魏森鲍姆曾开发出模拟人类对话的早期程序ELIZA。然而，看到人们轻易将人类情感投射到冰冷的机器上，他开始感到深深的担忧。他指出，人类思维和情感中有些核心部分是计算机永远无法复制的，并警告社会切勿盲目迷信技术而放弃人类的同理心与判断力。

en.title: From Relevant Posts to Attributable Spans: Explicit Symptom Evidence for Depression Questionnaire Inference
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers propose SREE, an evidence-grounded pipeline for depression questionnaire inference from social media that extracts first-person, symptom-specific text spans to avoid misleading context and improve reliability.
en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: Inferring standardized depression questionnaire responses from longitudinal social media histories often suffers from retrieval errors, such as picking up discussions about other people or multi-symptom posts that lack precise attribution. To address this, the authors propose SREE (Symptom Retrieval and Evidence-Grounded InfErence). SREE extracts first-person and symptom-specific text spans, selects a representative subset using a Facility Location-inspired objective, and performs Evidence-Gated Inference. Evaluated on BDI-Sen and eRisk 2019-2021 datasets, SREE achieves significant improvements in post-level precision and F1 compared to standard dense retrieval, while obtaining the highest exact item-level agreement across eRisk collections. This is a preprint paper, and while it improves evidence localization and attribution, the source does not detail independent replication or code release status.

zh.title: 从相关帖子到可归因文本片段：用于抑郁症问卷推断的显式症状证据
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员提出了一种名为SREE的基于证据的管道，用于从社交媒体推断抑郁症问卷结果，该管道提取第一人称且特定于症状的文本片段，以避免误导性上下文并提高可靠性。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：从长期的社交媒体历史记录中推断标准化的抑郁症问卷回答，往往会受到检索错误的影响，例如捕捉到关于他人的讨论或缺乏精确归因的多症状帖子。为了解决这一问题，作者提出了SREE（症状检索与证据扎根推理）。SREE提取第一人称和特定于症状的文本片段，使用受设施区位启发的优化目标选择代表性子集，并进行证据门控推理。在BDI-Sen和eRisk 2019-2021数据集上的评估表明，与标准密集检索相比，SREE在帖子级别的精确度和F1值上取得了显著提升，同时在各个eRisk集合中获得了最高的确切条目级一致性。这是一篇预印本论文，虽然它改进了证据定位和归因，但来源并未详细说明独立复制或代码发布状态。

en.title: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers demonstrate closed-loop autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices using a coding-agent infrastructure, providing complete transcripts to analyze the division of cognitive labor and decision provenance.
en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: This preprint describes the use of coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods to perform autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. By capturing complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts, the authors audit decision provenance and characterize the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, and the share of methodological and scientific contributions rose from 46% in the first experiment to 56-61% in later ones. Furthermore, 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants, and roughly half of all decisions incorporated input from another participant. While the work presents a notable integration of agentic systems with physical instruments, it is a preprint requiring further independent replication and code or hardware availability checks.

zh.title: 面向自主X射线实验的可审计人机智能体团队
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员利用编码智能体基础设施展示了纳米粒子超晶格的闭环自主同步辐射X射线实验，并提供完整对话记录以分析认知分工和决策溯源。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：该预印本描述了利用基于经验证科学方法的编码智能体基础设施，在不断演变的、人类定义的目标下对纳米粒子超晶格进行自主同步辐射X射线实验。通过捕获完整的人机智能体及智能体间对话记录，作者对决策溯源进行了审计并表征了认知分工。在三项实验中，61%至67%的信息涉及解释或判断，方法学和科学贡献的比例从第一项实验的46%上升到后续实验的56%至61%。此外，59%至68%的纠错涉及多名参与者，大约一半的决策吸收了其他参与者的输入。尽管该研究展示了智能体系统与物理仪器的重要集成，但它仍是一篇预印本，需要进一步的独立复制以及代码或硬件可用性验证。

en.title: How to Use Gemini Notebook to Slash Internal Support Costs
en.summary: Gemini Notebook lets companies build custom AI helpers by simply uploading existing manuals and documents. It answers routine employee questions with citations and generates FAQs or handover materials instantly, saving countless hours for HR and administrative teams.
en.full_summary: Managing repetitive internal inquiries regarding expense claims, HR rules, and IT systems often drains administrative bandwidth. Gemini Notebook addresses this by allowing teams to ingest PDFs, documents, and web pages without requiring new content creation. When staff ask questions, the tool provides direct answers along with exact source citations, ensuring high transparency and preventing hallucinations when information is missing. Furthermore, the system can automate the creation of FAQ drafts and staff handover materials complete with presentation outlines. To ensure safe deployment, companies are advised to use Google Workspace for information governance, verify document accuracy before uploading, establish clear access rules, and start small by targeting a single repetitive administrative process.

zh.title: 用 Gemini Notebook 轻松搞定社内问答，告别繁琐翻规章
zh.summary: 只需上传现有的公司手册和文档，Gemini Notebook 就能快速打造专属的智能问答助手。它不仅能根据原文提供带依据的准确回答，还能自动生成常见问题解答和交接资料，大大减轻总务和人事部门的日常负担。
zh.full_summary:
处理关于报销、规章和系统操作的重复性内部咨询，常常让行政和人事部门苦不堪言。Gemini Notebook 通过读取现有的 PDF、文档和网页等资料，让企业无需重新编写内容就能快速搭建问答工具。当员工提问时，它不仅能给出准确回答，还会附带原始资料的出处，并在资料缺失时如实告知，避免 AI 瞎编。

除了日常答疑，它还能一键生成常见问题解答和工作交接资料，甚至能自动整理出演示幻灯片。为了确保数据安全，专家建议企业通过付费账号管理权限、严格核对上传资料的时效性，并采取从小范围单项业务开始试水的方式，逐步向全员推广。

en.title: How AI and Robotics Help Recyclers Turn Mixed Waste Into Reusable Materials
en.summary: According to NVIDIA Generative AI: Global waste is piling up, but only a tiny fraction gets recycled due to manual labor shortages and messy materials. Startups are now using computer vision and AI to sort plastics, textiles, and household trash with incredible speed and accuracy. This breakthrough helps factories cut operating costs while keeping valuable resources in circulation.
en.full_summary:
According to NVIDIA Generative AI:

The Recycling Challenge
Globally, less than 7% of materials come from recycled sources, and municipal solid waste could nearly double by 2050. Traditional recycling relies heavily on hard-to-find manual labor, making it difficult to sort mixed scrap accurately and cost-effectively.
AI-Powered Solutions
Innovative startups are deploying edge AI and robotics to revolutionize recycling plants. Taiwan-based AIRECO uses vision AI to sort plastics for closed-loop recycling, aiming to triple processing capacity. EverestLabs AI operates robots on fast-moving conveyor belts across North America and Australia, identifying billions of objects. U.K.-based Greyparrot monitors waste streams in real time, replacing outdated manual sampling with instant analytics. Meanwhile, Germany's reverse.fashion automates the tedious task of sorting used textiles by analyzing fabric quality and defects at high speeds.
Industry Impact
By leveraging advanced computing, these companies are drastically improving sorting efficiency and boosting the yield of reusable materials. Major brands and recycling facilities are using these tools to reduce carbon emissions and build a more sustainable circular economy.

zh.title: AI和机器人如何帮回收厂把混杂垃圾变成宝
zh.summary: 据NVIDIA Generative AI发布的信息：全球垃圾堆积如山，但由于人工短缺和分拣困难，回收率一直很低。现在，多家初创企业正利用计算机视觉与AI技术，以极高的速度和准确率对塑料、纺织品和生活垃圾进行精细化分拣。这一技术突破不仅帮工厂大幅削减成本，还让宝贵的废旧资源重新回到循环利用的链条中。
zh.full_summary:
据NVIDIA Generative AI发布的信息：

垃圾回收的困境
全球只有不到7%的材料来自回收资源，而城市生活垃圾预计到2050年将翻一番。传统的回收严重依赖人工，不仅费时费力，还很难把混杂的废弃物准确分类，导致许多材料只能被降级处理。
AI带来的改变
全球多地的初创企业正在将AI与机器人技术引入垃圾分拣线。中国台湾的AIRECO利用视觉AI实现塑料的高精度分类，计划将处理能力提升近三倍。美国的EverestLabs AI在高速传送带上部署分拣机器人，目前已处理了数十亿个物件。英国的Greyparrot则通过实时监控废物流，彻底改变了过去靠人工抽样检查的落后做法。此外，德国的reverse.fashion利用高分辨率AI快速识别旧衣服的材质和瑕疵，把原本需要一周的人工分拣缩短到一个小时。
实际应用效果
通过边缘计算和深度学习，这些AI系统正在大幅提升回收效率，让更多塑料和纺织品能够真正循环使用。这不仅降低了企业的运营成本，也为全球的可持续发展注入了强劲动力。

en.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Lands on Amazon Bedrock with High-Speed Inference
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed is now available on Amazon Bedrock, bringing 2 to 3 times faster output generation. It retains the powerful 1-million-token context window while adding major boosts for complex coding, financial modeling, and agentic workflows.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

Background
Moonshot AI has expanded its partnership with cloud providers by bringing its latest K3.1 Pro Highspeed model to Amazon Bedrock. This version builds upon the K3 architecture, focusing heavily on extended post-training to dramatically reduce factual errors and master long-horizon agentic workflows.
Key Details
The new high-speed model delivers 2–3 times the output token generation rate of the standard Kimi K3.1 Pro. Developers can easily access it via existing endpoints by simply updating their model ID. It supports advanced features such as configurable reasoning effort, tool calling, structured outputs, and explicit prompt caching. Additionally, AWS ensures strict data privacy, keeping user prompts within the AWS data boundary and preventing data sharing with Moonshot AI.
Industry Impact
With features like a cost-saving Flex tier and high-speed token generation tailored for coding assistants like OpenCode, this launch lowers the barrier for enterprises wanting to deploy advanced AI agents. Faster inference directly accelerates multi-step tasks like debugging and editing, making AI-driven development much more practical.

zh.title: 月之暗面 Kimi K3.1 Pro 高速版正式登陆 Amazon Bedrock
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：月之暗面的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 高速版 现已上线 Amazon Bedrock，输出速度比原版快 2 到 3 倍。它保留了强大的百万级上下文窗口，并在复杂编程、金融建模和智能体任务方面带来了显著提升。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

背景介绍
月之暗面与亚马逊云科技进一步合作，将其最新的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 高速版 引入了 Amazon Bedrock 平台。该版本基于 K3 架构，通过大量的后训练专门优化了长周期的智能体任务，并大幅减少了事实性错误。
核心细节
这款高速模型实现了比标准版快 2 到 3 倍的输出速度。开发者只需修改模型 ID 即可无缝接入。它支持灵活的推理深度调节、工具调用、结构化输出以及显式提示词缓存等功能。在安全性方面，AWS 确保用户数据严格保留在云端边界内，绝不与月之暗面共享，也不会用于模型训练。
行业影响
凭借半价的 Flex 经济档位以及针对编程助手 OpenCode 优化的高速吞吐，此次上线大幅降低了企业部署高级 AI 智能体的成本和门槛。更快的生成速度直接缩短了多步骤调试和代码编写的等待时间，让 AI 辅助编程变得更加高效实用。

en.title: How LangChain's GTM Agent builds sales documents
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: LangChain's internal GTM Agent has saved sales reps thousands of hours by automatically generating customized sales documents like proposals and account plans. Deals where a rep sent one of these documents were 47% more likely to move to a later stage. The secret lies in giving the agent deep business context rather than just relying on prompt tuning.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

How It Works
LangChain's GTM Agent helps sales reps by automating the creation of time-consuming sales documents, such as proposal decks and account plans. Over a 12-week period, it generated over 1,500 artifacts, saving reps hundreds of hours and helping deals progress faster through the sales pipeline.
The Role of Context
While a powerful AI model helps, the real breakthrough comes from building around the model. The team feeds the agent specific business logic, customer call transcripts, Salesforce data, and strict brand guidelines. This ensures every document looks polished and follows the company's proven sales playbook.
Real Impact
By connecting the agent to Slack and team calendars, it acts proactively, suggesting the right document before a customer call. Deals featuring these agent-generated artifacts moved to a later stage 47% of the time, compared to just 16% for matched deals without them.

zh.title: LangChain 如何用 AI 代理自动生成高质量销售文档
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：LangChain 开发的销售 AI 代理通过自动生成定制化的销售文档，帮销售人员省下了数千小时。数据显示，附带这类文档的销售单子进入下一阶段的成功率高出 47%。这背后的核心秘诀在于给 AI 灌输深厚的业务上下文，而不是单纯折腾提示词。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

工作原理
LangChain 的内部销售代理通过自动化生成建议书、账户计划等耗时文档，大幅解放了销售人员。在 12 周的时间里，它生成了 1500 多份文档，不仅节省了大量时间，还显著推动了销售漏斗的进展。
业务上下文的关键作用
虽然强大的底层模型必不可少，但真正的突破在于模型周边的业务配套。团队为 AI 注入了具体的业务逻辑、客户通话记录、Salesforce 数据和严格的品牌规范。这确保了生成的每一份文档都既专业又符合公司的销售策略。
实际影响
通过将 AI 代理与 Slack 和日历打通，它能够在客户会议前主动建议并生成合适的材料。统计表明，使用了这些代理生成文档的销售单子，进入下一阶段的转化率达到了 47%，而没有使用的对照组仅为 16%。

en.title: Brain-computer interface lets paralyzed patients control smart home devices using silent speech
en.summary: A new brain-computer interface allows a person with ALS to control smart home devices simply by silently mouthing words, without needing any visual or auditory prompts. In clinical tests, this system achieved a high decoding accuracy of over 97 percent, proving that brain signals from internal speech can be reliably used for private and independent device control.
en.full_summary:
Background
Brain-computer interfaces hold great promise for restoring independence to individuals with paralysis, enabling them to interact with their environment and operate smart devices. However, previous BCI systems for device control often relied on external visual displays or audio cues, which restricted the user's ability to issue commands autonomously and privately in everyday settings.
Details
In this recent study, a clinical trial participant living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis used a chronically implanted electrocorticographic brain-computer interface. Over the course of 18 experimental sessions, the system detected silently mimed speech commands in real time. The technology successfully decoded these internal signals with a median accuracy of 97.1 percent, achieving nearly 12 correct decodes per minute without relying on any exogenous timing cues.
Impact
These findings represent a major step forward for assistive technology, demonstrating that silently attempted speech can be translated reliably into actionable commands. This capability significantly improves both the privacy and autonomy of people with severe motor impairments, bringing practical, hands-free smart home control one step closer to reality.

zh.title: 脑机接口实现瘫痪患者用“默念”控制智能家居
zh.summary: 一项最新研究显示，通过植入式脑机接口，一名渐冻症患者成功实现了仅靠默念说话来控制智能家居设备，完全不需要任何屏幕或声音提示。在临床试验中，该系统的识别准确率超过了97%，证明了利用内心语言进行独立、私密设备控制的可行性。
zh.full_summary:
背景
脑机接口技术一直被视为帮助瘫痪患者恢复独立生活的重要希望，能让他们通过智能设备来操纵周围环境。然而，以往的脑机接口系统大多需要依靠外部的屏幕显示或声音提示来配合操作，这在很大程度上限制了用户在日常生活中自主、私密地下达指令的能力。
细节
在这项新研究中，一位患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症的临床试验参与者，使用了一种长期植入体内的皮层电图脑机接口。在长达18次的实验中，该系统能够实时检测并解码默念的语音指令。测试结果显示，系统取得了 97.1%的中位准确率，并且在没有任何外部时间提示的情况下，每分钟能够正确识别近12条指令。
影响
这一突破标志着辅助技术向前迈出了重要一步，证明了内部默念的语音能够被稳定且准确地转化为实际的操作指令。这项进展不仅大大提升了严重运动障碍患者的隐私保护，也让真正自主、便捷的无障碍智能家居控制离现实更近了一步。

en.title: How LlamaParse Pen Tested Against OWASP LLM Risks
en.summary: According to LlamaIndex Blog: LlamaParse used AI-driven security agents to thoroughly test its document parsing platform against the OWASP LLM Top 10 risks. The test uncovered business logic and prompt manipulation issues, helping the company establish clear security boundaries between its service and customer workflows.
en.full_summary:
According to LlamaIndex Blog:

Background and Testing Approach
Traditional security tests are great for standard web apps, but they fall short when dealing with AI models that read customer documents. To ensure rigorous security, LlamaParse hired a dynamic application security testing firm using AI agents. These agents spent four days autonomously reading documentation, writing code, generating sample files, and attacking the production environment across all ten OWASP LLM risk categories.
Key Findings and Lessons
Among the findings was a subtle attack where invisible white-on-white text inside a PDF invoice altered extracted bank account details. This raised a crucial question about responsibility: should the parsing tool filter out such anomalies, or should the customer's downstream pipeline handle trust decisions? LlamaParse concluded that extraction should faithfully report what is on the page, while customers must implement business validation rules.
Enterprise Security Controls
Beyond the pen test, LlamaParse outlines robust enterprise controls, including strict data privacy policies that prevent customer data from being used for model training, SOC 2 compliance, and flexible deployment options ranging from managed SaaS to self-hosted environments.

zh.title: LlamaParse 是如何针对大模型安全漏洞进行渗透测试的？
zh.summary: 据LlamaIndex Blog发布的信息：LlamaParse 利用智能安全代理，对自身的文档解析平台进行了针对 OWASP 大模型安全风险的全面渗透测试。测试发现了业务逻辑和指令操纵等方面的问题，帮助公司明确了服务商与客户工作流之间的安全边界。
zh.full_summary:
据LlamaIndex Blog发布的信息：

背景与测试方法
传统的安全测试适合常规网页应用，但在面对需要阅读客户文档的 AI 模型时往往束手无策。为了确保安全性，LlamaParse 采用基于 AI 代理的动态应用安全测试。这些代理花四天时间自主阅读文档、编写代码、生成测试文件，并针对 OWASP 大模型十大风险对生产环境发起了全方位的自动化攻击。
核心发现与反思
测试发现了一个隐蔽的攻击案例：PDF 发票中带有白底白字的隐藏文本，能够悄悄篡改提取出的银行账户信息。这引发了关于责任归属的讨论：解析工具是否应该过滤掉这类异常，还是应该由客户的下游管道来做信任决策？LlamaParse 认为，解析工具应当忠实反映页面内容，而客户则需要在自己的业务流程中对提取结果进行校验。
企业级安全控制
除了渗透测试，LlamaParse 还公布了完善的企业级安全控制措施，包括不使用客户数据进行模型训练的严格隐私政策、SOC 2 合规认证，以及从托管软件即服务到私有部署等多种灵活的选择。

en.title: New tech lets spin signals travel much further at room temperature
en.summary: Scientists have developed a polariton waveguide using transition metal dichalcogenides that allows spin signals to travel up to 100 micrometers at room temperature. This breakthrough combines the long-distance advantages of light with the interactive properties needed for future computing.
en.full_summary:
In modern electronics and spintronics, using the spin of particles to carry information is a promising idea, but these spin signals usually fizzle out over very short distances. On the other hand, photons can travel far, but they don't have the nonlinear interactions required to build logic gates for computing.

To bridge this gap, researchers turned to polaritons—hybrid particles made of light and matter. By building special waveguides out of transition metal dichalcogenides, they achieved spin propagation of up to 100 micrometers while operating entirely at room temperature. More importantly, the system retains large polariton nonlinearities, meaning it opens the door to practical, ultra-fast optical computing and advanced information processing devices that don't need extreme cooling.

zh.title: 新技术让自旋信号在室温下传得更远
zh.summary: 科学家们用过渡金属硫化物做出了一种激子极化激元波导，能让自旋信号在室温下传出长达100微米的距离。这项突破把光能传得远的优点和做逻辑运算所需的相互作用结合在了一起。
zh.full_summary:
在自旋电子学里，利用粒子的自旋来传递信息是个好主意，但这些信号往往只能传很短的一段距离就消失了。另一方面，光子虽然能跑得很远，却缺乏做逻辑门计算所必需的非线性相互作用。

为了解决这个难题，研究人员把目光投向了光与物质结合的混合产物——极化激元。通过用过渡金属硫化物搭建特殊的波导结构，他们在室温环境下实现了长达100微米的自旋信号传输。更厉害的是，这个系统还保留了很强的非线性特性，为未来不需要极端低温的光学计算和高速信息处理设备铺平了道路。

en.title: Why India and Pakistan urgently need to rewrite their historic water treaty
en.summary: The historic Indus Waters Treaty between India and Pakistan is facing unprecedented suspension following regional conflicts. Experts argue that the decades-old agreement has systemic flaws regarding environmental and social sustainability. Revising the treaty using modern international water laws and sustainable development goals could help reduce regional tensions and pave the way for lasting peace between the two nuclear-armed neighbors.
en.full_summary:
Background
The Indus Waters Treaty (IWT), long hailed as a symbol of hydrological cooperation despite political hostility between India and Pakistan, has hit a major roadblock. Following the April 2025 terrorist attack in Kashmir, India suspended its participation in the treaty, bringing transboundary water management into uncharted and tense territory.
Core Issues and Solutions
Researchers point out that the original treaty, while managing water allocation, suffers from severe gaps in long-term environmental, political, and social sustainability. The authors argue for a complete reset by incorporating modern frameworks, such as the UN Sustainable Development Goals (Indicator 6.5.2) and international legal guidelines for ecologically viable treaties. Establishing better data exchange and regional mechanisms can transform how the two nations share this vital river basin.
Broader Impact
Beyond managing water scarcity and climate change adaptation, modernizing the IWT could serve as a vital confidence-building measure. In a heavily militarized region where two nuclear rivals share a massive border, finding common ground on water governance might just unlock a pathway to broader geopolitical stability.

zh.title: 印巴为何迫切需要重新谈判并修改历史性的《印度河水条约》
zh.summary: 印巴之间历史悠久的《印度河水条约》在经历地区冲突后正面临前所未有的暂停。专家认为，这份几十年前的协议在环境与社会可持续性方面存在系统性缺陷。利用现代国际水法和可持续发展目标来修订该条约，有助于缓和地区紧张局势，并为这两个核邻国之间的持久和平铺平道路。
zh.full_summary:
背景
长期以来，印巴两国尽管政治敌对，但《印度河水条约》一直被誉为水文合作的典范。然而，在2025年4月克什米尔发生恐袭事件后，印度暂停了对该条约的参与，使得跨境水资源管理陷入了前所未有的紧张境地。
核心问题与解决方案
研究人员指出，最初的条约虽然分配了水量，但在长期的环境、政治和社会可持续性方面存在严重漏洞。作者主张通过纳入现代框架（如联合国可持续发展目标指标6.5.2以及关于生态可行条约的国际法律准则）来对条约进行全面重组。建立更好的数据交换和区域协商机制，可以改变两国共享这一关键流域的方式。
实际影响
除了应对水资源短缺和气候变化适应问题外，现代化改造《印度河水条约》还可以作为一项至关重要的建立信任措施。在一个重兵把守、两个核邻国共享巨额边界的地区，在水治理上找到共同点，或许能为更广泛的地缘政治稳定打开通道。

en.title: AMD Ships New EPYC 9006 Processors Built for Agentic AI
en.summary: According to AMD Blogs: AMD is now shipping its new EPYC 9006 SP7 server processors, designed specifically to handle heavy workloads like agentic AI and high-performance computing. These chips offer up to 256 cores and blazing-fast memory speeds to help companies run multiple AI agents smoothly and keep expensive GPUs fed with data.
en.full_summary:
According to AMD Blogs:

Background
As AI shifts from simple chatbots to autonomous agentic workflows, data centers face massive concurrency demands. Multiple agents, tool calls, and subtasks require dense and efficient compute power.
Key Details
The new AMD EPYC 9006 SP7 is the first family member in a four-part rollout. It packs up to 256 cores and 512 threads per socket, reaches frequencies up to 5.3 GHz, and supports JEDEC-standard MRDIMM-12800 for up to 1.6 TB/s of memory bandwidth. It also introduces PCIe Gen 6 I/O to double bandwidth per lane.
Industry Impact
These processors are built to keep AI accelerators productive by moving large context windows quickly. Major cloud providers like Oracle and Microsoft are already integrating these chips into their cloud instances to support enterprise applications and agent orchestration.

zh.title: AMD 推出全新 EPYC 9006 处理器，专为智能体 AI 打造
zh.summary: 据AMD Blogs发布的信息：AMD 开始出货全新 EPYC 9006 SP7 服务器处理器，专门用来应付智能体 AI 和高性能计算等重度任务。这些芯片最高拥有 256 个核心和超快的内存速度，能帮企业顺畅运行多个 AI 智能体，并喂饱昂贵的 GPU 避免它们闲置。
zh.full_summary:
据AMD Blogs发布的信息：

背景介绍
随着 AI 从简单的聊天机器人转向自主运行的智能体工作流，数据中心面临着巨大的并发需求。大量的智能体、工具调用和子任务需要极高密度且高效的计算能力。
核心细节
全新的 AMD EPYC 9006 SP7 是其四款规划中处理器系列的第一款。单插槽最高可提供 256 个核心和 512 个线程，频率最高可达 5.3 GHz，并支持最新的内存标准以提供每插槽高达 1.6 TB/s 的内存带宽。它还引入了 PCIe Gen 6 接口，使每条通道的带宽翻倍。
行业影响
这些处理器旨在通过快速传输大规模上下文数据，让 AI 加速器保持高效运转。甲骨文和微软等主流云服务商已经准备在其云实例中集成这些芯片，以支持企业应用和智能体调度。

en.title: Amazon Bedrock brings DeepEval and AutoEval to AgentCore for better AI agent testing
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Testing AI agents in production is tough because traditional metrics often hide critical failures like leaked personal data. Amazon Bedrock is updating its AgentCore Evaluations feature to solve this by adding built-in AWS evaluators alongside popular third-party tools like DeepEval and AutoEval. This lets developers track real business outcomes, multi-turn conversations, and security risks in one unified place.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

The Evaluation Challenge
When deploying AI agents to production, simple metrics like latency or basic output checks aren't enough. An agent might resolve a customer support ticket while simultaneously leaking sensitive personal data. To fix this, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations provides a structured way to measure what truly matters by mapping business goals to observable behaviors.
A Catalog of Evaluators
AgentCore brings together evaluators from three main sources. AWS built-ins cover response quality, task completion, and safety. Third-party managed options from DeepEval and AutoEval tackle complex multi-turn issues like knowledge retention, conversational completeness, and security flags. Developers can also create custom dimensions to grade multiple criteria in a single judge call.
Flexible Running Modes
To fit different development stages, AgentCore supports three execution modes using the exact same evaluator IDs. On-demand evaluation helps during quick debugging, online evaluation samples live production traffic, and batch evaluation runs regression tests against a golden dataset before any new release.

zh.title: 亚马逊 Bedrock 在 AgentCore 中引入 DeepEval 和 AutoEval，帮开发者更好测试 AI 智能体
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：把 AI 智能体放到线上使用很难评估它到底有没有干好活，传统指标往往会漏掉诸如泄露隐私等严重问题。亚马逊 Bedrock 的 AgentCore 评估功能迎来更新，直接把 AWS 自家评估工具 和开源的 DeepEval、AutoEval 整合在了一起。这让开发者能在一个地方轻松搞定业务成果、多轮对话和安全风险等各种指标的测试。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

评估难题与核心思路
当 AI 智能体上线后，只看运行速度或简单的输出结果远远不够。一个客服智能体虽然解决了问题，却可能在聊天中泄露用户的个人隐私。为了解决这类隐蔽的失败，亚马逊 Bedrock 的 AgentCore 评估功能教大家从实际业务结果出发，把抽象的成功目标拆解为具体的行为，并用对口的评估器来进行打分。
丰富的评估工具库
AgentCore 整合了三种来源的评估器。AWS 自带的工具主要负责检查回答质量、任务完成度和安全性；第三方开源工具 DeepEval 和 AutoEval 则专注于解决多轮对话中的遗漏、记忆丢失和恶意攻击等复杂问题。如果这些还不够，开发者还可以自定义多维度的评估规则，一次性给多个指标打分。
三种灵活的运行模式
为了方便在不同阶段使用，AgentCore 提供了三种运行方式，并且它们都使用完全相同的评估器 ID。开发者可以在开发调试时使用即时评估，在生产环境中进行在线抽样监控，或者在发布新版本前用批处理评估来做回归测试，确保新代码没有引入旧问题。

en.title: v0.40.17 - AI Tooling and LLM Runtime Update with MLX and Vulkan Optimizations
en.summary: This update brings exciting performance boosts and fixes for running AI models locally. It introduces concurrent generation support for Apple's MLX framework and leverages memory mapping for Vulkan integrated GPUs, making your local AI run smoother and faster. Plus, it improves the ChatGPT CLI experience with better restart handling.
en.full_summary:
Detailed Updates

This release focuses heavily on hardware acceleration and reliability for running large language models locally. Key improvements include support for concurrent generation on MLX, allowing for better multitasking when using Apple Silicon hardware. Additionally, developers have integrated memory mapping for Vulkan integrated GPUs, which significantly improves memory efficiency on supported devices.
Core Fixes and Upgrades

Beyond hardware optimizations, the update includes a version bump for llama.cpp and related MLX components to stay aligned with the latest upstream capabilities. The ChatGPT CLI has also received a stability patch, ensuring graceful restarts and smoother session restoration during daily use.

zh.title: v0.40.17版本发布 - 带来针对MLX和Vulkan的AI大模型运行优化
zh.summary: 这个新版本为本地运行AI大模型带来了多项激动人心的性能提升和修复。它支持了苹果MLX框架的并发生成，并且让Vulkan核显能够使用内存映射技术，让你的本地AI跑得更快更顺畅。此外，它还优化了ChatGPT命令行的重启体验。
zh.full_summary:
详细更新内容

这次发布的版本主要专注于提升本地运行大语言模型的硬件加速能力和系统稳定性。其中最亮眼的改进是为苹果的MLX框架加入了并发生成支持，这能在使用苹果芯片时带来更好的多任务处理能力。同时，针对Vulkan集成显卡引入了内存映射（mmap）技术，显著提升了内存效率。
核心修复与升级

除了硬件层面的优化，该版本还升级了 llama.cpp 以及相关的MLX组件版本，以便紧跟最新的技术进展。此外，ChatGPT命令行工具也迎来了稳定性修复，确保在日常使用中能够优雅重启并更顺畅地恢复会话。

en.title: Australia's PM faces a political storm over AI copyright and the creative sector
en.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is facing a tough political dilemma as he weighs whether to attract massive AI datacentres or protect local artists. Tech companies want Australia to relax copyright laws to build their data hubs, but creators are furious that AI models have been trained on stolen property. This clash puts the government's long-standing alliance with the creative sector at serious risk.
en.full_summary:
The Australian government is being courted by AI hyperscalers like Anthropic, which wants to base training models and renewable datacentres in the country, potentially creating a lucrative new green industry. However, this economic vision comes with a catch: tech companies are pushing the government to relax copyright laws that currently protect artistic work from being scraped without consent. Critics argue this would turn Australia into a global haven for data-washing.

Beyond intellectual property, the rise of AI is triggering broader societal concerns, ranging from the automated mimicry of human art to the erosion of educational cognitive skills and mounting pressures on energy and water resources. The creative sector, traditionally a loyal political ally of the Labor party, is fiercely pushing back against what they see as a sell-out, demanding proper control, compensation, and the active promotion of human work.

zh.title: 澳大利亚总理面临关于人工智能版权与创意产业的政治风暴
zh.summary: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯正面临一个艰难的政治抉择：是吸引大规模的AI数据中心，还是保护本土艺术家的利益。科技巨头希望澳大利亚放宽版权法来建设数据枢纽，但创作者们对AI模型使用被盗财产进行训练感到愤怒。这场冲突将政府与创意产业长期以来的联盟推向了危险境地。
zh.full_summary:
澳大利亚政府正受到Anthropic等AI巨头的游说，这些公司希望在该国建立训练模型和可再生数据中心，从而打造利润丰厚的绿色新产业。然而，这一经济愿景伴随着代价：科技公司正敦促政府放宽版权法，而现行法律本可保护艺术作品不经同意就被抓取。批评人士认为，此举将把澳大利亚变成全球数据洗钱的天堂。

除了知识产权，人工智能的崛起还引发了更广泛的社会担忧，从对人类艺术的自动化模仿，到教育认知能力的退化，以及对能源和水资源日益增长的压力。创意产业作为工党传统的政治盟友，正激烈反对他们所认为的“出卖”行为，并要求获得适当的控制权、赔偿以及对人类作品的大力推广。

en.title: MIT School of Engineering welcomes new faculty members for 2026
en.summary: According to MIT Biological Engineering: MIT's School of Engineering is welcoming new faculty across multiple disciplines, bringing fresh perspectives to research and teaching.
en.full_summary: According to MIT Biological Engineering: The MIT School of Engineering has announced its newest cohort of faculty members for 2026, spanning six academic units and covering a wide range of advanced disciplines including mechanical engineering, aerospace, biological engineering, and quantum computing. These new appointments bring diverse expertise from top institutions, aiming to push boundaries in areas like autonomous systems, computational biology, and quantum error correction. The school also mourned the passing of Professor Thomas Rose, a newly joined materials science expert whose research focused on ancient metallurgy.

zh.title: 麻省理工学院工程学院迎来新一届教职工
zh.summary: 据MIT Biological Engineering发布的信息：麻省理工学院工程学院近期迎来了多位跨学科的新教职工，他们将为学校的研究与教学注入新鲜血液。
zh.full_summary: 据MIT Biological Engineering发布的信息：麻省理工学院工程学院近日公布了2026年的新教职工阵容，涵盖了六个学术单位，研究领域涉及机械工程、航空航天、生物工程以及量子计算等前沿学科。这些新加入的学者带来了来自各大顶尖机构的多元化专长，致力于在自主系统、计算生物学和量子纠错等方向取得突破。同时，学院也对不幸离世的材料科学专家托马斯·罗斯教授表达了悼念，他生前专注于古代冶金与材料科学的研究。

en.title: OpenAI Buys AI Travel Startup Odessia and Hires Founder
en.summary: OpenAI has bought an AI travel agent startup called Odessia and hired its founder, Francis Davidson. While the financial terms weren't shared and the original travel tool has already been shut down, the move shows OpenAI is doubling down on travel planning as a key use case for its AI assistants.
en.full_summary:
Background
Odessia was a one-year-old startup that raised $6 million in pre-seed funding led by Sequoia. Its founder, Francis Davidson, previously built the short-term rental unicorn Sonder, which unfortunately went bankrupt after the pandemic and a failed partnership.
Acquisition Details
Although Odessia's travel product has already been shut down and the tool is no longer running, Davidson and his expertise were brought on board by OpenAI. This looks largely like an acqui-hire to bolster OpenAI's talent pool in the travel sector.
Future Impact
OpenAI has pointed out that travel is one of the most common tasks users ask ChatGPT about. While there are no official announcements of a dedicated travel product yet, bringing in a seasoned travel entrepreneur suggests that OpenAI wants to make its personal assistants much better at handling real-world trip planning.

zh.title: OpenAI 收购 AI 旅游初创公司 Odessia 并将其创始人收入麾下
zh.summary: OpenAI 买下了一家名叫 Odessia 的 AI 旅游助手初创公司，并把创始人弗朗西斯·戴维森给挖了过来。虽然具体的交易金额没公开，而且那个旅游工具也已经关停了，但这说明 OpenAI 正准备把旅游规划作为 AI 助手的一个核心功能重点发力。
zh.full_summary:
背景情况
Odessia 是一家成立仅一年的初创公司，之前曾获得红杉资本领投的 600 万美元种子前轮融资。其创始人弗朗西斯·戴维森大有来头，他曾在大学时创立了短租独角兽企业 Sonder，不过后来因为疫情和业务受挫遗憾破产。
交易细节
虽然 Odessia 的旅游产品目前已经关闭，但 OpenAI 主要是把创始人及其团队给招安了。这笔交易更像是一次人才收购，看重的是创始人在旅游行业的丰富经验。
行业影响
OpenAI 透露，旅游规划是用户经常向 ChatGPT 寻求帮助的高频场景之一。尽管官方还没有发布专门的旅游产品，但这次招募经验丰富的创业者，表明他们希望让自家的智能助手在处理现实生活中的出行时更加得心应手。

en.title: Designing for AI Agents: How Resend is Optimizing for Answer Engines and Autonomous APIs
en.summary: Resend co-founder and CEO Zeno Rocha discusses how coding agents select infrastructure tools like email providers, exploring the emerging shift toward answer engine optimization (AEO). The conversation examines how AI models recommend services across versions, why developers must write for machines, and the product decisions required when giving agents over 80 Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools to autonomously set up accounts and send emails.
en.full_summary:
The Rise of Agentic API Selection
As coding agents become more autonomous, they increasingly make infrastructure decisions on behalf of developers—such as choosing which email provider to integrate. Zeno Rocha explores how tools like Claude Code recommend specific services and how these recommendations shift across model versions. This trend introduces answer engine optimization (AEO), requiring API providers to ensure their documentation, pricing, and capabilities are easily discoverable and parsable by non-human actors.
Designing for Machine Consumers
To support autonomous workflows, Resend has experimented with giving agents over 80 named Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, enabling them to read pricing written in Markdown, register for services independently, and execute API calls. Rocha details the practical challenges of this paradigm, from handling DNS hurdles and Gmail throttling to rethinking traditional metrics like tracking pixels, which may no longer accurately measure human engagement when interacting through software agents.

zh.title: 面向 AI 代理设计：Resend 如何布局答案引擎优化与自主 API 交互
zh.summary: Resend 联合创始人兼 CEO Zeno Rocha 探讨了编码代理如何选择邮件服务商等基础设施工具，并深入分析了新兴的答案引擎优化（AEO）趋势。访谈考察了 AI 模型在不同版本间如何推荐服务、开发者为何必须为机器写作，以及当赋予代理 80 多个模型上下文协议（MCP）工具来自主设置账户和发送邮件时所需做出的产品决策。
zh.full_summary:
代理自主选择 API 的兴起
随着编码代理变得越来越自主，它们越来越多地代表开发者做出基础设施决策——例如选择集成哪个邮件服务商。Zeno Rocha 探讨了诸如 Claude Code 之类的工具如何推荐特定服务，以及这些推荐在不同模型版本间如何变化。这一趋势催生了答案引擎优化（AEO），要求 API 提供商确保其文档、定价和功能能够轻松被非人类代理发现和解析。
为机器消费者进行设计
为了支持自主工作流，Resend 进行了实验，向代理提供 80 多个命名的模型上下文协议（MCP）工具，使它们能够读取 Markdown 格式的定价、独立注册服务并执行 API 调用。Rocha 详细阐述了这一范式的实际挑战，从处理 DNS 障碍和 Gmail 频率限制，到重新思考传统指标（如追踪像素），在通过软件代理进行交互时，这些传统指标可能不再能准确衡量人类的参与度。

en.title: FDA's new rare disease framework faces its first big test with Capricor's DMD drug
en.summary: The FDA's newly launched rare disease framework is facing its first major test as the agency decides whether to approve Capricor's cell therapy, deramiocel, for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. With the decision looming, the case highlights the tension between strict statistical rules and the harsh realities of treating progressive, rare conditions where slowing physical decline means preserving patient independence.
en.full_summary:
Capricor Therapeutics is seeking FDA approval for deramiocel, a cell therapy designed to preserve upper limb function in non-ambulatory Duchenne muscular dystrophy patients. In its Phase 3 trial, the drug slowed upper limb decline by 54% compared to placebo, though the statistical analysis plan was revised, sparking debate and scrutiny from FDA reviewers during an advisory committee meeting.

The debate underscores the core dilemma of the FDA's new Rare Disease Framework Initiative. In small patient populations with progressive diseases, running large trials is nearly impossible, and missing data is common. Experts argue that the FDA needs to explicitly define how it handles analysis plan changes, evaluates the totality of evidence, and values slowing functional loss as a meaningful clinical outcome.

The upcoming decision will reveal whether the FDA's new framework leads to a genuinely flexible approach or simply changes public relations rhetoric. For patients, delaying approval for another multi-year trial means losing irreversible physical independence.

zh.title: FDA刚推出的罕见病新规，马上就要迎来了首场大考
zh.summary: 美国食药监局刚推出的罕见病监管新规，马上迎来了首次关键大考：即将决定是否批准一款治疗杜氏肌营养不良症的细胞疗法。这场审评不仅关乎药物去留，更直接暴露出在面对罕见病时，传统统计标准与患者实际需求之间的激烈碰撞。
zh.full_summary:
Capricor公司研发的细胞疗法deramiocel正在等待FDA的审批，该药旨在延缓杜氏肌营养不良症患者的上肢功能衰退。在三期临床试验中，该药将患者上肢功能的恶化速度减缓了54%。但由于研究中调整了统计分析计划，引发了FDA审查人员的质疑与讨论，这也成为检验罕见病新规尺度的试金石。

这场争议凸显了罕见病药物研发的普遍困境：在患者基数极小的罕见病领域，开展大规模随机对照试验极为困难，数据缺失也难以避免。业界呼吁，FDA的新框架应当明确如何看待分析计划的调整，并承认在致死性退行性疾病中，延缓功能丧失本身就是极有意义的临床终点。

对患者而言，如果因为要求更漫长的重复试验而延迟批准，他们失去的是宝贵的自主生活能力。这次审批结果将直接影响未来资本对罕见病领域的投资信心。

en.title: Google brings Gemini Intelligence to more devices with new features
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google is expanding Gemini Intelligence to more Android devices like the Pixel 10 and Motorola Signature 27, while rolling out cool new features like custom widget creation and built-in tech support to make your phone smarter and easier to use.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

Google is aggressively expanding its Gemini Intelligence ecosystem to a broader range of hardware, including the newly supported Pixel 10 series and Motorola Signature 27, while bringing features like Rambler and task automation to more regions.

Key new additions include Create My Widget, which allows users to design personalized home screen widgets using just a text prompt without any coding, and Device Assistance, turning Gemini into a built-in expert that can manage phone settings, clear storage, and handle privacy checks through natural conversation.

Additionally, Gemini is breaking into new form factors and scenarios, integrating proactive suggestions into Android Auto to connect messages with emails on the go, and bringing custom widgets to the Pixel Watch.

zh.title: 谷歌将双子星智能带入更多设备并推出全新功能
zh.summary: 据Google AI发布的信息：谷歌正在将双子星智能扩展到Pixel 10和摩托罗拉等更多安卓设备上，并推出了通过简单描述定制小组件以及帮你搞定手机设置的全新功能，让日常使用变得更轻松。
zh.full_summary:
据Google AI发布的信息：

谷歌正在加速将双子星智能推向更多硬件设备，除了支持最新的Pixel 10系列和摩托罗拉新机外，还把实时语音转文字和跨应用任务自动化等实用功能带到了更多地区。

此次更新的亮点包括“创建我的小组件”功能，用户只需用大白话描述需求就能自动生成桌面小组件，完全不需要懂编程。同时推出的设备助手功能，能让手机变成你的专属客服，通过日常对话帮你清理内存或检查权限。

此外，这项智能技术还在向更多场景渗透，比如在车载安卓系统上提供主动智能建议，并把自定义小组件功能带到智能手表上，让多设备协同变得更加顺手。

en.title: Voyager 1 Reaches One Light-Day Distance From Earth
en.summary: According to NASA JPL: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft has reached a milestone of one light-day away from Earth, traveling over 16 billion miles since its 1977 launch. To celebrate this historic achievement, NASA is inviting the public to participate in a global light-flashing event and will host a special panel discussion with mission scientists to share updates and preview an upcoming documentary.
en.full_summary:
According to NASA JPL:

Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 is officially humanity's most distant space traveler. It has traveled so far that a signal from Earth now takes a full 24 hours to reach the spacecraft. Originally designed to explore the outer planets during a rare planetary alignment, the probe eventually entered interstellar space in 2012, continuing to send back valuable scientific data from beyond the sun's protective bubble.

To mark this historic milestone, NASA has organized a series of events. On November 17, people worldwide can use their smartphones to send a symbolic morse code signal of the spacecraft's call sign. Following that, NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory will host a live-streamed discussion with key mission members on November 19, detailing the ongoing challenges of operating the aging probes and offering a preview of a documentary planned for the mission's 50th anniversary in 2027.

zh.title: 旅行者1号距离地球达到惊人的一光天
zh.summary: 据NASA JPL发布的信息：美国宇航局的旅行者1号飞船迎来了历史性时刻，它距离地球已经达到 一光天 的超远距离，自1977年发射以来已飞行超过160亿英里。为了庆祝这一壮举，NASA邀请全球公众参与 闪光互动活动，并举办专家座谈会分享最新进展及纪录片预告。
zh.full_summary:
据NASA JPL发布的信息：

于1977年发射的旅行者1号是人类历史上走得最远的人造飞行器。它目前的距离极其遥远，地球发出的光或无线电信号需要整整 24小时才能到达 它身边。它最初的设计目的是借助罕见行星排列去探测外行星，并在2012年正式进入星际空间，源源不断地传回太阳系边缘之外宝贵的科学观测数据。

为了纪念这一里程碑，NASA精心筹备了一系列庆祝活动。在11月17日，全球公众可以通过手机发送象征着飞船呼号的 摩斯密码光波 来参与互动。随后在11月19日，喷气推进实验室将举办一场直播座谈会，由核心任务成员分享在如此遥远距离下维持老旧飞船运转的挑战，并提前放映为2027年 50周年纪念 而筹备的纪录片片段。

en.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with advanced reasoning and cybersecurity skills
en.summary: According to Google DeepMind: Google has officially released Gemini 4 Carbon, its most powerful AI model designed for complex coding, scientific research, and cybersecurity tasks. It builds on the earlier Argon model by offering deeper reasoning, multi-agent workflow support, and top-tier performance on industry benchmarks at a low cost.
en.full_summary: According to Google DeepMind: Google's new Gemini 4 Carbon model is built for tasks that test the limits of AI intelligence, such as multi-step coding, open-ended scientific research, and complex enterprise data analysis. Available for developers, enterprises, and scientists, Carbon excels in specialized areas like cybersecurity, where it aids security teams in finding, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. In scientific domains, it has been used to accelerate protein structure discovery and formal code verification, completing tasks in weeks that previously took human experts years. Furthermore, Google has introduced advanced safety mitigations to ensure its strong cyber capabilities do not translate into offensive misuse, achieving low breach rates in red-teaming tests.

zh.title: 谷歌发布Gemini 4 Carbon，主打更强推理与网络安全能力
zh.summary: 据Google DeepMind发布的信息：谷歌正式推出了最强AI模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，专门用来应对复杂的编程、科学研究和网络安全挑战。相比之前的模型，它具备更深入的推理能力和多智能体协作支持，在多个行业基准测试中表现拔尖且成本较低。
zh.full_summary: 据Google DeepMind发布的信息：谷歌全新发布的 Gemini 4 Carbon 模型专门用于挑战人工智能智力极限的任务，例如多步骤编程、开放式科学研究以及复杂的企业数据分析。面向开发者、企业和科学家开放的 Carbon，在网络安全等专业领域表现尤为出色，能够协助安全团队查找、利用并修复软件漏洞。在科学领域，它被用来加速蛋白质结构发现和形式化代码验证，将过去需要专家团队耗时数年的任务缩短至几周完成。此外，谷歌还引入了先进的安全缓解措施，确保其强大的网络安全能力不会演变成攻击性滥用，并在红队测试中实现了极低的违规突破率。

en.title: How Workday Built Its Enterprise AI Agent Platform with LangGraph
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: Workday built a production-ready AI agent platform using LangGraph and LangSmith, reducing prototype time from months to less than a day while meeting strict enterprise security and governance requirements.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

Facing the demand to build and deploy production-ready AI agents by 2026, a small initial team of four at Workday set out to create an internal developer platform. Operating under strict enterprise security and data governance policies, they needed a solution that supported rapid prototyping and robust compliance. By leveraging LangGraph for agent orchestration and LangSmith for evaluation and observability, the team abstracted away underlying infrastructure.

They developed a Python SDK dubbed 'Workday LangChain' to wrap primitives and connect with internal systems like LLM gateways and RAG services. This setup allowed them to out-of-the-box support advanced protocols like A2A and MCP. As a result, prototype delivery dropped from five months to under a day, enabling the team to scale up significantly and unify Workday's fragmented internal services into a single cohesive agent interface.

zh.title: Workday如何利用LangGraph打造企业级AI代理平台
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：企业服务巨头Workday利用LangGraph和LangSmith快速搭建了内部AI代理平台，将原型开发时间从数月缩短至不到一天，同时满足了严格的安全与合规要求。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

面对在2025年启动、计划于2026年底前将AI代理投入生产的大胆目标，Workday仅由4人组成的团队着手打造内部开发平台。在极为严格的企业安全与合规框架下，他们需要平衡快速原型开发与后端审计。通过引入LangGraph负责代理编排、LangSmith负责监控与评估，团队成功抽象化了底层基础设施。

他们开发了内部Python SDK，将LangChain原语与Workday的LLM网关、RAG检索等内部服务打通，从而原生支持了A2A和MCP等前沿协议。这一平台将原本需要4到5个月的原型开发周期缩短至不到一天，不仅促使团队规模扩大了数倍，还将Workday过去孤立的内部服务串联成统一的代理接口。

en.title: Beam Therapeutics reports positive trial results for its CRISPR sickle cell treatment
en.summary: Beam Therapeutics announced that its CRISPR-based treatment for sickle cell disease successfully met the main goal in a key clinical trial. Patients achieved freedom from severe pain crises for at least 12 months, and the company plans to file for FDA approval by the end of this year.
en.full_summary: Beam Therapeutics revealed that its experimental CRISPR-based therapy for sickle cell disease, called risto-cel, achieved the primary goal in a pivotal clinical trial by keeping patients free from severe pain crises for at least a full year. Although detailed data have not yet been publicly disclosed, the company is moving forward quickly with regulatory plans. Beam stated it intends to submit an FDA marketing application for the therapy as early as the end of this year, marking a significant milestone for its gene-editing pipeline.

zh.title: Beam Therapeutics宣布其CRISPR镰状细胞贫血治疗试验取得积极结果
zh.summary: Beam Therapeutics宣布，其针对镰状细胞贫血的基因编辑疗法在一项关键临床试验中达到了主要目标。患者实现了至少12个月内不再遭受严重疼痛危象，该公司计划在今年年底前向美国食品药品监督管理局提交上市申请。
zh.full_summary: Beam Therapeutics透露，其针对镰状细胞贫血的实验性CRISPR疗法risto-cel在一项关键临床试验中达成了主要目标，使患者在至少一年时间内免受严重疼痛危象的折磨。尽管尚未披露详细数据，但该公司正迅速推进监管流程。Beam表示，计划最早在今年年底前向FDA提交该疗法的上市申请，这为其基因编辑产品线树立了一个重要的里程碑。

en.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
en.summary: Adobe is upgrading its software lineup, including Photoshop and Premiere, with new AI agents and creative tools announced at the MAX event. The company is also launching a Model Context Protocol to let external chatbots access its creative features, alongside a move into Figma's design territory.
en.full_summary:
Adobe announced a massive wave of AI updates for its core software suite—including Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, and InDesign—at its MAX event in Miami. The updates introduce an always-on AI agent designed to understand user workflows and offer proactive assistance for quick tasks like background removal.

In addition to application updates, Adobe's Firefly app is expanding with a prototyping tool called Builder to compete with Figma, alongside smart video assembly and editing features. Adobe is also releasing a local MCP (Model Context Protocol), allowing third-party AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to tap into Creative Cloud capabilities, though industry figures debate the open standard's balance of benefits.

zh.title: Adobe为Photoshop和Premiere等王牌软件大举引入AI助手与新功能
zh.summary: Adobe在MAX大会上为其全线软件大举升级，给Photoshop和Premiere等工具塞入了更多AI功能。同时，他们还推出了允许外部聊天机器人调用自家功能的接口，甚至开始涉足竞争对手Figma的地盘。
zh.full_summary:
Adobe在迈阿密举行的MAX大会上，为其核心软件家族（包括Photoshop、Premiere、Illustrator和InDesign）推出了大批AI功能更新。此次升级引入了一款随时待命的AI助手，能够深入理解用户的创作工作流，并在抠图等日常任务中主动提供帮助。

除了常规软件升级，Adobe旗下的Firefly应用也推出了名为Builder的原型设计工具，直接切入竞争对手Figma的领地，同时还带来了智能视频剪辑功能。此外，Adobe还发布了本地MCP协议，允许ChatGPT和Claude等第三方AI工具直接调用其创意软件的功能，不过业内对其开放标准的实际利弊仍存争议。

en.title: Google and Adobe team up to put creative tools into Gmail and Docs
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google and Adobe are expanding their partnership to reduce app switching by integrating Adobe's PDF and creative tools directly into everyday Google apps like Gmail, Google Drive, and Gemini. At the same time, Google's advanced AI models will power Adobe's software, helping people work faster and stay focused without constantly jumping between different programs.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

Deeper Integration
Google and Adobe are teaming up to solve a common annoyance: constantly jumping between different apps just to edit a file or tweak an image. Soon, tools like Adobe Acrobat will show up directly inside Gmail and Google Drive as quick options, letting you view and edit PDFs on the spot.
AI Collaboration
This partnership goes both ways. Adobe is bringing its connectors into Google's Gemini and Search, and integrating its CX Enterprise Coworker agent to help teams design graphics and launch marketing campaigns right inside enterprise workspaces. Meanwhile, Adobe is teaming up with Google DeepMind to explore new features, starting with an image model for Photoshop aimed at making near-real-time edits possible.

zh.title: 谷歌和Adobe强强联手：把修图和改PDF搬进你的常用软件
zh.summary: 据Google AI发布的信息：谷歌和Adobe宣布扩大合作，把Adobe的图片和PDF处理工具直接塞进Gmail、谷歌网盘和Gemini等日常软件里。这意味着大家以后不用频繁切换软件就能直接改文件或处理图片，同时谷歌的先进AI模型也将为Adobe的各类应用提供强力支持，让日常办公和创作变得更顺手。
zh.full_summary:
据Google AI发布的信息：

告别频繁切屏
谷歌和Adobe这次合作的目标很直接，就是为了解决大家在不同软件之间跳来跳去处理文件的烦恼。很快，用户在Gmail和谷歌网盘里就能直接看到Adobe Acrobat的快捷入口，预览文件时点一下就能开始编辑。
深度融合AI
除了办公软件的打通，双方还把AI技术揉合到了一起。Adobe的工具将接入谷歌的Gemini和搜索功能，企业用户甚至可以直接在Gemini里使用Adobe的AI助手来设计海报和做营销。此外，Adobe还将携手谷歌DeepMind，探索全新功能，计划为Photoshop开发能实现准实时编辑的图像模型。

en.title: Ring is finally launching its flying indoor security drone
en.summary: Ring is releasing its AI-powered drone camera for indoor security, priced at $249.99 and set to ship in January 2027. It patrols your home automatically when triggered by sensors, offering 2K resolution and cloud-based navigation while addressing privacy concerns by recording only during flight.
en.full_summary:
How It Works
The new Ring Drone Cam is an autonomous indoor drone designed to replace multiple stationary security cameras. Powered by a new AI system called AI Pilot, it flies along preprogrammed routes when triggered by home sensors like motion detectors or door openings. It features a 2K camera with a 148-degree field of view and weighs just 165 grams.
Development and Privacy
Ring has spent years developing the device, finally redesigning it to rely on cloud processing to keep the price down. To address privacy concerns, the drone only records while flying, remains shuttered in its dock, and uses a rotating encryption system for its footage. However, it relies heavily on an internet connection and only offers a short flight time of five to eight minutes per charge.

zh.title: 亚马逊旗下Ring终于要推出室内巡逻无人机了
zh.summary: 亚马逊旗下的Ring即将在2027年1月推出售价249.99美元的室内巡逻无人机。它能在家里自动飞来飞去帮你巡逻，当感应器被触发时就会出动，画质达到2K，并且只有在飞行时才会进行录像，试图打消大家的隐私顾虑。
zh.full_summary:
工作原理
这款全新的Ring室内无人机旨在替代家里装的好几个固定摄像头。它搭载了名为AI Pilot的人工智能系统，当家里的门窗传感器或移动侦测器被触发时，它就会沿着预设路线自动起飞巡逻。它拥有2K分辨率和148度的广角视野，机身重量只有165克。
开发历程与隐私
Ring为此研发多年，最终选择将核心技术放在云端以控制成本。为了缓解用户的隐私担忧，这款无人机只有在飞行时才会录像，平时在底座上时镜头是关着的，视频也采用了加密技术。不过，它非常依赖网络信号，且每次充电只能飞5到8分钟。

en.title: Hollywood is fighting back against AI as storyboard artists face displacement
en.summary: AI is already affecting behind-the-scenes jobs in Hollywood, with storyboard artists bearing the brunt of the impact as major film-makers adopt text-to-image tech. While big directors like Martin Scorsese and James Cameron dabble with AI tools, artists argue that storyboarding is not just about drawing pictures, but a collaborative creative process that builds human connection and cinematic language. Many believe the rise of AI will ultimately lead to a greater appreciation for human authenticity in filmmaking.
en.full_summary:
The Threat to Storyboards
While the prospect of fully AI-generated movies is still on the horizon, generative AI tools are already stepping on the toes of Hollywood's storyboard artists. Traditionally, these illustrators work hand-in-hand with directors, cinematographers, and crew members to map out scenes, serving as the blueprint for the entire production. Now, text-to-image software threatens to replace this foundational step, with directors like Martin Scorsese even partnering with AI firms for their upcoming projects.
The Human Collaborative Process
Artists emphasize that storyboarding is much more than just producing pretty pictures; it is a vital part of human collaboration. British storyboard artist Alex Clark points out that hashing out ideas, acting things out, and discussing details with the crew creates a shared creative vision. Legendary directors like Denis Villeneuve and Bong Joon-ho view storyboarding as an extension of the director's brain and a crucial form of cinematic writing that fosters spontaneity and emotional connection.
Future Outlook
Despite the creeping influence of AI, experts and artists believe that the core of filmmaking relies on human touch. Some academics suggest that the friction and difficulty of traditional artistic collaboration are actually the whole point of making art. As AI tools become more common, industry insiders predict that audiences and creators will place an even higher value on human authenticity and the unique imperfections of hand-crafted cinema.

zh.title: 好莱坞的分镜画师正在被AI冲击，电影行业展开反击
zh.summary: AI已经开始影响好莱坞的幕后工作，随着大导演们纷纷试水新技术，分镜画师成了首当其冲受冲击的群体。虽然马丁·斯科塞斯和詹姆斯·卡梅隆等大咖都在尝试使用AI工具，但从业者认为分镜不仅是画画，更是一个需要真人沟通的合作创作过程。许多人相信，AI的泛滥最终反而会让人类更加珍惜电影里的人情味。
zh.full_summary:
分镜画师面临的危机
虽然全AI生成的电影还在未来，但生成式AI工具已经开始抢好莱坞分镜画师的饭碗了。按照传统，画师们需要和导演、摄影师及剧组密切合作，把剧本变成一幅幅指引拍摄的分镜头草图。如今，文生图软件正威胁要取代这一步，甚至连马丁·斯科塞斯这样的大导演也开始在新电影中尝试使用AI工具来做分镜。
珍贵的真人协作
从业者强调，分镜远不止是画出漂亮的图片，它更是不可或缺的人类协作过程。英国分镜画师亚历克斯·克拉克指出，大家坐在一起讨论、甚至现场演练细节的过程，能创造出独特的集体创作火花。像丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦和奉俊昊这样的名导，一直把分镜视为导演大脑的延伸和电影语言的第一步，其中充满了意外的惊喜和情感连接。
行业的未来展望
尽管AI步步紧逼，艺术家和学者们依然坚信电影的核心在于人类的情感。有学者指出，传统艺术创作中那些磕磕绊绊的沟通，恰恰是艺术本身的价值所在。业内人士预测，随着AI越来越普及，大家反而会更加珍惜带有人类真实温度的手工电影质感。

en.title: PepGen shares promising early trial data for its muscular dystrophy drug
en.summary: Biotech company PepGen announced that its experimental drug showed promising early results in treating a severe muscle disorder affecting over 100,000 people. Although PepGen entered the race relatively late, this data from six patients provides a much needed boost to the field, especially after a rival drug from Novartis recently failed in late-stage trials.
en.full_summary:
PepGen announced on Tuesday that its experimental drug for myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) has demonstrated promising early data based on a key measure. DM1 is a debilitating muscle disorder that usually strips patients of their strength and muscle control starting from adolescence, impacting over 100,000 individuals across the U.S. and Europe.

Although PepGen is considered a latecomer in developing treatments for this specific condition, the latest results come from a small group of six patients who received 12 weeks of treatment. This announcement arrives at a critical time for the industry. A rival company, Dyne Therapeutics, is currently nearing completion of a pivotal trial for its own DM1 treatment. Meanwhile, the entire field faced a major setback when Novartis announced that a DM1 drug it acquired through a massive $12 billion buyout of Avidity Biosciences failed to improve key muscle control measures in a Phase 3 trial.

zh.title: 生物医药公司 PepGen 公布肌肉萎缩症药物的早期积极临床数据
zh.summary: 生物医药公司 PepGen 宣布，其研发的实验性药物在治疗一种影响超过十万人的肌肉疾病时，显示出了不错的早期疗效。尽管 PepGen 入局较晚，但来自六名患者的这组数据为该领域注入了一剂强心针，特别是此前诺华的一款同类药物刚刚在后期临床试验中遭遇了失败。
zh.full_summary:
生物医药公司 PepGen 在周二宣布，其针对 1 型强直性肌营养不良症（DM1）的实验性药物，在某项关键指标上取得了迄今为止最令人鼓舞的早期数据。DM1 是一种会严重摧毁患者肌肉控制力和力量的顽疾，通常从青春期开始发作，在美欧两地影响着超过 10 万名患者。

尽管 PepGen 在该领域的研发上属于后来者，但这些最新数据来自于接受了 12 周治疗的 6 名患者。当前整个行业正处于微妙的竞争格局中，竞争对手 Dyne Therapeutics 正在接近完成一项关键性临床试验。与此同时，不久前诺华斥资 12 亿美元收购 Avidity Biosciences 获得的 DM1 药物在三期临床中宣告失败，这曾给整个研发领域蒙上了一层阴影，而 PepGen 的新数据则带来了一丝转机。

en.title: Google DeepMind uses AI to mathematically prove Signal protocol security
en.summary: According to Google DeepMind: Google DeepMind has introduced AlphaProof Code, a new AI agent system that mathematically verified the actual code behind the Signal protocol. This breakthrough took just four weeks instead of years, marking a major milestone in software security.
en.full_summary:
According to Google DeepMind:

How It Works
Google DeepMind researchers built AlphaProof Code, a multi-LLM framework that combines human expertise with AI agents. Human experts worked with models to translate Signal's security goals into formal mathematical specifications, while Gemini Carbon-powered agents generated over six million lines of Lean, a computer language used for mathematical proofs.
Why It Matters
Most security verification stops at the design level, but this system proved that the compiled code actually fulfills its security promises down to the exact code running on user devices. This bridges a major gap where real-world vulnerabilities often hide, cutting down verification time drastically.
Future Impact
This breakthrough demonstrates how AI can bring elite security assurance to critical systems like medical device firmware and power grids, helping defend against modern cyber threats while safeguarding billions of private conversations.

zh.title: 谷歌DeepMind用AI在数学上证明了Signal协议的安全性
zh.summary: 据Google DeepMind发布的信息：谷歌DeepMind推出了名为AlphaProof Code的全新AI智能体系统，首次在数学层面上验证了Signal加密协议的真实代码。这项原本需要专家耗时多年的工作，现在仅用了四周就完成了，是软件安全领域的一大突破。
zh.full_summary:
据Google DeepMind发布的信息：

工作原理
谷歌DeepMind的研究人员开发了AlphaProof Code，这是一个结合了人类专业知识与AI智能体的多模型框架。人类专家与模型合作，将Signal的安全目标转化为形式化的数学规范，随后由Gemini Carbon驱动的智能体生成了超过六百万行Lean代码，这是一种用于数学定理证明的计算机语言。
为什么重要
大多数安全验证通常只停留在设计阶段，而这套系统直接证明了编译后的代码在用户设备上实际运行的每一行都符合安全承诺。这弥合了现实世界漏洞常常藏身的鸿沟，将原本需要数年的人工审核时间大幅缩短。
未来影响
这一突破展示了AI如何为医疗设备固件和电网等关键系统带来顶级的安全保障，在防范现代网络威胁的同时，保护数十亿人的隐私对话安全。

en.title: D-Wave Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results with 21% Revenue Growth and Expanded Global Partnerships
en.summary: According to D-Wave News: D-Wave released its third-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting a 21% increase in revenue year-over-year and a massive surge in remaining performance obligations. The company also reported major business milestones, including a potential $100 million CHIPS Act grant from the U.S. government and new quantum deployments with global telecom and tech giants.
en.full_summary:
According to D-Wave News:

D-Wave Quantum Inc. announced its financial and business results for the third quarter of 2026, showing continued commercial momentum alongside heavy investments in next-generation quantum technologies. During the quarter, the company generated $4.5 million in revenue, marking a 21% increase compared to the same period in 2025. Total bookings for the first nine months of 2026 surged to $37.4 million, representing a 611% year-over-year increase, while remaining performance obligations reached $38.3 million.

On the technical and partnership fronts, D-Wave finalized an agreement to access up to $100 million in funding from the U.S. CHIPS and Science Act to advance both its annealing and gate-model quantum computers. Internationally, the company delivered Italy's first commercial annealing quantum system to Como and expanded enterprise applications, such as NTT DOCOMO deploying a second production hybrid quantum application that significantly optimized mobile network signaling loads.

zh.title: D-Wave公布2026年第三季度财报：营收同比增长21%，全球合作进一步扩展
zh.summary: 据D-Wave News发布的信息：量子计算公司 D-Wave 公布了 2026 年第三季度财报，其中营收实现了 21% 的同比增长，未执行完的订单金额也大幅飙升。此外，该公司还迎来了多项重要业务进展，包括获得美国政府高达 1.0 亿美元的芯片法案资助，以及与全球多家通信和科技巨头展开量子技术合作。
zh.full_summary:
据D-Wave News发布的信息：

D-Wave Quantum Inc. 发布了 2026 年第三季度财务与业务报告，展示了其在商业化进程中的持续增长，同时也反映出公司在下一代量子技术研发上的巨大投入。财报显示，该季度公司实现营收 450 万美元，较去年同期增长 21%。2026年前九个月的总预定订单额飙升至 3740 万美元，同比增幅达到 611%，未履约订单金额也达到 38.3 亿美元。

在技术研发与外部合作方面，D-Wave 与美国商务部签署了最终协议，将获得最高达 1.0 亿美元的芯片法案资金支持，用于开发性能更强的退火型和门模型量子计算机。在国际市场上，D-Wave 向意大利科莫交付了该国首台商用退火量子计算机系统；同时，日本电信巨头 NTT DOCOMO 部署了其第二个基于 D-Wave 混合量子技术的生产级应用，成功大幅降低了移动网络的信令负载。

en.title: France calls for strict rules on AI assistants to protect minors
en.summary: A new report submitted to French President Emmanuel Macron urges immediate regulation of mainstream AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini. The advisory council warns that highly personalized chat tools create serious risks of dependence and psychological exploitation, especially for minors, by monetizing human cognitive abilities and emotional responses.
en.full_summary:
Background and Mission
Following a mandate given at the New Delhi AI summit, the French Council on AI and Digital Technology investigated how popular AI services exploit user vulnerabilities. While stopping short of an outright ban for minors, the report highlights the emergence of a cognition economy where platforms profit from psychological profiles and emotional manipulation.
Key Proposals
The council recommends banning default features that make AIs feel human, such as flattery and anthropomorphization. It also demands stricter safety guardrails, including better detection of self-harm topics, mandatory reminders that users are talking to machines, and accessible reporting mechanisms for problematic AI replies.

zh.title: 法国呼吁对人工智能助手进行严格监管以保护未成年人
zh.summary: 一份提交给法国总统马克龙的新报告敦促对像ChatGPT和双子座这样的主流AI助手进行立即监管。咨询委员会警告说，高度个性的聊天工具会带来严重的依赖风险和心理剥削，特别是对未成年人而言，因为它们正试图通过将人类的认知能力和情感反应进行商业化变现。
zh.full_summary:
背景与任务
在响应新德里AI峰会的委任后，法国人工智能与数字技术委员会调查了热门AI服务如何利用用户弱点。尽管该报告没有提议对未成年人全面禁封AI，但它指出了认知经济的兴起，即平台通过用户的心理画像和情感操纵来获取利润。
核心建议
委员会建议禁用默认让AI显得像人类的功能，例如恭维和拟人化。它还要求设立更严格的安全护栏，包括更好地检测自残话题、强制提醒用户正在与机器对话，以及为有问题的AI回复建立便捷的举报机制。

en.title: AI Tollbooths are Moving: Why On-Device Chips Target Cloud Cashiers
en.summary: As edge AI chips and on-device models boom, people worry the cloud will lose out. In reality, on-device processing doesn't kill the cloud; it just changes how we pay. Just like household appliances increased total power consumption instead of shutting down power plants, edge devices handle daily tasks while cloud giants keep the core knowledge and fallback power. The industry is shifting from per-token charges to a three-tier billing system covering installation, continuous updates, and cloud backups, reshaping who holds the pricing power.
en.full_summary:
The Shift of AI Tollbooths
Recent data shows edge AI chip shipments growing much faster than cloud chips, and startups are raising billions. A common misconception is that running AI locally will starve the cloud. However, physical token consumption is actually expanding due to model distillation, synchronization, and data feedback. This mirrors the Jevons Paradox, where higher efficiency leads to a massive surge in total resource consumption. Edge devices act as execution layers, while the cloud remains the ultimate supply layer.
Three Tiers of the New Business Model
The industry is moving away from the rigid per-token pricing model toward a three-tier billing structure. First is the installation authorization fee, where model makers charge hardware manufacturers based on device shipment volumes. Second is the continuous service subscription, allowing devices to stay updated with frontier models. Third is the cloud fallback fee for complex tasks that local chips cannot handle. Combined with new industry standards like agent interoperability guidelines, this creates a transparent system for metering, pricing, and accountability.
The Strategic Balance
Ultimately, the cloud providers don't need to charge for every single interaction; they just need to monetize the uniqueness of their answers when local devices fail. The pricing power remains at the top, ensuring that a thriving edge ecosystem actually deepens the device makers' long-term reliance on cloud intelligence.

zh.title: AI的收费站正在搬家：端侧抢的不是算力，是云端的收银台
zh.summary: 随着端侧AI芯片和本地模型大火，很多人担心云端生意要黄。其实，端侧抢的不是云端的算力，而是按次计费的收银台。这就好比家里添了电器让发电厂用电量大增一样，端侧处理日常小事，云端则牢牢掌握核心知识与兜底权力。接下来，AI行业的收费模式将变成涵盖装机、更新和兜底的三层账单，彻底改变产业链的利益分配格局。
zh.full_summary:
收费站为什么搬家
最新数据显示，端侧AI芯片的出货增速和融资热度都在快速上升。很多人误以为端侧芯片吃掉本地调用量会威胁到云端，但实际上，这只是改变了计费方式。大模型蒸馏、快照更新以及内容审核每一环都在产生新的消耗，这完全符合杰文斯悖论：效率提升并没有减少资源消耗，反而让总消耗量暴涨。端侧芯片处理的是日常任务的出口，而云端依然是大模型的知识入口。
三层账单的诞生
随着端侧AI的普及，传统的按token过闸模式不再适用，行业正在走向三层账单的新格局。第一层是面向设备厂商的装机授权费，按出货量计费；第二层是按年收取的持续服务费，用来跟进模型迭代；第三层则是处理本地搞不定的复杂任务时的云端兜底计费。配合各类智能体互联公约与标准的出台，整个行业的计量、计费和权责划分正在变得清晰规范。
谁来掌控定价权
在这场产业链的重新洗牌中，云端厂商不需要赚取每一次调用的微利，而是垄断了本地搞不定时唯一能找到的终极答案。设备厂商赚取硬件溢价，而模型厂则通过提供长期稳定的同源对齐与更新服务来锁定收益。端侧越繁荣，对云端知识供给的依赖反而越深。

en.title: Zhengyuan Quantum Secures Funding to Tackle Thousand-Qubit Superconducting Challenges
en.summary: Superconducting quantum computing is tackling the scaling bottleneck, aiming to build a thousand-qubit machine.
